KGaA (a subsidiary of Branicks Group AG, formerly DIC Asset AG) holds roughly 69% of voting rights, following a partial takeover offer completed in 2022; remaining ~31% was free float before a 2026 control/profit-transfer agreement and share-swap offer to minority holders. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/VIB-VERMOGEN-AG-66284737/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: No evidence of meaningful founder/management ownership; control rests with corporate parent Branicks Group/DIC Asset rather than insiders or founders. Not disclosed in public filings beyond the controlling corporate shareholder.
thesis.red_flags: A VIB major shareholder requested a special audit regarding a EUR 250 million loan from VIB to its majority shareholder Branicks Group, a related-party transaction; minority shareholders also raised concerns about potential delisting and dividend cuts following DIC Asset's takeover and the 2026 control/profit-transfer agreement. [Spruchverfahren.blogspot.com](https://spruchverfahren.blogspot.com/2024/07/vib-groaktionar-fordert-sonderprufung.html)

thesis.business_description: StealthGas Inc. is a Marshall Islands-domiciled international shipping company that owns and operates a fleet of LPG carriers transporting liquefied petroleum and petrochemical gas products (propane, butane, butadiene, propylene, etc.); as of March 2026 it operated a fleet of 28 LPG carriers with combined capacity of 334,118 cbm.
thesis.competitive_position: StealthGas is described as the world's largest owner of small LPG pressurized carriers in the strategic 3,000-8,000 cbm segment, giving it scale leadership in that specific niche of the LPG shipping market ([StealthGas investor relations](https://www.stealthgas.com/investor-relations-mainmenu-99.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Flawless Management, Inc. (19.11%, controlled by CEO Harry Vafias), Glendon Capital Management L.P. (12.75%), Harry Vafias directly (12.18%) plus additional indirect holdings via Arethusa Properties LTD (586,020 shares) ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/heres-stealthgas-inc-nasdaq-gass-115509217.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Harry Vafias controls roughly 30%+ of the company when direct holdings plus Flawless Management, Inc. and Arethusa Properties LTD are combined; he has been President/CEO since the company's founding in December 2004 ([Yahoo Finance ownership summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/heres-stealthgas-inc-nasdaq-gass-115509217.html))
thesis.red_flags: Heavy insider/founder control (CEO Vafias and affiliated entities hold a large combined stake) concentrates governance power; no specific litigation or accounting red flags identified from sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Bertrandt AG, headquartered in Ehingen, Germany, provides engineering development services to the automotive and aviation industries, organized into Digital Engineering, Electrical Systems/Electronics and Physical Engineering segments, and also serves aerospace, rail, defense, medical-technology and energy sectors.
thesis.competitive_position: Bertrandt is an established European automotive engineering-services provider with roughly 12,100 employees; Porsche AG is its largest shareholder (28.97%), reflecting close ties to the German auto industry - a source of stable client relationships but also a concentration risk given dependence on automotive R&D spending cycles ([Bertrandt IR](https://www.bertrandt.com/en/company/investor-relations/bertrandt-share/shareholder-structure)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Porsche AG (28.97%), Friedrich Boysen Holding GmbH (14.90%), Frank Ferchau (10%), Supervisory/Management Board (4.0%), free float (45.76%), as of December 2024 ([Bertrandt IR](https://www.bertrandt.com/en/company/investor-relations/bertrandt-share/shareholder-structure))
thesis.insider_ownership: Supervisory Board and Management Board together hold about 4.0% of shares ([Bertrandt IR](https://www.bertrandt.com/en/company/investor-relations/bertrandt-share/shareholder-structure))
thesis.red_flags: Notable customer/industry concentration risk given heavy reliance on the automotive sector, including ties to major shareholder Porsche AG, exposing Bertrandt to cyclical downturns in auto R&D spending. No governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: UK-based developer and manufacturer (Surgical and Woundcare segments) of tissue-healing technologies including tissue adhesives, sutures, haemostats and internal sealants (INTEGUSEAL, LiquiBand, RESORBA, Seal-G brands) and advanced wound-care dressings (ActivHeal brand), serving the UK, Germany, France, US and international markets.
thesis.competitive_position: Described as a world-leading independent developer/manufacturer of tissue-healing technologies with manufacturing sites across the UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, Thailand, India, Czech Republic and Israel, giving it a broader international manufacturing footprint than many AIM-listed medtech peers.
thesis.main_shareholders: Octopus Investments Limited (13%), Canaccord Genuity Wealth International (6.5%), Charles Stanley & Co. Asset Management (5.2%); top 12 shareholders control 51%, no single majority holder ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/advanced-medical-solutions-group-plc-050446954.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders hold under 1% in their own names; CEO Andrew Meredith individually holds ~0.8% ([MatrixBCG/Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/advanced-medical-solutions-group-plc-050446954.html))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Sonel S.A. is a Polish manufacturer of electrical test and measuring instruments for the power industry and telecommunications, headquartered in Świdnica, Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: A Polish niche electrical test-equipment manufacturer; specific market-share or competitive-moat data was not found in available sources beyond its domestic manufacturing base. [Sonel company history](https://sonel.pl/en/about/history)
thesis.main_shareholders: Chairman Krzysztof Wieczorkowski holds approximately 22.51%; board member Mirosław Nowakowski holds approximately 7.95%; individual insiders collectively hold approximately 67.1% of the company, with institutional ownership around 17.5% and the general public holding approximately 15.3%. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/tech/wse-son/sonel-shares/news/who-are-the-major-shareholders-of-sonel-sa-wseson/amp)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high insider ownership at approximately 67.1% held by individual insiders, led by Chairman Krzysztof Wieczorkowski (~22.51%) and board member Mirosław Nowakowski (~7.95%). [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/tech/wse-son/sonel-shares/news/who-are-the-major-shareholders-of-sonel-sa-wseson/amp)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Greek car rental and leasing company (founded 1966, Crete origin), the official Hertz International franchisee for Greece and 8 other countries (Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Montenegro, Ukraine, Croatia and others), also importing/distributing/selling cars; operates Hertz, Thrifty, Dollar and Firefly brands.
thesis.competitive_position: The largest car rental company in Greece and the largest national Hertz franchisee in the world (continuously since 1978), with a fleet of 48,000+ vehicles and 160+ service locations (51 at airports) across 9 countries.
thesis.main_shareholders: Estate of Theodore E. Vassilakis holds 62.7% (29,782,668 shares); historically Theodore Vassilakis (58.16%) and Emmanuella Vassilakis (9.53%) individually per 2012 disclosure ([MarketScreener/company disclosures](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AUTOHELLAS-S-A-6258920/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Vassilakis founding family controls approximately 62.7% via the Estate of Theodore E. Vassilakis, maintaining majority control of the listed company since its 1999 Athens Exchange listing ([company financial statements](https://www.autohellas.gr/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/FINANCIAL-STATEMENTS-31-12-2012.pdf))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Fountaine Pajot SA is a French shipyard and one of the world's pioneering builders of cruising catamarans, sailing catamarans, motor yachts and sailboats, founded in 1976 in Aigrefeuille-d'Aunis.
thesis.competitive_position: A long-established, founder-family-controlled catamaran/motor-yacht builder with global distribution (including an expanding Asia network); H1 FY2025/26 revenue fell to EUR 136.3 million from over EUR 156 million a year earlier and net profit fell from EUR 15.3 million to EUR 5.2 million, reflecting a cyclical slowdown in leisure-marine demand. [Boat Industry](https://www.boatindustry.com/news/52672/fountaine-pajot-asia-an-expanded-network-from-hong-kong-to-thailand)
thesis.main_shareholders: La Compagnie du Catamaran SAS, the investment vehicle of the founding Fountaine family, holds approximately 53.3%; Independance AM holds approximately 5.59%, with smaller stakes held by Kirao SAS, Amplegest SAS and OFI Invest Asset Management. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FOUNTAINE-PAJOT-54449/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder family control is high: La Compagnie du Catamaran (the Fountaine family vehicle) holds roughly 53.3%, and family members are represented on both management and the board; CEO Nicolas Gardies has led since 1997 and is planning a transition to Deputy CEO Mathieu Fountaine (a family member) ahead of 2027 retirement. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FOUNTAINE-PAJOT-54449/company/)
thesis.red_flags: Revenue and net profit declined sharply in H1 FY2025/26 (revenue down ~13%, net profit down ~66%); the company is also undergoing a leadership succession, with deputy CEO Romain Motteau departing after 20+ years and new deputy CEO Steven Guedeu appointed, alongside CEO Nicolas Gardies' planned 2027 retirement, both execution risks to monitor. [Marine Business World](https://www.marinebusinessworld.com/news/297669/Fountaine-Pajot-strengthens-its-governance)

thesis.business_description: Mensch und Maschine Software SE (M+M) is a German provider of CAD, CAM, PDM and BIM software solutions, operating across Europe, the Americas and Asia, headquartered in Wessling near Munich.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading European CAD/CAM/BIM software and Autodesk reseller/value-added partner (founded 1984), with EUR 238.6 million in 2025 sales and ~1,200 employees; chose a monistic (one-tier) board structure to suit its owner-managed-yet-public status. [Rhino Insight](https://rhinoinsight.substack.com/p/mensch-und-maschine-software-se-ticker)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and Chairman of the Management Board Adi Drotleff holds approximately 47-48% of shares; other management members hold a further ~5.4%; the top 3 shareholders collectively control more than half the company, with institutional ownership around 16%. [Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/47-ownership-mensch-und-maschine-054517782.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high insider ownership: founder Adi Drotleff alone holds approximately 47-48% as of year-end 2025, with other management holding an additional ~5.4%, giving insiders well over 50% combined control. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/47-ownership-mensch-und-maschine-054517782.html)
thesis.red_flags: No specific governance disputes or auditor concerns were found; dhgp GmbH Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft was elected as auditor for FY2024 in the normal course. Concentrated founder control (top 3 holders >50%) is a structural governance consideration but not a disclosed dispute. None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Interlife General Insurance Company S.A., founded in Thessaloniki, Greece in 1991, is a non-life insurer offering motor, marine/ship, property, group life/health, legal-protection, technical/engineering, liability and transport insurance products, listed on the Athens Stock Exchange main market since 2021.
thesis.competitive_position: Interlife is a mid-sized, founder-led Greek non-life insurer competing against larger domestic players (e.g. Ethniki, Interamerican, European Reliance) in a fragmented Greek P&C insurance market. [Interlife company data](https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/164465-29)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Votsaridis family controls the company: founder Ioannis Votsaridis holds approximately 22.03%, Georgia Votsaridou approximately 14.24%, Konstantinos Votsaridis approximately 13.42%, and Panagiotis Ioannis Votsaridis approximately 5.08%, with Gnomon Consultants SA holding approximately 5.31%. [iggyoninvesting Substack, citing company disclosures](https://iggyoninvesting.substack.com/p/interlife-the-next-davis-double-play)
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Votsaridis family collectively holds more than 50% of the company (summing disclosed family stakes of ~22.03% + ~14.24% + ~13.42% + ~5.08%), with founder Ioannis Votsaridis serving as President and CEO — very high founder/insider control. [iggyoninvesting Substack](https://iggyoninvesting.substack.com/p/interlife-the-next-davis-double-play)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: edding AG is a German manufacturer of felt-tip pens, marker pens, spray paints and other writing/stationery products, headquartered in Ahrensburg near Hamburg and founded in 1960.
thesis.competitive_position: A well-known German stationery/marker brand (2023 revenue ~EUR 161 million) competing in a market experiencing structural underperformance, especially in its core Germany and Turkey units; the family retains majority voting control through ordinary shares while only non-voting preference shares trade publicly. [Edding IR](https://www.edding.com/en-us/investor-relations/overview/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Ledermann founding family holds the majority of ordinary (voting) shares; only non-voting preference shares are publicly traded, meaning public shareholders do not have voting control. [Wikipedia/Edding History](https://www.edding.com/en-us/history/)
thesis.insider_ownership: High and controlling: the Ledermann family has held majority ordinary-share ownership since the 1986 IPO (when co-founder Edding exited), with Per Ledermann (2nd generation) and Julia Marie Ledermann (3rd generation, Chairwoman of the Advisory Board) actively involved in governance. [Edding History](https://www.edding.com/en-us/history/)
thesis.red_flags: The company reported its first-ever net loss in the consolidated financial statements for FY2023, driven by a EUR 5.0 million negative deconsolidation effect from the sale of edding Argentina S.A.; guidance was cut multiple times, with FY2026 sales guidance reduced to EUR 139-154 million (from original mid-term planning of EUR 173-188 million) and EBIT guidance cut to EUR 1-4 million (from EUR 8-11 million), reflecting weak performance in Germany and Turkey. [edding IR](https://www.edding.com/en-us/investor-relations/news/article/net-loss-expected-in-edding-ags-individual-financial-statements/)

thesis.business_description: AB Kauno Energija is a Lithuanian utility that produces and distributes heat energy to consumers in Kaunas and Jurbarkas and parts of the surrounding Kaunas districts, and also generates electricity in Kaunas, operating a power plant in Petrašiūnai, district and regional boiler houses, and providing heat/power infrastructure maintenance services.
thesis.competitive_position: Kauno Energija is effectively the monopoly district-heating utility for Kaunas, Lithuania's second-largest city, giving it a stable, regulated regional market position typical of municipal utilities rather than a competitive commercial moat ([GlobeNewswire](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/26/3300751/0/en/Activity-results-of-AB-Kauno-energija-of-the-1-quarter-of-the-year-2026.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Kaunas City Municipality holds 92.8% of votes (39,736,058 ordinary shares) ([GlobeNewswire shareholder meeting resolutions](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/04/29/tmt-newswire/globenewswire/resolutions-of-the-general-meeting-of-shareholders-of-ab-kauno-energija/2331132))
thesis.red_flags: Very high public-sector ownership concentration (92.8% held by Kaunas City Municipality) means the free float and minority-shareholder influence are minimal; as a regulated municipal utility it is also exposed to tariff-setting/regulatory risk. No other red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Addnode Group AB is a Swedish company that acquires, operates and develops knowledge-led software businesses, organized around Design Management (construction, real estate, industrial design IT solutions), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM software), and Process Management (case management, municipal government, e-archive, GIS systems).
thesis.competitive_position: A Swedish serial-acquirer software group ('digitizing society') spanning multiple vertical software niches; specific market-share/moat data was not confirmed from sources reviewed, though its diversified, acquisition-driven model resembles other Nordic industrial/software holding companies. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ADDNODE-GROUP-AB-6491326/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Lannebo Kapitalförvaltning holds approximately 10.77%, Swedbank Robur Fonder approximately 10.29%, Andra AP-fonden approximately 6.57%, Cliens Kapitalförvaltning approximately 6.52%, and Fjärde AP-fonden approximately 5.04%. No connection to Lagercrantz Group was confirmed; shared minor holder ODIN Forvaltning appears in both companies' registers coincidentally. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ADDNODE-GROUP-AB-6491326/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a significant founder/management stake in sources reviewed; the shareholder register is dominated by Swedish institutional asset managers and pension funds rather than insiders.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Odfjell SE is a Norway-based provider of seaborne transportation and storage of chemicals and other specialty bulk liquids, operating through two segments: Chemical Tankers (a fleet of more than 80 ships serving global routes) and Tank Terminals.
thesis.competitive_position: Odfjell is one of the world's leading chemical tanker operators, competing globally in transport of hard-to-handle liquid chemicals for industrial producers and traders; it recently agreed to buy four 40,000 dwt 'super-segregator' newbuilds for USD290 million to modernize and expand its fleet ([Odfjell](https://www.odfjell.com/investors)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Norchem A/S, controlled by founding-family member Laurence Ward Odfjell (42.37% of shares, 42.02% of votes), A/S Rederiet Odfjell (also Odfjell-family controlled), Stolt-Nielsen Norway AS (13.6% of votes), the Steen family (12.2%) ([Pestel Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/odfjell))
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Odfjell family controls a plurality stake via Norchem A/S and A/S Rederiet Odfjell (combined well over 40% of votes) ([Pestel Analysis](https://pestel-analysis.com/blogs/owners/odfjell))
thesis.red_flags: Dual-class share structure (A- and B-shares, with B-shares carrying no votes) concentrates control with the founding Odfjell family. No other governance red flags identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Oponeo.pl S.A. is a Poland-based online retailer of tires and automotive parts, founded in 1999 and headquartered in Bydgoszcz, offering roughly 100 tire brands plus wheel rims and other auto accessories.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading Polish/European online tire retailer with an established e-commerce platform since its 2007 WSE listing, competing in the fragmented online tire-and-parts retail space. [Oponeo company history](https://www.ir.oponeo.pl/en/company-info/history/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Co-founders Dariusz Topolewski (~32.57%) and Ryszard Zawieruszyński (~26.42%) together hold approximately 59% of shares; institutional holders include Allianz Polska TFI (~5.86%), ING TFI (~5.26%) and Norges Bank Investment Management (~5.13%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/OPONEO-PL-S-A-6499864/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high founder ownership: co-founders Topolewski and Zawieruszyński together control roughly 59% of the company, indicating strong alignment between management/founders and shareholders. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/OPONEO-PL-S-A-6499864/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Stabilus SE is a German manufacturer of gas springs, hydraulic dampers and motion-control components for automotive, industrial and medical applications, headquartered in Koblenz.
thesis.competitive_position: Stabilus is the global market leader in automotive gas springs with an estimated market share of over 40%, and world leader in gas springs/hydraulic dampers overall with annual production exceeding 140 million units; it transformed into a broader industrial-automation player via the 2024 Destaco acquisition, expanding into clamping and robotic end-effectors. [Ad-hoc-news.de](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/stabilus-se-stock-de000stab1l8-is-its-automotive-motion-control-edge/69158070)
thesis.main_shareholders: Following its 2014 IPO, Stabilus is widely held with roughly 89% free float; notable institutional shareholders include Goldman Sachs Advisors BV (~11.02%), Teleios Capital Partners (~9.77%), and Fidelity Management & Research (~9.54%). No single controlling shareholder remains; prior private-equity owners Montagu and Triton Partners have fully exited. [Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/stabilus-se-etr-stm-largely-073935973.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in public filings as a significant founder/management stake; ownership is dominated by institutional investors rather than insiders following the 2014 IPO and full exit of prior private-equity sponsors.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Fleury Michon SA is a French family-owned agri-food company and France's leading producer of cooked meats (charcuterie), ready meals and catering products sold through supermarkets, founded in 1905 in Vendée.
thesis.competitive_position: Market leader in France for cooked/processed meat products and prepared meals, operating 12 production sites (10 in France) and present in eight additional countries; competes against other European packaged-food players on brand strength and French retail distribution. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLEURY-MICHON-110711919/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Société Holding de Contrôle et de Participations SAS (the founding-family holding vehicle) holds approximately 48.69%; the Gonnord family holds approximately 10.08% and the Magdelenat family approximately 6.14% directly, giving the founding families majority control. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLEURY-MICHON-110711919/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: High and controlling: the founding Gonnord/Magdelenat families together control roughly two-thirds of the company through the holding company and direct stakes, with Grégoire Gonnord serving as Chairman and multiple family members on the board. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FLEURY-MICHON-110711919/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No Fleury Michon-specific food-safety scandal, lawsuit or governance dispute was found in available search results (a separate 2025 listeria case involved an unrelated French cheese company, Chavegrand, not Fleury Michon).

thesis.business_description: Kras d.d. is a Croatian confectionery producer (founded 1911, based in Zagreb) making cocoa products, candy, waffles, biscuits and chocolate, sold under the Kraš brand across the Balkans.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading, long-established confectionery brand in Croatia and the wider Balkan region (2025 revenue ~HRK/EUR 194 million, ~1,597 employees); now fully controlled by meat processor Braća Pivac following a takeover. [Just Food](https://www.just-food.com/news/croatia-meat-group-braca-pivac-now-majority-owner-of-confectioner-kras/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Following a 2026 takeover, Pivac Holding and Kappa Star Ltd (owned by Serbian entrepreneur Nebojša Šaranović) jointly control approximately 97.15% of shares (MI Braća Pivac ~49.29%, Kappa Star ~28.01%, cumulatively with prior holdings); a squeeze-out of remaining minority shareholders (~2.85%) at EUR 130/share was initiated after crossing the 95% threshold. [Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/news/156491-pivac-moves-to-squeeze-out-kra-minorities-at-130-a-share/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is now concentrated with the Pivac family (via MI Braća Pivac) and Kappa Star Ltd as controlling shareholders, rather than company management; original founders are no longer the controlling party. [Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/news/156491-pivac-moves-to-squeeze-out-kra-minorities-at-130-a-share/)
thesis.red_flags: A squeeze-out of minority shareholders was executed at EUR 130/share after Pivac Holding and Kappa Star Ltd crossed the 95% ownership threshold under Croatian takeover law, meaning the stock is being delisted/taken private - a material consideration for any shortlist thesis given the company is being removed from public markets. [Dealroom](https://dealroom.co/news/156491-pivac-moves-to-squeeze-out-kra-minorities-at-130-a-share/)

thesis.business_description: PayPoint plc is a UK-based payments and commerce company operating across Shopping, E-Commerce, Payments and Banking, and Love2shop divisions, providing a range of payment acceptance, card processing, Open Banking, direct debit and cash-handling services to retailers, billers and consumers.
thesis.competitive_position: An established UK payments/commerce platform (MultiPay) with net revenue growth of 17.9% year-on-year in its most recent reported period, competing against payment specialists such as EVO Payments, Paymentus and larger players like Stripe; the company has historically held a strong position in UK prepayment/bill-payment services though this has drawn regulatory scrutiny (see red flags). [MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PAYPOINT-PLC-4004860/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Invermob Coruña SL holds approximately 32.15%; Inversis Gestión SGIIC holds approximately 8.2%; Santander Asset Management holds approximately 6.78%; Brown Capital Management holds approximately 5.42%; institutional investors comprise approximately 71.98% of the shareholder base overall. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PAYPOINT-PLC-120960517/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a significant founder/management stake in sources reviewed; the register is dominated by institutional/financial investors (notably Spain-linked Invermob Coruña SL) rather than company insiders.
thesis.red_flags: A UK Competition Appeal Tribunal found PayPoint had abused its dominant position in the pre-pay energy market (historical infringement on contracts that ceased in 2018), in a case brought by competitor Global 365/energy supplier Utilita; PayPoint largely defeated the GBP 172.2 million claim (awarded damages of only ~GBP 169,334 plus interest, over 99.8% reduction) but was ordered to pay roughly GBP 1.5 million toward the claimant's legal costs; separately, Ofgem's earlier investigation into PayPoint's prepayment-market conduct led the company to make voluntary commitments and a GBP 12.5 million donation to Ofgem's redress fund; the company was also separately sued by a fuel-poverty charity. [Global Competition Review](https://globalcompetitionreview.com/article/paypoint-damages-claim-cut-more-99)

thesis.business_description: PCC Exol S.A. is a Polish manufacturer of surfactants used in household chemicals, personal care, textiles, paper and metallurgical industries, headquartered in Brzeg Dolny, Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized Central European surfactants producer and one of only two PCC Group companies listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (alongside PCC Rokita), operating as part of the larger German PCC SE chemicals conglomerate. [PCC Group Structure](https://pcc.eu/en/company/group-structure/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Parent company PCC SE (a German holding company) holds approximately 87.09% of PCC Exol S.A.; the remainder is free float from its 2012 partial IPO. PCC SE's sole shareholder is reported to be Waldemar Preussner, chairman of PCC SE's supervisory board. [Wikipedia/PCC SE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PCC_SE)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ultimate insider control rests with Waldemar Preussner as sole shareholder of parent PCC SE, which in turn owns ~87% of PCC Exol; no separate PCC Exol management ownership stake was identified in sources reviewed. [Wikipedia/PCC SE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PCC_SE)
thesis.red_flags: High related-party concentration risk: ~87% parent ownership by PCC SE means minority (free-float) shareholders have limited influence over strategy and related-party transactions within the PCC Group; no specific litigation or fraud finding was identified in sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Spyrosoft S.A. is a Poland-based (Wrocław, founded 2016) software engineering company providing custom software development, cloud, embedded engineering, AI/ML, product design and technology-consulting services to clients in automotive, healthcare/life sciences, financial services, geospatial and other industries.
thesis.competitive_position: Spyrosoft is a fast-growing mid-sized Polish IT services/software-engineering company competing in the broader European nearshore-outsourcing and engineering-services market, differentiated by sector specialization (notably automotive and embedded systems) rather than being a generic staffing provider. [EMIS company profile](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/PL/Spyrosoft_SA_en_4370759.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: The company is majority-controlled by its founders: Konrad Weiske (~30.71%), Dorota Łekawa (~25.08%) and Wioletta Bodnarus (~24.98%), with remaining shares (~19.24%) held by others/free float. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SPYROSOFT-SP-LKA-AKCYJNA-123687631/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders Konrad Weiske, Dorota Łekawa and Wioletta Bodnarus collectively hold approximately 80.8% of shares, representing very high founder/insider ownership. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SPYROSOFT-SP-LKA-AKCYJNA-123687631/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Ökoworld AG is a German asset manager specializing in sustainable/ESG investment funds since 1975, also owning an insurance-brokerage business for pension schemes and an asset-advisory service for high-net-worth individuals (via its subsidiary versiko ASS).
thesis.competitive_position: Ökoworld is an asset-light fund distributor generating fee income from its own fund range, positioned as a pioneer in socially responsible investing (SRI); its non-voting preference shares trade on the Scale segment of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange ([Edison Group research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/profits-and-principles-a-pioneer-in-sri/18413/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: The Ökoworld Foundation (a charitable foundation) now holds the majority of voting ordinary shares (3.95 million ordinary shares, unlisted), after founders Klaus Odenthal and Angelika Grote and early shareholders transferred their shares to the foundation; non-voting preference shares (3.05 million) trade publicly ([Private Banking Magazin](https://www.private-banking-magazin.de/oekoworld-foundation-wird-mehrheitliche-stammaktionaerin-der-oekoworld/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders' shares were consolidated into the charitable Ökoworld Foundation, meaning future dividends on ordinary shares flow to charitable projects rather than to individual founders directly; founder Klaus Odenthal remains active on the supervisory board ([Private Banking Magazin](https://www.private-banking-magazin.de/oekoworld-foundation-wird-mehrheitliche-stammaktionaerin-der-oekoworld/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from sources reviewed; the foundation-based control structure is unusual but was a deliberate, disclosed restructuring rather than a governance concern.

thesis.business_description: Belgian company (incorporated 1996, headquartered in Zaventem) supplying electronic payment terminals, transaction processing software and related services (installation, support, tokenization via S-token, e-payment platform SET2U) mainly to small and mid-sized merchants.
thesis.competitive_position: A small, Belgium-focused payments provider (~52 employees, ~$23.5M trailing revenue) with 86% of sales domestic; niche player relative to larger pan-European payment processors, with revenue split across card transaction management (45.3%), terminals (41.1%) and software (13.6%).
thesis.main_shareholders: Major disclosed holders (via >5% transparency declarations) include Big Friend NV, Powergraph BV, Drupafina and Think Media NV; private companies hold ~64% of shares in aggregate, general public ~29% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/be/diversified-financials/ebr-keyw/keyware-technologies-shares/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders collectively hold a modest stake (~€1.0m of the ~€21m company) largely through private-company holding vehicles rather than direct individual ownership ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/be/diversified-financials/ebr-keyw/keyware-technologies-shares/ownership))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; small market cap (~€21m) and concentrated private-company ownership warrant governance attention.

thesis.business_description: LIMES Schlosskliniken AG is a German holding company (formerly GMF Capital AG) headquartered in Cologne that owns and manages six private clinics across Germany, Switzerland, Italy, and Liechtenstein specializing in psychiatry, psychotherapy, and psychosomatic medicine, with roughly 400 treatment places. [LIMES Schlosskliniken Annual Report 2024](https://www.limes-schlosskliniken.de/app/uploads/2025/05/Annual-Report-2024-LIMES-Schlosskliniken-1.pdf)
thesis.competitive_position: LIMES operates as a consolidator/operator of high-end private psychiatric and psychosomatic clinics ('Deluxe Mental Healthcare'), a specialized niche within German private healthcare; it has continued to expand via acquisitions such as a majority stake in Clinicum Alpinum. [Investec: LIMES Schlosskliniken Group takes over majority shareholding in Clinicum Alpinum](https://www.investec.com/advisory/deals/limes-schlosskliniken-group-takes-over-majority-shareholding-in-private-clinic-clinicum-alpinum/), [Deluxe Mental Healthcare overview](https://hrmt.substack.com/p/limes-schloss-clinics-lik)
thesis.main_shareholders: GMF Capital GmbH is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 75.6%-76.9% of LIMES Schlosskliniken AG (reported slightly differently across sources/dates); other holders include Chelverton Asset Management Ltd. (~3.14%) and Lupus alpha Asset Management AG (~2.08%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/LIMES-SCHLOSSKLINIKEN-AG-56049225/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling insider ownership runs through GMF Capital GmbH (~75-77%); a director's dealing disclosure shows GMF Capital GmbH sold a block of shares worth approximately €4.8 million outside the trading platform, which reduces but does not eliminate its controlling position. [EQS director dealing notice](https://www.eqs-news.com/news/directors-dealings/limes-schlosskliniken-ag-gmf-capital-gmbh-sell/3a08b096-7810-4b44-ab7d-9001292a5d00_en)
thesis.red_flags: A disclosed insider/controlling-shareholder sale by GMF Capital GmbH (~€4.8 million off-market) is worth noting as a reduction in founder/controlling-holder commitment, though it was a disclosed, routine directors'-dealings transaction rather than a scandal. No lawsuit, auditor issue, or delisting was identified. [EQS director dealing notice](https://www.eqs-news.com/news/directors-dealings/limes-schlosskliniken-ag-gmf-capital-gmbh-sell/3a08b096-7810-4b44-ab7d-9001292a5d00_en)

thesis.business_description: Hawesko Holding SE is a German wine, champagne and spirits trading group, operating through retail (Jacques' Wein-Depot, Wein & Co.), B2B wholesale (Wein Wolf, Grand Cru Select) and e-commerce (Hawesko, WirWinzer) segments.
thesis.competitive_position: Hawesko describes itself as one of Europe's leading wine merchants, with a multi-channel model spanning specialist retail stores, B2B wholesale distribution and e-commerce, plus subsidiaries abroad (e.g. an 80%-owned Czech operation, Global Wines & Spirits). The multi-brand, multi-channel structure gives it scale advantages in sourcing and logistics versus independent wine shops, though it faces competition from supermarket wine ranges and pure online retailers. [Hawesko Holding corporate info](https://eqs-news.com/company/hawesko-holding-se/info/5b75b6ff-ea7c-11e8-902f-2c44fd856d8c)
thesis.main_shareholders: Detlev Meyer controls the company through his wholly-owned holding vehicle Tocos Beteiligung GmbH, reported at roughly 72.7% of shares as of 31 December 2024 ([MarketScreener insider profile](https://ae.marketscreener.com/insider/DETLEV-MEYER-A0DAG8/)); free float is the remainder (~21-28% depending on the date of the snapshot) ([TradingView financials overview](https://se.tradingview.com/symbols/XETR-HAW/financials-overview)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is effectively Detlev Meyer's controlling stake via Tocos (~72-73%); he built this from an initial ~29.5% stake via a 2014-2015 takeover offer that ultimately crossed 75-79% of voting shares before settling near its current level ([Meininger/Börsen-Zeitung takeover coverage](https://www.meininger.de/wein/handel/hawesko-endgueltig-gekapert)).
thesis.red_flags: Historical (2014-2015) public governance dispute: then-CEO and major shareholder Alexander Margaritoff publicly accused incoming majority owner Detlev Meyer of disguising his real motive (control) behind a dividend-policy disagreement, and Margaritoff subsequently resigned and sold his stake; this is a decade-old conflict with no evidence of ongoing dispute found. [Börsen-Zeitung interview with Margaritoff](https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/herrn-meyers-verhalten-ist-nicht-freundlich)

thesis.business_description: CANCOM SE is a German IT infrastructure and services provider, founded in 1992 and headquartered in Munich, operating Cloud Solutions and IT Solutions segments (IT strategy, system integration, managed services) primarily in Germany and Austria.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading German/Austrian IT systems integrator and managed-services provider that has grown via acquisition (e.g., K-Businesscom AG, Austria's leading ICT provider with ~1,650 employees, expanding reach into Switzerland, Romania and the Czech Republic); competes with larger global IT service providers and regional integrators. [CANCOM company facts](https://www.cancom.de/en/company/cancom-se/about-cancom/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Free float is approximately 57.51%; Primepulse SE (the investment holding co-founded by CANCOM founder Klaus Weinmann) holds approximately 15.00%; other notable holders include K & K Stiftung (~6.49%), SEO Management AG (~5.04%), Allianz Global Investors (~4.98%), Union Investment (~4.87%), Goldman Sachs (~4.77%), BlackRock (~3.17%) and Johannes Mohn (~3.15%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/CANCOM-SE-435885/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: CANCOM co-founder Klaus Weinmann exercises significant influence through Primepulse SE's ~15% stake and, as of October 2023, his court-ordered appointment to and chairmanship of CANCOM's Supervisory Board, raising potential related-party/conflict-of-interest considerations given his continued operational role at Primepulse. [Stock3/Primepulse](https://primepulse.com/unternehmen/)
thesis.red_flags: CANCOM issued a profit warning shortly after having raised its own forecast, described in press commentary as an 'embarrassing' guidance reversal; additionally, founder Klaus Weinmann holds overlapping roles as CANCOM Supervisory Board Chairman and CEO of Primepulse SE (a ~15% CANCOM shareholder), which raises potential conflict-of-interest questions around capital allocation and related-party dealings. [Stock3](https://stock3.com/news/cancom-gruender-greift-erneut-bei-der-aktie-zu-12970591)

thesis.business_description: Intred S.p.A. is an Italian telecommunications provider based in Brescia that builds and operates proprietary fiber-optic broadband infrastructure (15,000+ km of network) for residential and business customers, primarily in Lombardy.
thesis.competitive_position: Intred has built a strong regional position with full ownership of its fiber network across Brescia, Milan and Bergamo provinces (45,000+ customers, over €160m in technology investment), giving it service-quality and response-time advantages versus resellers; however, its footprint is geographically concentrated in Lombardy (despite an OpenFiber partnership), limiting national scale versus larger Italian telecom operators, and it has been pursuing an uplisting to Euronext Milan to support further growth.
thesis.main_shareholders: DM Holding S.r.l. (controlled 67% by Daniele Peli and 33% by Marisa Prati) ~60.3-60.4%, Value First SICAF / First Sicaf S.p.A. ~9.4%, free float ~30.2-30.3% ([Borsa Italiana](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/azioni/profilo-societa-dettaglio.html?isin=IT0005337818&lang=en))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~60.3% held by founder/Chairman-CEO Daniele Peli and his wife Marisa Prati via DM Holding S.r.l.
thesis.red_flags: Geographic concentration risk: operations remain limited to Lombardy, which supports service quality locally but constrains addressable market versus national fiber operators; no accounting, litigation or regulatory red flags were identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: ChemoMetec A/S is a Danish developer, manufacturer and seller of analytical instruments (the NucleoCounter range) for quantitative cell counting and analysis, serving cell and gene therapy, cancer/stem cell research, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and animal semen/milk quality-control applications.
thesis.competitive_position: ChemoMetec holds a specialized niche in automated cell-counting instrumentation (Instruments, Consumables, and research-partnership segments), serving life-science, biopharma and agricultural end markets; scale is small relative to broad-based lab-instrument conglomerates, but its NucleoCounter platform has established recurring consumables revenue.
thesis.main_shareholders: BlackRock, Inc. (~14.2%), SEB Investment Management AB (~5.83%), The Vanguard Group, Inc. (~3.96%), Hans Glensbjerg (~3.67%) ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/kind-shareholders-own-chemometec-cph-040240651.html))
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold approximately 3.75% of the company, per Simply Wall St ownership data; institutions hold ~33% and the general public ~63.2%
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: Gesco SE is a German investment holding company, founded in 1989, that acquires and develops economically sound industrial small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) for the long term, organized in Process technology, Resource technology, and Healthcare/Infrastructure technology segments.
thesis.competitive_position: A long-standing, publicly listed (since 1998) German SME holding company that provides capital-markets access to owner-managed industrial businesses; ownership is broadly dispersed with no single controlling shareholder. [Gesco Annual Report 2025](https://gesco.de/fileadmin/static/pdfs/en/investor_relations/financial_reports/2025/2025-gesco-annual_report.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Investor Norman Rentrop holds approximately 14.5% and entrepreneur Stefan Heimöller holds approximately 14.2%; Baden-Württembergische Versorgungsanstalt für Ärzte, Zahnärzte und Tierärzte has reported crossing the 3% disclosure threshold; free float is approximately 66.8% across roughly 8,300 registered shareholders. [Gesco Shareholders](https://gesco.de/en/investor-relations/shares)
thesis.insider_ownership: No founder-family or management insider control was identified; the two largest holders (Rentrop and Heimöller) are described as outside investor/entrepreneur shareholders rather than company management, and the remainder is widely held. Not disclosed as a management-held stake in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Cinkarna Celje, d. d. is a Slovenian chemical processing company, operating for over 150 years, that produces and markets titanium dioxide pigment along with construction chemicals (sealants, facade plasters, mortars, waterproofing agents) and copper/sulfur fungicides.
thesis.competitive_position: A long-established, vertically diversified Slovenian chemicals producer that transitioned from metallurgy (pre-1968) to titanium dioxide pigment production (from 1973) and diversified further into construction chemicals and agrochemicals; among the most resilient companies in the Slovenian economy given its long operating history. [Cinkarna company profile](https://www.cinkarna.si/en/about-the-company)
thesis.main_shareholders: SDH d.d. (Slovenia's state-owned Slovenian Sovereign Holding) holds approximately 24.44%; Modra zavarovalnica d.d. (a Slovenian pension/insurance fund) holds approximately 20.17%; UniCredit Bank Austria AG (as nominee/FID) holds approximately 4.33%; TR5 d.o.o. holds approximately 4.2%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/CINKARNA-CELJE-D-D-11360089/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: No specific founder/management insider ownership was identified; the largest shareholders are the Slovenian state holding company (SDH) and an insurance/pension fund (Modra zavarovalnica) rather than company insiders. Not disclosed as a management stake in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: As a long-running titanium dioxide and chemicals producer, the company operates in an industry with inherent environmental/regulatory exposure (it references holding an integrated IPPC environmental permit), but no specific pollution lawsuit, litigation or governance dispute was identified in available search results. None identified from official sources reviewed.

thesis.business_description: Miquel y Costas & Miquel, S.A. is a Spain-based company, with roots dating to 1725, that produces fine and lightweight specialty papers, primarily for the tobacco (cigarette paper) industry, and is one of only four cigarette-paper manufacturers in the world. [Miquel y Costas Miquel S.A. - Encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/books/politics-and-business-magazines/miquel-y-costas-miquel-sa)
thesis.competitive_position: Miquel y Costas holds a globally scarce competitive position as one of only four manufacturers of cigarette paper worldwide, a niche with high barriers to entry given specialized know-how and long-standing customer relationships built over nearly 300 years of operating history. [Miquel y Costas corporate information](https://miquelycostas.com/en/corporate-information/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders include Jorge Mercader Miró (~18.17%), Indumenta Pueri SL (~14.65%), Bernadette Miquel Vacarisas (~12.36%), and Miquel María Del Carmen Escasany (~9.0%); descendants of the founding Miquel y Costas family remain prominent shareholders alongside Chairman Jorge Mercader Miró. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MIQUEL-Y-COSTAS-MIQUEL-S--74860/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider/family ownership remains significant: descendants of the founding Miquel family (including Bernadette Miquel Vacarisas and Miquel María Del Carmen Escasany) hold meaningful stakes, and Chairman Jorge Mercader Miró personally holds approximately 18.17%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MIQUEL-Y-COSTAS-MIQUEL-S--74860/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Renta Corporación Real Estate, S.A. is a Barcelona-based Spanish real estate company, founded in 1991, that acquires, refurbishes/rehabilitates and sells residential, office, retail, logistics and hotel properties in Barcelona, Madrid and internationally (Germany, UK).
thesis.competitive_position: Renta Corporación operates a value-add 'buy-refurbish-sell' real estate trading model rather than long-term holding, with a market cap of roughly $29.7m and trailing revenue of about $51.2m (2025); it recently brought in BC Partners as a 30% partner in its self-storage business, indicating a strategy of partnering with larger capital providers to scale niche real estate segments ([El Economista](https://www.eleconomista.es/vivienda-inmobiliario/noticias/13073774/11/24/bc-partners-toma-el-30-del-negocio-de-trasteros-de-renta-corporacion.html)).
thesis.main_shareholders: Luis Hernández de Cabanyes, founder and executive president/CEO (39.26%), Dinomen S.L. (10.82%), Blas Herrero Fernández (7.94%), Aurodoc 75 S.L. (6.28%) ([Yahoo Finanzas](https://es.finance.yahoo.com/quote/REN.MC/holders/))
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and CEO Luis Hernández de Cabanyes holds 39.26% of the company, making it founder-controlled ([Yahoo Finanzas](https://es.finance.yahoo.com/quote/REN.MC/holders/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; the company's opportunistic buy-refurbish-sell real estate trading model carries inherent cyclicality/market-timing risk versus buy-and-hold REITs, though no specific governance issue was found.

thesis.business_description: Jæren Sparebank is a Norwegian regional savings bank headquartered in Bryne, formed from the 2015 merger of Time Sparebank and Klepp Sparebank, serving personal, agricultural, and SME customers through branches in the Jæren region. [Jæren Sparebank - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A6ren_Sparebank)
thesis.competitive_position: Jæren Sparebank is a small local savings bank with a regional branch network in the Jæren area of Norway, structured as a Norwegian savings bank with equity certificates (a hybrid ownership form) rather than ordinary shares; by law equity-certificate holders can hold at most 40% of votes, which protects against takeover but also caps outside investor control. [About equity certificates](https://www.sparebank1.no/en/ostlandet/about-us/investor/equity-certificate/about-equity-certificates.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Major holders of Jæren Sparebank's equity certificates include Sparebankstiftinga Time og Hå (~50.92%), Sparebankstiftelsen Klepp (~12.27%), Eika Kapitalforvaltning AS (~8.45%), Oddvar Salte (~3.04%), and KLP Kapitalforvaltning AS (~2.23%). [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/JAEREN-SPAREBANK-1413187/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is dominated by two local savings-bank foundations (Sparebankstiftinga Time og Hå and Sparebankstiftelsen Klepp, together holding over 63%) rather than by bank management or individual insiders; one named individual holder, Oddvar Salte, holds approximately 3.04%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/JAEREN-SPAREBANK-1413187/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Nilörngruppen AB is a Sweden-based company that designs and manufactures garment labels and branding/identity solutions for fashion and apparel brands, with offices and manufacturing in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the UK, Portugal, Turkey, Hong Kong, and India. [Nilörn investors page](https://www.nilorn.com/investors/)
thesis.competitive_position: Nilörngruppen is a specialized global garment-label and brand-identity supplier serving fashion houses internationally, backed by private-equity-style parent AB Traction; it recently became the subject of a public takeover offer from Trimco Group, a larger global label/trim competitor, suggesting strategic consolidation interest in the sector. [Nilörngruppen board statement on Trimco Group takeover offer](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/04/3286410/0/en/Nil%C3%B6rngruppen-publishes-Board-statement-in-connection-with-public-takeover-offer-from-Trimco-Group.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: AB Traction is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 26.31% of share capital and about 58.08% of voting rights (as of Sept 30, 2025) via dual-class shares; AB Traction is itself a family-run investment vehicle, over 80% owned by the Stillström family. [Nilörn largest shareholder page](https://www.nilorn.com/investors/the-share/largest-shareholder/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider/controlling ownership is concentrated via AB Traction, led by CEO Petter Stillström, who also chairs Nilörngruppen's board; Traction holds 100% of Nilörn's A-shares, giving the Stillström family effective control despite a minority economic stake. Reflecting this conflict, Petter Stillström recused himself from the board's evaluation of the 2026 Trimco Group takeover offer. [GlobeNewswire: Nilörngruppen board statement](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/04/3286410/0/en/Nil%C3%B6rngruppen-publishes-Board-statement-in-connection-with-public-takeover-offer-from-Trimco-Group.html)
thesis.red_flags: A structural governance point: the Chairman (Petter Stillström) is simultaneously CEO of the controlling shareholder (AB Traction), creating an inherent related-party dynamic that required him to recuse himself from a 2026 takeover-offer evaluation; this is disclosed and managed via recusal rather than being a hidden conflict. No other lawsuit or scandal was identified. [Nilörngruppen board statement on Trimco Group offer](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/05/04/3286410/0/en/Nil%C3%B6rngruppen-publishes-Board-statement-in-connection-with-public-takeover-offer-from-Trimco-Group.html)

thesis.business_description: Sparebanken Møre is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Ålesund, providing retail and corporate banking, financing, and digital banking services, and is the largest independent bank for individuals and businesses in northwest Norway. [Sparebanken Møre official site](https://www.sbm.no/en/about-us/sparebanken-more/)
thesis.competitive_position: Sparebanken Møre is the leading independent regional savings bank in the Møre og Romsdal region of northwest Norway, structured with a dual ownership model (equity certificate holders plus the local community/ownerless capital) that protects it from takeover. [Sparebanken Møre equity certificates](https://www.sbm.no/en/about-us/Investor-relations/equity-certificates/About-equity-certificates/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Reported equity certificate holders include Sparebankstiftelsen Tingvoll (~9.72%), Eika Kapitalforvaltning AS (~8.25%), Borea Asset Management AS, KLP Kapitalforvaltning AS (~3.4%), and MP Pensjon PK (~3.36%); a portion of the bank's capital is also held as 'ownerless' community equity, structurally preventing full acquisition. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/SPAREBANKEN-MORE-38988597/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a specific management/board personal ownership percentage; ownership is dominated by institutional asset managers and a savings-bank foundation rather than named company insiders. Could not verify further.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Asseco South Eastern Europe S.A. is a Poland-based holding company providing IT consulting and software services across the Balkans, Turkey and Romania, operating as part of the broader Asseco Group federation of companies.
thesis.competitive_position: A regional IT services arm of the Asseco Group (a federation of listed and unlisted companies led by parent Asseco Poland, which does not seek 100% ownership of group members), giving it scale and cross-selling advantages across South-East Europe. [Outsiders' Corner](https://www.outsiderscorner.com/p/asseco-poland)
thesis.main_shareholders: Parent company Asseco Poland S.A. holds approximately 50.89%; PTE Allianz Polska SA holds approximately 16.85%. [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/equities/asseco-south-eastern-europe-ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Control is exercised through parent Asseco Poland's ~50.89% stake rather than direct founder/management ownership of ASEE itself; no separate significant management stake was identified. Not disclosed as a distinct insider stake in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: A Serbian governance/conflict-of-interest controversy was reported: Igor Brnabić, brother of former Serbian PM Ana Brnabić, served as a director of Asseco while Asseco's South-Eastern Europe unit held IT contracts with the Serbian government's IT office (headed by the PM), raising public conflict-of-interest questions that went unanswered by relevant institutions. [Serbian Monitor](https://www.serbianmonitor.com/en/the-asseco-affair-and-conflict-of-interest/)

thesis.business_description: ORBIS AG (Saarbrücken, Germany) is an IT consulting and software company specializing in SAP-based business solutions and implementation services for mid-sized and large enterprises.
thesis.competitive_position: ORBIS is a niche SAP implementation/consulting specialist rather than a scale software vendor; it has grown via partnerships (e.g., a 2021 strategic cooperation with Hörmann) rather than organic market dominance, positioning it as a smaller regional player in the crowded SAP consulting ecosystem. [ORBIS-Hörmann strategic cooperation announcement](https://orbis.de/en/investor-relations/ad-hoc-announcements/detail/strategic-collaboration-orbis-hoermann.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Hörmann Digital Beteiligungs GmbH became the controlling shareholder via a 2021 strategic cooperation and share purchases from GMV AG (the former largest shareholder) and other holders; a 2021 voting-rights notice shows Hörmann's direct stake around 34.7% with total voting rights (including instruments/options) near 50% ([ORBIS 2021 board report / GSC Research](https://gsc-research.de/media/2021-04-26_ORBIS.pdf)). Swoctem GmbH (linked to Friedhelm Loh) separately held about 15% of voting rights as of a 2014 disclosure ([ORBIS board report 2022](https://www.orbis.de/fileadmin/dateien/de/downloads/ir/HV/2022/Erlaeuternder_Bericht_des_Vorstands_der_ORBIS_SE_zu_den_Angaben_nach______289a_Abs__1_315a_Abs__1_HGB.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: GMV AG, whose only board members/voting shareholders are Thomas Gard and Stefan Mailänder, previously held 27% of ORBIS AG (2018) before selling down to about 15.36% (2021) as part of the Hörmann transaction ([ORBIS 2021 board report](https://gsc-research.de/media/2021-04-26_ORBIS.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: Hörmann's stake-building triggered a mandatory takeover offer process (expected around EUR 7.50/share per 2021 analyst commentary); no confirmed squeeze-out or delisting was found in current search results, but concentrated control by a single strategic investor (now near/above 50% with instruments) warrants monitoring for minority-shareholder dilution or a future squeeze-out. [GSC Research ORBIS analysis 2021](https://gsc-research.de/media/2021-04-26_ORBIS.pdf)

thesis.business_description: PCC Rokita SA is a Poland-based chemicals producer headquartered in Brzeg Dolny, operating primarily in polyols/polyurethane precursor chemicals and other specialty chemical products, and is described as one of the largest chemical companies in Poland and the largest in Lower Silesia. [PCC Rokita company profile](https://en.pcc.rokita.pl/about-company/)
thesis.competitive_position: PCC Rokita is a leading Polish chemicals producer, particularly in polyether polyols for polyurethane production, benefiting from being part of the larger PCC SE group's integrated chemicals/raw-materials/energy/logistics platform. [PCC SE group structure](https://pcc.eu/en/company/group-structure/)
thesis.main_shareholders: PCC SE (headquartered in Duisburg, Germany) is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 84.26% of PCC Rokita SA, with the remainder free-floated on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since a 2014 IPO of a minority stake. [PCC SE - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PCC_SE)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling insider ownership runs through PCC SE (~84.26%); PCC SE itself is reported to be majority-controlled by entrepreneur Waldemar Preussner, making him the ultimate controlling individual behind PCC Rokita, though a precise personal stake in Rokita itself was not separately confirmed. [MarketScreener](https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PCC-ROKITA-SA-16933446/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No specific minority-shareholder or related-party controversy was identified in the sources searched, though the ~84% controlling stake by parent PCC SE means related-party transactions with the broader PCC group are a structural factor minority investors should monitor. Could not verify further beyond general ownership structure.

thesis.business_description: Billington Holdings Plc is a UK structural steel and construction safety-solutions group, comprising Billington Structures, Peter Marshall Steel Stairs and Specialist Protective Coatings (structural steelwork) and Easi-Edge and Hoard-It (safety solutions).
thesis.competitive_position: One of the UK's leading structural steel and engineering groups, capable of handling projects exceeding 10,000 tonnes of steel; competes against market leader Severfield plc and private firm William Hare Group, differentiating on agility, technical complexity and secondary steelwork integration. FY2023 revenue grew 53% to GBP 132.5 million. [Rock and Turner](https://rockandturner.substack.com/p/billington-holdings)
thesis.main_shareholders: Top institutional holders include Miton Asset Management / Premier Miton UK Multi Cap Income (275,980 shares each, same holder), Providence Investment Partners (50,000 shares) and Diverse Income Trust (12,500 shares); precise percentage stakes were not confirmed from sources reviewed. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BILLINGTON-HOLDINGS-PLC-4001636/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed with a specific percentage in sources reviewed; Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP) awards to management were disclosed in company announcements, implying some management equity participation, but an exact insider ownership percentage could not be verified. [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/billington-holdings-announces-ltip-awards-to-align-strategic-goals)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Les Docks des Pétroles d'Ambès -SA is a France-based company (Bassens, near Bordeaux) specializing in the storage and transport/loading of petroleum products, including automotive fuels, diesel, and domestic/heavy fuel oil, with storage capacity of up to 270,000 m³, described as one of Europe's largest tank-truck loading facilities. [Le Journal des Entreprises: DPA refait le plein d'énergie](https://www.lejournaldesentreprises.com/article/docks-des-petroles-dambes-dpa-refait-le-plein-denergie-60729)
thesis.competitive_position: DPA holds a strategic, large-scale fuel storage/logistics position on the Gironde estuary, serving as shared infrastructure for major French/international oil companies (its shareholders include TotalEnergies and Esso), giving it a quasi-utility-like role in regional fuel distribution. [Les Docks Pétroles d'Ambès company profile](https://m.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DOCKS-PETROLES-D-AMBES-35053997/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Entrepôts Pétroliers Régionaux holds approximately 53.6% (52,445 shares); TotalEnergies SE holds about 12.4% (12,113 shares); Macquarie Strategic Storage Facilities Holdings SARL holds roughly 12.0% (11,701 shares); and Esso S.A.F. holds about 10.0% (9,780 shares). [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/energy/epa-dpam/les-docks-des-petroles-dambes-sa-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is dominated by large industrial/infrastructure shareholders (Entrepôts Pétroliers Régionaux, TotalEnergies, Macquarie Strategic Storage Facilities, Esso) rather than individual company insiders or a founder-family; President Ahmed Abzizi leads day-to-day management. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/energy/epa-dpam/les-docks-des-petroles-dambes-sa-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: DPA (then a Total subsidiary) was convicted and ordered to pay approximately €130,000 in damages to the municipality of Macau and three environmental associations following a January 2007 incident in which a crude oil storage tank collapsed and roughly 3,000 m³ of crude oil escaped into the Gironde estuary; this is a documented historical environmental/legal liability tied to the company. [Usine Nouvelle: Docks des pétroles d'Ambès condamnée pour pollution](https://www.usinenouvelle.com/article/docks-des-petroles-d-ambes-filiale-de-total-condamnee-pour-pollution.N890104)

thesis.business_description: ABC arbitrage SA is a France-based company that designs and operates arbitrage trading strategies and asset management services across European and American financial markets, exploiting price discrepancies between related financial instruments. [ABC arbitrage - Who we are](https://www.abc-arbitrage.com/who-we-are/)
thesis.competitive_position: ABC arbitrage is described by equity research as a specialist arbitrage trader and asset manager, a niche quantitative strategy business founded in 1995 by Dominique Ceolin (current CEO) and co-founder Xavier Chauderlot; it operates its own capital plus a regulated asset management arm (ABC arbitrage Asset Management), differentiating it from traditional long-only asset managers. [Edison Group: ABC arbitrage - A specialist arbitrage trader and asset manager](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/a-specialist-arbitrage-trader-and-asset-manager/32531/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders include Financière WDD (~11.95%), Aubépar Industries (~11.93%, linked to co-founder Xavier Chauderlot), David Hoey (~5.85%), Eximium (~5.06%), and CEO/co-founder Dominique Ceolin (~4.44%); other management holds a further ~6.23%, with free float around 54.26%. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ABC-ARBITRAGE-5094/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders and management retain meaningful ownership: CEO Dominique Ceolin holds roughly 4.44% personally, co-founder Xavier Chauderlot is linked to Aubépar Industries (~11.93%), and other management collectively hold about 6.23%, putting combined founder/management-linked ownership above 20%. [MarketScreener](https://in.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ABC-ARBITRAGE-5094/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No specific lawsuit or regulatory sanction was identified; the company combines CEO/Chairman roles, which it has disclosed and defended via governance counterweights per its own filings, a governance structure worth noting though not flagged as a violation by regulators in the sources found. Could not verify further beyond routine AMF disclosure filings.

thesis.business_description: Bulgarian commercial bank (founded 1996 in Sofia by the Bulgarian-American Enterprise Fund) providing banking products to individuals and corporates, with a business-bank focus on SME lending, agriculture, real estate/project finance, and renewable energy financing.
thesis.competitive_position: A specialized SME- and project-finance-focused business bank in Bulgaria (~$144M market cap, ~$62.1M trailing revenue) rather than a broad retail bank; origins as a USAID-backed enterprise fund give it a specific developmental-finance heritage distinct from universal Bulgarian banks.
thesis.main_shareholders: Siyesayev AD holds 61.43% as the major shareholder ([StockAnalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/bul/BACB/company/))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; high ownership concentration (61.43% single shareholder) limits free float and outside shareholder influence.

thesis.business_description: Altri, SGPS, S.A. is a Portuguese industrial group that manages eucalyptus forests and produces and sells wood/eucalyptus pulp (including kraft and bleached hardwood/eucalyptus pulp) through mills including Celbi, Celtejo, and Caima, with combined capacity of around 1.2 million tonnes/year, plus co-generation of renewable energy. [Altri - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Altri)
thesis.competitive_position: Altri is a major European eucalyptus pulp producer with scale advantages from owning its own forest/timber supply and multiple mills; it was spun out of the Cofina group's industrial assets and continues to expand (e.g., acquiring a controlling stake in green-fibre producer AeoniQ), though it faces resistance to expansion projects on environmental grounds. [Altri AeoniQ acquisition](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/altri-sgps-acquires-controlling-stake-113404898.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Reported major shareholders include Ana R. de C. Menéres de Mendonça (~17.54%), Caderno Azul-SGPS SA (~16.67%), Paulo Jorge dos Santos Fernandes (~13.63%), and Pedro Miguel Matos Borges de Oliveira (~12.35%); these holders are linked to the company's founding/controlling group originating from the Cofina spin-out. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ALTRI-SGPS-S-A-5808/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is concentrated among a small group of individual/family-linked holders tied to the company's founding structure (Menéres de Mendonça, Caderno Azul SGPS, Santos Fernandes, Matos Borges de Oliveira), collectively holding roughly 60% combined per the figures found, rather than being widely dispersed among unrelated institutions. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ALTRI-SGPS-S-A-5808/company/)
thesis.red_flags: Altri's planned new pulp mill in Galicia, Spain has drawn significant opposition from local communities and a coalition of 52 NGOs over environmental impact in an ecologically sensitive Natura 2000 area, and the project has sought roughly €250 million in EU NextGenerationEU funding, which has raised additional public scrutiny; separately, the company previously announced it terminated pulp deliveries to Russia following the 2022 invasion of Ukraine (a disclosed compliance action, not a red flag itself). [Altri's pulp mill in Galicia: a battle for the region's future](https://meta.eeb.org/2025/04/03/altris-pulp-mill-in-galicia-a-battle-for-the-future-of-the-region/)

thesis.business_description: Akwel SA (formerly MGI Coutier) is a French automotive equipment maker that designs, manufactures, and markets fluid-management and mechanisms components for vehicle manufacturers worldwide. [Akwel company profile](https://akwel-automotive.com/en/group/history/)
thesis.competitive_position: Akwel is a long-established, family-controlled Tier 1/2 automotive supplier operating internationally; it is a mid-sized niche component maker rather than a dominant global player, competing in a fragmented auto-parts supply market. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AKWEL-5052/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Coutier family controls approximately 69.7%-70% of the company's capital, via holding entities including Coutier Junior Company (~57.3%) and Coutier Senior Company (~12.2%). [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AKWEL-SA-158548708/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Second-generation family management (CEO Mathieu Coutier, with Benoît and Nicolas Coutier on the Management Board) continues the founding Coutier family's roughly 70% ownership and board control. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AKWEL-5052/company/)
thesis.red_flags: No specific minority-shareholder dispute or governance controversy was identified in sources searched; heavy family control (~70%) with multi-generational succession is a structural factor to note but no documented conflict was found. [Akwel 2023 annual report](https://akwel-automotive.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/AKWEL_Annual_report_2023.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Aktia Bank Plc (Aktia Pankki Oyj) is a Finland-based financial services group offering banking, asset management, insurance, and real estate agency services. [Aktia Bank - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aktia_Bank)
thesis.competitive_position: Aktia is a mid-sized Finnish bank with a diversified financial-services model (banking plus asset management and insurance), rooted in historical savings-bank/Åbo Akademi-linked ownership; no independent market-share data was found to size its competitive position versus larger Nordic banks. [Aktia shareholder information](https://www.aktia.com/en/investors/shareholder-information)
thesis.main_shareholders: Major shareholders include the Etola Family (~19.93%), the von Rettig Family (~10.08%), Veritas Pension Insurance Co. Ltd. (~8.23%), Stiftelsen för Åbo Akademi (~4.08%), the Hammarén Family (~3.14%), and Mandatum Henkivakuutusosakeyhtiö (~3.12%). [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AKTIA-PANKKI-OYJ-42765428/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Ownership is concentrated among legacy founding-era families (Etola, von Rettig, Hammarén families) rather than current executive management; these combined family stakes total roughly a third of the company. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/AKTIA-PANKKI-OYJ-42765428/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Papoutsanis S.A., founded in 1870 and based near Athens (Kifissia/Halkida production), manufactures and sells soaps and liquid cosmetics (bar soaps, shower gels, shampoos, hotel amenities, specialty soap bases such as noodles and syndets) under brands including Olivia, Aromatics, Natura and Karavaki Hotel Amenities.
thesis.competitive_position: Papoutsanis describes itself as a leading Greek soap manufacturer and one of the largest producers of bar soap and hotel amenities products in Europe, exporting to Europe, the US, Asia and Oceania. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/PAP.AT/profile/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Reported major shareholders (5%+ voting rights) include Menelaos Tasopoulos (~23.4-23.75%), Georgios Gatzaros (~22.4-23.1%), Truad Verwaltungs AG/Truad Administration Ltd (~21.3%), and 3K Investment Partners (~6.2%). [Athens Times](https://athens-times.com/papoutsanis-at-23-23-the-percentage-of-menelaos-tasopoulos/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Combined, co-founders/principal individual shareholders Menelaos Tasopoulos and Georgios Gatzaros hold roughly 45-47% of the company between them, indicating high founder/insider concentration. [Athens Times](https://athens-times.com/papoutsanis-at-23-23-the-percentage-of-menelaos-tasopoulos/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: cBrain A/S is a Danish software company providing the F2 digital platform, a commercial off-the-shelf case- and document-management system used by government ministries, agencies and municipalities for workflow, compliance, FOI/records management and (more recently) AI-assisted case handling.
thesis.competitive_position: cBrain's F2 platform is used by more than 75 Danish government bodies including 21 of Denmark's ministries, giving it a dominant, deeply entrenched position in the Danish central-government case-management market; it has also expanded F2 to over a dozen other countries (including France, Germany, the UK, the US, the UAE and several African nations), positioning it as a scalable COTS alternative to costly bespoke government IT systems. [cBrain company profile - stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/cph/CBRAIN/company/); [Investseekers - cBrain: A Scalable Software Play for the Public Sector](https://www.investseekers.com/post/cbrain-a-scalable-software-play-for-the-public-sector).
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and CEO Per Tejs Knudsen is the dominant shareholder, holding approximately 41.7% of shares (~8.34 million shares); other holders include CTO Thomas Qvist (~3.58%), ODIN Forvaltning AS (~3%) and Nordea Investment Management AB (~1.9%). The company has approximately 14,200 shareholders across 40 countries. [cBrain - Ownership (official)](https://www.cbrain.com/investor/ownership).
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is very high and founder-concentrated: CEO/founder Per Tejs Knudsen controls approximately 41.7% of the company and CTO Thomas Qvist holds approximately 3.58%, together representing roughly 45% of shares held by two senior executives. [cBrain - Ownership (official)](https://www.cbrain.com/investor/ownership); [theorg.com - Per Tejs Knudsen, CEO/Founder](https://theorg.com/org/cbrain/org-chart/per-tejs-knudsen).
thesis.red_flags: No major controversy identified. Routine insider share sales by CEO Per Tejs Knudsen (e.g., a sale of 192,730 shares, ~0.96% of market cap, reported April 2024) and an earlier combined sale of a 4.2% stake by Knudsen and Qvist to institutional investors were found, but these were disclosed PDMR transactions rather than signs of distress or governance failure. None identified from official sources beyond routine, disclosed insider trading. [cBrain - PDMR transaction report](https://www.cbrain.com/post/reporting-of-executive-employees-trading-in-cbrain-shares).

thesis.business_description: Dekpol S.A. is a Polish construction and development group based in Pinczyn, providing general-contracting services for industrial, sports and environmental-protection facilities plus road, sanitary and hydro-technical works, manufacturing buckets/attachments for construction machinery, and developing residential and commercial real estate mainly in northern Poland.
thesis.competitive_position: Dekpol combines general contracting with its own residential/commercial development arm and a machinery-attachments manufacturing business, giving it diversified revenue streams versus pure-play developers or contractors in the Tri-City/northern Poland market ([Dekpol](https://dekpol.pl)).
thesis.main_shareholders: OMT Family Foundation, controlled by founder Mariusz Tuchlin (77.33% of votes via 6,466,845 shares), Familiar S.A. SICAV-SIF (8.13%) ([BiznesRadar](https://www.biznesradar.pl/akcjonariat/DEKPOL))
