Mutares publicly disputed the allegations, attributing the cash discrepancy to a transcription error, and the Supervisory Board subsequently extended CEO Robin Laik's contract. [Bloomberg](https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/international/2024/09/26/german-investment-firm-mutares-targeted-by-short-seller-gotham/)

thesis.business_description: Eurosnack S.A. is a Polish food processing company producing salty snacks (potato and gluten-free corn chips) and traditional sponge-cake cookies under brands including Chrupcie, Lajkonik, Hip Chrup and Salaterki, plus private-label production for retailers.
thesis.competitive_position: A small-cap Polish snack manufacturer with two production facilities (Dobczyce and Chorzów) and 284 employees, supplying private-label contracts to major retail chains (Jerónimo Martins, Dino, Tesco, Carrefour, Polomarket) alongside its own brands, competing in a market with larger players such as Intersnack. [Eurosnack About Us](https://eurosnack.pl/en/about-us/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Insiders hold a significant proportion of shares (reported at roughly zł2.3m in value); institutions own about 14% and the general public holds about 12%, implying a majority insider/founder-linked stake, though an exact consolidated percentage was not confirmed in filings reviewed. [Yahoo Finance/Simply Wall St](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/type-shareholder-owns-eurosnack-wse-135731641.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insiders (including board members such as Chairman Marcin Kłopociński and co-CEOs Mirosław Właźlo and Andrzej Krakówka) are reported to hold a significant stake in value terms, but an exact consolidated percentage could not be verified from the sources reviewed. Not fully disclosed in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: MHP SE is a Ukraine-based, vertically integrated food and agribusiness group and the largest poultry producer in Europe, controlling the chain from crop growing and feed, through chicken hatching, raising, and processing, to meat distribution and retail. [PrJSC MHP - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PrJSC_MHP)
thesis.competitive_position: MHP is described as Europe's largest poultry producer and 8th largest globally, with a fully vertically-integrated model spanning feed production through retail that supports cost efficiency and export capability, including EU market access. [MHP overview](https://eba.com.ua/en/member/mhp/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder, CEO and majority shareholder Yuriy Kosyuk controls MHP through 100% ownership of WTI Trading Limited, which holds more than 60% of MHP's shares; more specifically Kosyuk directly/indirectly owns approximately 61.78% of the company. [Yuriy Kosiuk - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yuriy_Kosiuk)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/CEO Yuriy Kosyuk is the dominant insider owner, with an approximately 61.78% stake held via WTI Trading Limited. [Yuriy Kosiuk - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yuriy_Kosiuk)
thesis.red_flags: MHP carries material leverage/refinancing risk: net debt rose to about $1.53 billion as of Sept 30, 2025 (from $1.18 billion at start of year), and the company is preparing a new ~$1 billion bond issuance to refinance a $550 million eurobond maturing in April 2026; it also operates in a war-affected jurisdiction (Ukraine), which is a material operating risk though not a governance red flag per se. [MHP bond refinancing plans](https://inventure.com.ua/en/news/ukraine/mhp-prepares-a-bond-issue-of-up-to-dollar1-billion-to-refinance-dollar550-million-of-debt-in-2026)

thesis.business_description: North Media A/S is a Danish company operating three business areas: North Media Online (digital marketplaces boligportal.dk for rental housing and ofir.dk for jobs), BEKEY (digital access/entry systems), and FK Distribution (distribution of printed retail offers/local newspapers and the digital offer platform minetilbud.dk). [North Media official site](https://www.northmedia.dk/en/)
thesis.competitive_position: North Media holds leading positions in Danish niche volume-distribution businesses -- FK Distribution is a long-established large-scale print/offer distributor, while its digital marketplaces (boligportal.dk, ofir.dk) and BEKEY access-tech unit represent diversification into scalable digital platforms; no independent market-share figures were found to size these positions precisely. [North Media business overview](https://www.northmedia.dk/en/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Baunegård ApS, linked to the Bunck family, holds approximately 56.56% of share capital; North Media A/S itself holds about 10.40% of its own shares (treasury). [North Media ownership page](https://www.northmedia.dk/en/investor-relations-en/ownership/)
thesis.insider_ownership: The company's founding family is the controlling insider: Richard Bunck, the main shareholder (via Baunegård ApS, ~56.56%), serves as Vice Chairman of the Board, alongside Chairman Lasse Ingemann Brodt. [North Media ownership page](https://www.northmedia.dk/en/investor-relations-en/ownership/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: RheinLand Holding AG (Neuss, Germany) is the parent of the RheinLand insurance group, a composite/life insurer offering life, accident, liability, motor, fire/home and reinsurance products through subsidiaries including Rheinland Versicherungs AG, Rhion Versicherung AG and Credit Life AG.
thesis.competitive_position: RheinLand is a small, family-controlled German composite insurer (market cap roughly EUR 123m, ~941 employees per 2024 data) operating as a niche/regional player rather than a scale national insurer; it has been majority-owned by its founding families for four generations since the group's 1880 origins. [Simply Wall St company snapshot](https://simplywall.st/stock/duse/rlv)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Werhahn family (and, per one profile, the Körfgen family) controls the company through a holding vehicle; a stock-market profile lists a securities-holding entity linked to the Werhahn name at approximately 50% with the remaining ~50% in free float ([boerse.de company profile](https://www.boerse.de/unternehmensprofil/RHEINLAND-HOLDING-AG-Aktie/DE0008415100)). Anton Werhahn is listed as chairman of the supervisory board ([boerse.de](https://www.boerse.de/unternehmensprofil/RHEINLAND-HOLDING-AG-Aktie/DE0008415100)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Described by one industry profile as majority-owned by descendants of the 1880 founders, now in the fourth generation; exact individual management/board percentages were not found and should be verified against the annual report. Not independently confirmed beyond the ~50% family-holding-entity figure cited above.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: Leifheit Aktiengesellschaft is a German household products manufacturer, producing cleaning and home-organization products (Leifheit brand), wellbeing/personal-scale products (Soehnle brand) and private-label goods (Birambeau, Herby brands), sold across Germany, Central/Eastern Europe and internationally.
thesis.competitive_position: Leifheit is an established mid-cap German household-goods brand (listed on the Frankfurt Prime Standard since 1984) competing against larger players like Freudenberg's Vileda brand in mechanical cleaning products; it has historically been majority-controlled by a founding-family holding structure. [Börsen-Zeitung interview with Leifheit CEO](https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/wir-besitzen-eine-hohe-resilienz-gegen-externe-schocks)
thesis.main_shareholders: Historically (2010-2011 GSC Research analyst notes) the controlling holder was HOME Beteiligungen GmbH at approximately 47.3%, followed by MKV Verwaltungs GmbH (~10.0%) and Joachim Loh personally (~6.6%), with treasury shares (~5%) and free float (~31%) making up the rest ([GSC Research, 2010-2011](https://gsc-research.de/media/2010-11-15_LEIFHEIT.pdf)); these figures are over a decade old and a current breakdown was not found in this search - only 61.73% of share capital was represented at the 2024 AGM, which is consistent with a continued large anchor shareholder but should be verified via Leifheit's current voting-rights notifications.
thesis.insider_ownership: Joachim Loh (associated with the Loh/HOME Beteiligungen holding structure) was reported as a direct holder of ~6.6% in 2010-2011 filings, alongside the larger HOME Beteiligungen GmbH stake (~47%); current individual insider holdings were not confirmed in this search and should be checked against recent Bundesanzeiger/EQS voting-rights notices. Not independently confirmed for the present day.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Kri-Kri Milk Industry S.A. is a Greek dairy company (based in Serres) producing and distributing yogurt, milk and ice cream, with the Dairy/Yogurt segment as its larger revenue contributor and significant exports (~42 countries).
thesis.competitive_position: Kri-Kri is a leading Greek yogurt and ice cream producer: it has grown its branded yogurt market share from 12% (2016) to about 17.1%, produces over 95% of Greece's private-label yogurt, and holds roughly #2 position in Greek ice cream by volume - giving it meaningful scale advantages in a market with significant private-label manufacturing contracts. [OT.gr profile of Panagiotis Tsinavos](https://www.ot.gr/2022/12/15/english-edition/panagiotis-tsinavos-the-new-king-of-greek-yogurt-from-serres/)
thesis.main_shareholders: CEO Panagiotis Tsinavos (son of founder George/Giorgos Tsinavos, who started the business as a pastry/ice-cream shop in Serres) is the largest individual holder, reported at approximately 25.2% (~8.3 million shares) per aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/food-beverage-tobacco/lse-0qg6/kri-kri-milk-industry-shares/ownership)); institutional holders include 3K Investment Partners (~2.15%) and PEH Wertpapier AG (~1.85%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/food-beverage-tobacco/lse-0qg6/kri-kri-milk-industry-shares/ownership)). The company held 47,581 treasury shares (0.144% of total) as of a July 2024 announcement ([Athens Exchange/Euronext notices](https://athens.euronext.com/en/node/706841)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Panagiotis Tsinavos, CEO and son of the founder, personally holds ~25.2% and has led the listed company for roughly three decades (since 1994), making this a founder-family-controlled business (though not majority-controlled on paper) ([Naftemporiki profile](https://naftemporiki.gr/english/1743917/tsinavos-a-yogurt-worth-400-million-euros); [OT.gr](https://www.ot.gr/2022/12/15/english-edition/panagiotis-tsinavos-the-new-king-of-greek-yogurt-from-serres/)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

name: HSBC Bank Malta p.l.c.
gmSourceUrl: [HSBC Bank Malta Investor Relations](https://www.about.hsbc.com.mt/investor-relations), [2025 Annual Report](https://www.hsbc.com/-/files/hsbc/investors/hsbc-results/2025/annual/pdfs/hsbc-bank-malta-plc/260225-hbmt-annual-report-and-accounts-2025.pdf), [2024 Annual Report](https://www.hsbc.com/-/files/hsbc/investors/hsbc-results/2024/annual/pdfs/hsbc-bank-malta-plc/250219-hbmt-annual-report-and-accounts-2024.pdf), [2023 Annual Report](https://www.about.hsbc.com.mt/-/media/malta/en/investor-relations/financial-statements/240328-hbmt-annual-report-and-accounts-2023.pdf)

thesis.business_description: HSBC Bank Malta p.l.c. is a Malta-based retail, commercial and private banking institution, part of the global HSBC Group, offering deposit, lending, wealth-management and corporate banking services in Malta.
thesis.competitive_position: HSBC Bank Malta is one of Malta's largest banks by balance sheet, benefiting from its global HSBC brand and parent-group backing, though its ultimate parent (HSBC Holdings) is actively reviewing an exit from the Maltese market, which creates strategic uncertainty for the subsidiary's positioning. [AJ Bell - HSBC exclusive talks for sale of Malta stake](https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/brief-hsbc-enters-exclusive-talks-sale-malta-branch-stake)
thesis.main_shareholders: HSBC Continental Europe holds a direct 70.0295% shareholding (252,320,580 voting rights), transferred from HSBC Europe B.V. in November 2022 as part of an internal HSBC Group restructuring designating HSBC Continental Europe as the EU intermediate parent; ultimate control rests with HSBC Holdings plc ([HSBC Malta announcement, Nov 2022](https://www.about.hsbc.com.mt/-/media/malta/en/news-and-media/2022/221130-hsbc-malta-direct-shareholding-transferred-to-hsbc-continental-europe.pdf)). Minor institutional holders include HSBC Global Asset Management (UK) Ltd (~0.84%) and Bank of Valletta's asset-management arm (~0.29%) per aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/mt/banks/mtse-hsb/hsbc-bank-malta-shares/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed/found; no local management or board insider stake was identified in search results. Not disclosed in public filings found.
thesis.red_flags: Pending M&A / ownership uncertainty: HSBC Holdings announced in September 2024 a strategic review of its ~70% stake in HSBC Bank Malta; HSBC Continental Europe subsequently entered exclusive talks with CrediaBank SA (formerly Attica Bank) for a possible sale of the majority stake, with APS Bank also having submitted a competing non-binding offer; the outcome (and required MFSA/Bank of Greece/ECB regulatory approvals) was still pending as of the most recent sources found. [Malta Business Weekly - HSBC strategic review](https://maltabusinessweekly.com/hsbc-undertaking-strategic-review-of-its-shareholding-in-malta-will-consider-range-of-options/26940/) / [Malta Today - APS Bank competing offer](https://www.maltatoday.com.mt/business/business_news/132507/aps_bank_submits_undisclosed_nonbinding_offer_to_acquire_hsbc_bank_malta)

thesis.business_description: IMC S.A. (formerly Industrial Milk Company S.A.) is an integrated Ukrainian agricultural holding engaged in crop farming (corn, wheat, sunflower, soybeans), dairy farming, and grain storage/elevator and logistics operations, ranked among Ukraine's top-10 agricultural producers.
thesis.competitive_position: IMC farms roughly 120,000-137,000 hectares across the Poltava, Chernihiv and Sumy regions of northern/central Ukraine and operates its own elevator/storage network (~554,000 tonnes of capacity), giving it scale advantages in logistics and cost efficiency versus smaller Ukrainian producers, though the business remains exposed to war-related operational and land-access risk. [IMC - Who we are](https://www.imcagro.com.ua/en/about-company/who-we-are); [stockanalysis.com - IMC company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IMC/company/).
thesis.main_shareholders: Agrovalley Ltd. (a Cyprus-registered holding entity) is the controlling shareholder with approximately 76.14% of shares; CEO/Chairman Alex Lissitsa separately holds approximately 5.56% in his own name; free float is reported at roughly 18.3%. [MarketScreener - IMC S.A. shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/IMC-S-A-10514789/company-shareholders/).
thesis.insider_ownership: Alex Lissitsa, IMC's CEO since 2013 and Board Chairman since July 2024, holds approximately 5.56% of shares directly; it was not possible to independently verify whether Lissitsa or other managers also hold beneficial interests in Agrovalley Ltd. itself, so total insider economic exposure could be understated. [MarketScreener - IMC S.A. shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/IMC-S-A-10514789/company-shareholders/); [Alex Lissitsa - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alex_Lissitsa).
thesis.red_flags: Primary risk is the ongoing war in Ukraine: in 2022 the company swung to a net loss of $1.1 million (from $78.7 million net profit in 2021) as revenue fell 37.3% to $114 million, with a significant share of farmland located in regions close to the conflict. No fraud, auditor dispute, or related-party governance controversy was identified in available sources, but the structural war/occupied-land risk and the very high (76%) single-shareholder concentration (Agrovalley Ltd.) are notable risk factors for minority holders. [Interfax - IMC corn harvest 2023](https://interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/99151/); [stockanalysis.com - IMC company profile](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/wse/IMC/company/).

thesis.business_description: Allane SE (formerly Sixt Leasing SE) is a Germany-based multi-brand mobility solutions provider based in Garching near Munich, operating in Online Retail, Fleet Leasing, Captive Leasing, and Fleet Management segments. [Allane Mobility Group about us](https://allane-mobility-group.com/en/aboutus)
thesis.competitive_position: Allane is an established German vehicle leasing and fleet-management/online car-retail group, having rebranded from Sixt Leasing after its change of control; it benefits from backing by its strategic majority shareholder's international auto-finance expertise (Hyundai Capital/Santander Consumer Bank joint venture) following the end of the Sixt family's five-decade ownership. [Allane SE company overview](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allane)
thesis.main_shareholders: Hyundai Capital Bank Europe GmbH (HCBE), a joint venture between Santander Consumer Bank AG and Hyundai Capital Services Inc., holds a strategic majority stake of approximately 92% of Allane SE's share capital, following a 2020 takeover from Sixt SE. [Allane SE public takeover offer page](https://ir.allane-mobility-group.com/websites/allane/English/3650/public-takeover-offer-by-hyundai-capital-bank-europe-gmbh.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: The company is now majority-controlled by an external strategic/financial-sponsor shareholder (Hyundai Capital Bank Europe, ~92%) rather than by individual management or founder insiders; the prior long-term controlling family (Sixt) exited in 2020. [Allane SE / Sixt Leasing company history](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allane)
thesis.red_flags: With HCBE holding roughly 92% of shares, free float and minority liquidity are very limited, which is a structural factor (not fraud) that new investors should weigh; no lawsuit or governance scandal was identified in the sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Séché Environnement SA is a French waste management and environmental services company providing hazardous and non-hazardous waste treatment, recycling, and site remediation/decontamination services.
thesis.competitive_position: Séché Environnement is one of France's leading independent waste-treatment specialists, particularly in hazardous waste treatment where it holds specialized permitted facilities that create regulatory barriers to entry versus new competitors; it remains tightly family-controlled rather than widely held. [Businesswire - Groupe Séché share purchase disclosure](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20210407005835/en/Exercise-of-the-Second-Unilateral-Promise-to-Sell-S%C3%A9ch%C3%A9-Environnement-Shares)
thesis.main_shareholders: Groupe Séché SAS, the family holding company, is the reference shareholder: directly and via its subsidiary Pégase-53 (60% owned by Groupe Séché, 40% by Unexo, a Crédit Agricole Group investment fund) it held 69.03% of share capital and 78.33% of voting rights as of April 2021, after exercising a purchase right over shares previously held by ICM SA ([Businesswire, April 2021](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20210407005835/en/Exercise-of-the-Second-Unilateral-Promise-to-Sell-S%C3%A9ch%C3%A9-Environnement-Shares)); this was up from 59.04% of capital / 71.34% of votes in mid-2020 ([Businesswire, Sept 2020](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20200923005827/en/Signature-of-Unilateral-Promises-to-Sell-Sch-Environnement-Shares-for-the-Benefit-of-Groupe-Sch-SAS)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/Chairman-CEO Joël Séché transferred his direct shares into Groupe Séché in November 2018 and, in December 2018, gave bare ownership of Groupe Séché to his two sons, Guillaume and Maxime Séché, explicitly to secure long-term family control of Séché Environnement, with the AMF granting exemptions for these intra-family transfers ([Businesswire/AMF filings, 2018-2021](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20210407005835/en/Exercise-of-the-Second-Unilateral-Promise-to-Sell-S%C3%A9ch%C3%A9-Environnement-Shares)). Aggregator data (Simply Wall St, last updated ~2024) separately lists Joël Séché as personally holding ~62.3%, though this likely reflects the pre-2021 figure and should not be treated as current.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; family control is very high (approaching 70-78% of capital/votes), which concentrates governance power and reduces minority-shareholder influence, though no litigation or related-party controversy was found.

thesis.business_description: TCM Group A/S is a Danish manufacturer of kitchens and furniture for bathrooms and storage, operating the Svane Køkkenet, Tvis Køkkener and Nettoline brands.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading Danish kitchen-furniture manufacturer and retailer that transitioned from private-equity ownership to a Nasdaq Copenhagen listing in 2017; has been growing via acquisition of retail stores, though recently absorbing integration/turnaround costs on newly acquired, previously unprofitable outlets. [IK Partners](https://ikpartners.com/investments/tcm-group/)
thesis.main_shareholders: As of year-end 2024, major holders exceeding 5% included Paradigm Capital Value Fund (15.8%), Paradigm Capital Value LP (12.1%), BI Asset Management Fondsmæglerselskab (10.8%), and Arbejdsmarkedets Tillægspension/ATP (10.3%); no single controlling shareholder remains since the 2017 IPO ended IK Investment Partners' prior majority stake. [TCM Group major shareholder announcement](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/08/01/3125631/0/en/TCM-Group-A-S-Major-shareholder-announcement.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in public filings as a distinct founder/management stake beyond the institutional holders above; ownership is now broadly institutional/public following the 2017 IPO rather than concentrated in management.
thesis.red_flags: Recent leadership turnover: CFO Thomas Hjannung stepped down and Jens-Peter Poulsen was appointed new CEO effective August 2026; rising selling/admin costs from integrating newly acquired, previously unprofitable retail stores pressured margins in Q3 2025. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/TCM-GROUP-A-S-38838935/company-governance/)

thesis.business_description: Alexanderwerk Aktiengesellschaft is a Germany-based (Remscheid) manufacturer of high-technology compaction and granulation machines for the chemical, food, life science, nuclear, and pharmaceutical industries, founded in 1885 and listed since 1899. [Alexanderwerk company history](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexanderwerk)
thesis.competitive_position: Alexanderwerk is a long-established, specialized niche equipment maker (compacting/granulating machines) serving industrial and pharmaceutical processing customers; it is a small-cap company (around 178 employees) with limited independent market-share data available to size its competitive position precisely. [MarketScreener company profile](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ALEXANDERWERK-AG-35053408/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Reported major shareholders include Dr. Schmitt Vermögensverwaltungsgesellschaft mbH (~25.53%) and RECAY GmbH (~20.04%), with free float at roughly 25.52%. [Onvista Alexanderwerk shareholder data](https://www.onvista.de/aktien/unternehmensprofil/ALEXANDERWERK-AG-Aktie-DE000A37FTW0)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a specific named-individual management/founder percentage in the sources found; the largest holders (Dr. Schmitt Vermögensverwaltungsgesellschaft mbH, RECAY GmbH) appear to be investment-holding entities rather than clearly identified operating management. Could not verify further.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Fabryki Mebli FORTE S.A. is a Polish furniture manufacturer (founded 1992, headquartered in Ostrów Mazowiecka) and one of Europe's leading producers of ready-to-assemble (RTA) furniture.
thesis.competitive_position: A leading European RTA/flat-pack furniture manufacturer with scale production in Poland, supplying furniture retailers across Europe; specific market-share figures were not confirmed in sources reviewed. [Forte company profile](https://company.forte.com.pl/en/investor-relations/company-authorities/)
thesis.main_shareholders: MAFORM HOLDING AG (the founder's holding vehicle) holds approximately 43.23% of total votes (55.75% of votes at the EGM referenced); Otwarty Fundusz Emerytalny (an open pension fund) holds approximately 14.43% of total votes; other institutional holders include AgioFunds TFI, Pekao TFI and Goldman Sachs TFI with smaller stakes. [MoneyController](https://www.moneycontroller.co.uk/finance-news/fabryki-mebli-forte-sa/list-of-shareholders-holding-at-least-5-of-votes-at-the-extraordinary-general-meeting-of-fabryki-mebli-forte-s-a-1879085)
thesis.insider_ownership: High founder ownership: founder Maciej Formanowicz controls the company through MAFORM HOLDING AG (~43% of total votes); Formanowicz served as President of the Management Board from 1993 until stepping down on 31 August 2023 (succeeded by CEO Maria Małgorzata Florczuk) while remaining Chairman of the Board. [Crunchbase/MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/FABRYKI-MEBLI-FORTE-S-A-6493904/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results; a 2020 EU trademark dispute (Fabryki Mebli 'Forte' v EUIPO) appears to be a routine IP/trademark registration matter rather than a governance or fraud concern.

thesis.business_description: Wulff Group Plc (Wulff-Yhtiöt Oyj) is a Finnish company selling workplace/office products and supplies, with additional staffing-services and accounting-firm business lines, operating in Finland, Sweden, Norway and Denmark.
thesis.competitive_position: Wulff is a small-cap Nordic workplace-products distributor (2025 net sales EUR 122.3 million) founded in 1890 and listed since 2000; it is tightly insider/founder-family controlled rather than institutionally dominated. [Wulff Group 2026 shareholder notification](https://www.inderes.dk/en/releases/wulff-group-plc-notification-according-to-chapter-9-section-10-of-the-securities-market-act)
thesis.main_shareholders: Heikki Vienola is the largest shareholder at approximately 37.3% (~2.53 million shares) per aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/retail/hel-wuf1v/wulff-yhtiot-oyj-shares/ownership)); institutional holders include LähiTapiola (~6%), Eläke-Fennia (~5%), Nordea Investment Management (~4.7%) and SEB (~3.7%) per the same source. Laine Capital Oy (controlled by Timo Laine) crossed the 5% threshold in June 2026, reaching 350,272 shares (5.07% of shares and votes) ([Wulff Group shareholder notification, June 2026](https://www.inderes.dk/en/releases/wulff-group-plc-notification-according-to-chapter-9-section-10-of-the-securities-market-act)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Individual insiders hold roughly 54% of the company in aggregate per aggregator data, dominated by Heikki Vienola's ~37.3% stake ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/retail/hel-wuf1v/wulff-yhtiot-oyj-shares/ownership)); the company has a single share class (one share, one vote), with 6,907,628 total shares outstanding ([Wulff Group shareholder notification, June 2026](https://www.inderes.dk/en/releases/wulff-group-plc-notification-according-to-chapter-9-section-10-of-the-securities-market-act)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Infas Holding AG (formerly Action Press Holding AG) is a Germany-based social and market research company, headquartered in Bonn, conducting qualitative and quantitative surveys and analyses (face-to-face and telephone) across fields such as transport and health. [Infas Holding MarketScreener profile](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/INFAS-HOLDING-AG-436213/company/)
thesis.competitive_position: Infas was described by acquirer Ipsos as 'the industry leader in German public sector research,' indicating a strong niche position in German government/public-sector survey research prior to its 2025 acquisition. [Ipsos launches voluntary public takeover offer for infas](https://www.ipsos.com/en/ipsos-launches-voluntary-public-takeover-offer-infas-acquire-industry-leader-german-public-sector)
thesis.main_shareholders: As of January 2025, Ipsos GmbH completed acquisition of approximately 97% of Infas Holding AG from prior shareholders including Investmentaktiengesellschaft für langfristige Investoren TGV, PEN GmbH, Hans-Herbert Döbert, and Effecten-Spiegel AG, for approximately €59.4 million; Infas Holding is now majority-owned by Ipsos. [MarketScreener - Infas/Ipsos transaction](https://app.researchpool.com/company/ifs-de0006097108-infas-holding-ag-j3YrPqhkv0/press/infas-holding-ag-ifs-infas-holding-aktiengesellschaft-disclosure-of-an-inside-information-a-Zlz71XecLS)
thesis.insider_ownership: Pre-takeover insider/founder-linked holders included Hans-Herbert Döbert among the group collectively holding ~77.52% that sold to Ipsos; post-acquisition, Ipsos (a large external strategic acquirer, not a historical insider) now holds the controlling ~97% stake. [Research-live: Ipsos takeover of Infas](https://www.research-live.com/article/news/ipsos-launches-public-takeover-of-infas/id/5129713)
thesis.red_flags: Note that Infas is now a ~97%-controlled subsidiary of Ipsos following a 2025 takeover, meaning free float / minority liquidity is very limited going forward; this is a material structural change for any new investor to be aware of, not a governance scandal per se. [Ipsos takeover announcement](https://www.research-live.com/article/news/ipsos-launches-public-takeover-of-infas/id/5129713)

thesis.business_description: IVF Hartmann Holding AG is a Swiss holding company based in Neuhausen am Rheinfall that produces and distributes medical consumer goods for hospitals, doctors, pharmacies and retail, organized in wound care, incontinence management and infection management segments (bandages, first aid, hygiene, diagnostics equipment, etc.). Source: https://m.uk.investing.com/equities/ivf-hartmann-holding-ag-company-profile ; https://www.ivf.hartmann.info/fr-CH/savoir-news/investor-relations
thesis.competitive_position: Niche Swiss medical-consumables producer (~300 employees) with recurring B2B demand from hospitals, care centers and pharmacies; operates as part of the international Hartmann group's distribution network, which gives it scale and sourcing advantages but limits its independent market positioning. Source: https://simplywall.st/stocks/ch/healthcare/vtx-vbsn/ivf-hartmann-holding-shares/ownership
thesis.main_shareholders: The company's own investor-relations materials state that the majority of shares has belonged since 1993 to the international HARTMANN GRUPPE (Paul Hartmann AG, Heidenheim, Germany), held via Paul Hartmann Finance B.V. (https://www.ivf.hartmann.info/fr-CH/savoir-news/investor-relations ; https://de.finance.yahoo.com/quote/0QQM.L/profile). A third-party aggregator (Simply Wall St, dated Jan 2021) cites Paul Hartmann AG at ~67% of shares outstanding (https://simplywall.st/stocks/ch/healthcare/vtx-vbsn/ivf-hartmann-holding-shares/ownership) but we could not locate a current SIX disclosure-threshold filing confirming the exact percentage today, so this figure should be treated as approximate/dated rather than a confirmed official-source number.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources beyond the standard controlling-parent/related-party relationship: 2024/2025 results disclosed a CHF 23.5m related-party loan repayment from Paul Hartmann AG, which is a related-party transaction worth monitoring but not inherently a governance problem. Source: https://www.moneycab.com/schweiz/ivf-hartmann-erzielt-wegen-hoeherer-kosten-2025-weniger-gewinn/amp/

thesis.business_description: Delfingen Société Anonyme (Delfingen Industry) is a France-based (Anteuil) manufacturer of protection and routing systems for electrical networks and on-board fluid transfer solutions, serving automotive and other industrial sectors worldwide, with roughly 3,850 employees. [MarketScreener company profile](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DELFINGEN-INDUSTRY-5062/company/)
thesis.competitive_position: Delfingen is an established global automotive-components supplier specializing in cable/wire protection and fluid-transfer systems, operating internationally under founder-family leadership; it has achieved strong recent share-price performance (reported one-year shareholder gains of around 209% as of a 2026 note), though this reflects market sentiment rather than an independently verified moat metric. [Simply Wall St: Delfingen shareholders' one-year gains](https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/automobiles/epa-aldel/delfingen-societe-anonyme-shares/news/the-12-return-this-week-takes-delfingen-socit-anonymes-epaal/amp)
thesis.main_shareholders: Delfingen Group SA, the family holding vehicle, holds approximately 57.04% of Delfingen Société Anonyme's equity; the founding Streit family directly or indirectly holds more than two-thirds of voting rights in the broader group structure. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DELFINGEN-INDUSTRY-5062/company/), [Delfingen Group governance](https://delfingengroup.com/en/governance/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is high and multi-generational: founder Bernard Streit led the company for over 35 years before resigning as Chairman, handing leadership to his son Gérald Streit (current Chairman/CEO), who serves alongside his own two sons, Victor and Benoît, on the board -- giving the Streit family effective control of more than two-thirds of voting rights. [Delfingen Group governance page](https://delfingengroup.com/en/governance/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched; the recent Chairman transition from Bernard to Gérald Streit was a disclosed, orderly succession rather than a dispute. [MarketScreener - Bernard Streit resignation announcement](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DELFINGEN-INDUSTRY-5062/news/Delfingen-Industry-Resignation-of-Bernard-Streit-as-Chairman-of-DELFINGEN-Industry-s-Board-of-Di-26739665/)

thesis.business_description: SBO AG (formerly Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield Equipment AG) is an Austrian manufacturer of high-precision components and equipment for the oil and gas drilling industry (downhole tools, drill collars and related equipment), listed on the Vienna Stock Exchange (ATX).
thesis.competitive_position: SBO is a long-established, specialist manufacturer of precision oilfield drilling equipment, historically regarded as a leading global niche supplier of drill collars and downhole tools to the oilfield services industry; detailed current market-share data was not found in this search. [Boerse-express](https://www.boerse-express.com/boerse/aktie/schoeller-bleckmann-ag+tts-666437/firmenprofil)
thesis.main_shareholders: Not disclosed in sources found with specific percentages; the company's 2025 AGM approved a name change to SBO AG and a dividend of EUR 1.75/share, but no major-shareholder breakdown was located. Could not verify current ownership structure from available sources.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in sources found. Brigitte Ederer was re-elected to the Supervisory Board for a four-year term at the 2025 AGM, but no personal shareholding data was found for board members. [Boerse-express AGM release](https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/eqs-news-schoeller-bleckmann-oilfield-equipment-ag-annual-general-meeting-approves-company-name-change-to-sbo-ag-and-a-dividend-payment-of-eur-175-per-share-775118)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The 2025 AGM discharged both the Executive and Supervisory Boards for fiscal 2024, a routine governance action.

thesis.business_description: Toyota Caetano Portugal, S.A. is Toyota's import and distribution operation for Portugal, also manufacturing/assembling light commercial vehicles (notably the Toyota Dyna/Caetano Bus operations historically) and operating dealership/retail automotive activities, controlled jointly by the Salvador Caetano family group and Toyota.
thesis.competitive_position: Toyota Caetano is the exclusive Toyota (and historically Lexus) importer/distributor for Portugal, giving it a durable franchise-based moat tied directly to its contractual relationship with Toyota Motor Europe; this relationship is itself the source of a formal shareholder agreement constraining the company's ownership structure. [Grupo Salvador Caetano corporate governance report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Grupo Salvador Caetano, SGPS, S.A. (the family holding company) holds approximately 69.8% per recent aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pt/automobiles/eli-sct/toyota-caetano-portugal-shares/ownership)), versus about 60.8% in a 2015 governance report; Toyota Motor Europe NV/SA (listed by some sources as Toyota Motor Corporation) holds approximately 27% ([2015 Governance Report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pt/automobiles/eli-sct/toyota-caetano-portugal-shares/ownership)). A shareholder agreement tied to the Toyota dealer contract commits the family holding to retain roughly 60% of share capital while that contract remains in force (described as a pledge of honour with no penalty clause) ([2015 Governance Report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: The Salvador Caetano family controls the company via Grupo Salvador Caetano SGPS; heirs of founder Salvador Fernandes Caetano separately held about 4% directly as of the 2015 report ([2015 Governance Report](https://toyotacaetano.pt/wp-content/uploads/sites/24/2018/08/Governance_Report-30042015.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: A 2019 shareholder-approved attempt to delist the company (with Salvador Caetano Auto committing to buy out minority shareholders) was abandoned in 2020 because the company judged the offer price unconvincing; minority shareholders should be aware a future delisting attempt is plausible given this history. [ECO - Salvador Caetano abandons delisting plan](https://eco.sapo.pt/2020/04/22/salvador-caetano-desiste-de-retirar-toyota-caetano-da-bolsa-preco-nao-convence/)

thesis.business_description: Celebrus Technologies plc (formerly D4t4 Solutions) provides a first-party digital identity and customer data platform that captures real-time behavioural data from websites and apps without manual tagging, sold as software/SaaS mainly to banking, insurance and retail customers. In FY26 (year to 31 March 2026) reported revenue was about $23.6m (down from $38.7m, largely due to a switch to straight-line licence revenue recognition from April 2025) and ARR rose 10.3% to about $15.0m; in 2025-26 it launched an AI data model, an MCP server and 'Celebrus AI' conversational analytics. Sources: https://www.celebrus.com/hubfs/FY26%20Files/FY26%20Investors%20Webpages/Celebrus%20FY26%20Final%20Results%20Presentation%20FINAL.pdf ; https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/celebrus-technologies-projects-loss-accounting-changes-impact-sales ; https://www.techmarketview.com/ukhotviews/archive/2026/07/14/celebrus-growth-continues-but-new-business-disappoints
thesis.competitive_position: A small, niche vendor in the crowded customer data platform / digital analytics space, with a concentrated base of large financial-services clients; its differentiator is tag-free, real-time first-party data capture and identity resolution. FY26 showed decent retention (net revenue retention reported at 96.7% in the company presentation vs 97.6% in press coverage) but new-logo wins disappointed, with several Q4 deals lost or delayed and two banking clients reducing footprint after divestitures. The balance sheet is a strength: roughly $32m cash and no debt at FY26 year-end, and the company has been buying back shares into treasury. Sources: https://www.celebrus.com/hubfs/FY26%20Files/FY26%20Investors%20Webpages/Celebrus%20FY26%20Final%20Results%20Presentation%20FINAL.pdf ; https://www.techmarketview.com/ukhotviews/archive/2026/07/14/celebrus-growth-continues-but-new-business-disappoints ; https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/celebrus-technologies--clbs/transaction-in-own-shares/9702403
thesis.main_shareholders: Company shareholder page (information dated 30 September 2025): Rathbones 13.62%, Canaccord Genuity Wealth Management 10.28%, Charles Stanley 9.87%, TrinityBridge 8.28%, Herald Investment Management 8.04%; shares not in public hands 24.87%. More recent TR-1 notifications show Mission Trail Capital Management at 13.30% (5,205,200 shares) after crossing a threshold on 9 March 2026 (up from 11.47% in February 2026), so the company table is stale. Simply Wall St (aggregator, undated) shows Mission Trail at 15.6% - unverified against a filing. Sources: https://www.celebrus.com/investors/shareholders ; https://www.ticker.app/lse/CLBS/rns/2026-03-11/holdings-in-company/2761W ; https://www.ticker.app/lse/CLBS/rns/2026-02-23/Holding(s)-in-Company/0111U
thesis.red_flags: FY26 revenue fell about 39% and the company swung to an adjusted pre-tax loss (about $0.2m vs $8.7m profit the year before), partly due to the change in revenue recognition, which makes year-on-year comparisons hard; new business underperformed and two banking clients cut usage. An AskTraders article (single, non-official source, not verified against a company RNS) reports a further H1 FY27 trading update guiding to FY27 revenue of $20.0-20.5m and an adjusted pre-tax loss of $2.8-3.0m. Customer concentration in financial services is high. Sources: https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/aim-and-small-cap-news/aim-bulletin/celebrus-flags-flat-revenue,-swing-to-losses ; https://www.asktraders.com/analysis/celebrus-guides-below-consensus-after-customer-exit-and-slower-deals/
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider holdings appear small. CEO Bill Bruno held 185,428 shares (0.47% of voting rights) after an option exercise in September 2025; Chair Tom Skelton bought 50,000 shares (0.12%) in January 2024. Could not locate a complete current table of all director holdings in this search; check the FY26 annual report. Sources: https://www.ticker.app/lse/CLBS/rns/2025-09-12/PDMR-dealing/1945Z ; https://lse.co.uk/rns/directorpdmr-shareholding-2jzia5n40bfulx7.html

thesis.business_description: Creepy Jar S.A. is a Warsaw-based independent ('Premium Indie') video-game developer and self-publisher best known for Green Hell, a survival simulation set in the Amazon rainforest, which has sold over 4.5 million copies across Steam, PlayStation and Xbox; its next title in development is StarRupture, a solo/co-op survival-crafting game. Source: https://creepyjar.com/en/company/ ; https://creepyjar.com/en/?p=14495
thesis.competitive_position: Small, self-financed Polish indie studio that avoids external publishers and reinvests cash flow from its one proven hit (Green Hell) into new IP; 2023 preliminary results showed PLN 37.5m revenue and PLN 18.3m net profit, indicating a profitable but single-title-dependent business until StarRupture ships. Source: https://creepyjar.com/en/?p=14495
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and CEO Krzysztof Kwiatek has historically been the largest named holder; a Parkiet shareholder table (dated, pre-2023) showed Kwiatek with 78,879 shares = 11.27% of capital and votes, with Krzysztof Sałek shown at a similar level, source: https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/creepy_jar. Quercus TFI funds (QUERCUS Parasolowy SFIO, Acer Aggressive FIZ / Acer Multistrategy FIZ) held stakes but both fell below the 5% voting threshold in notifications filed January 2022 and January 2023, source: https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26455861-creepy-jar-s-a-zawiadomienie-akcjonariusza-o-zmianie-udzialu-w-ogolnej-liczbie-glosow. In January 2026, Bankier reported that Venture FIZ sold 45,000 shares (~6.43% of share capital) via accelerated bookbuild at PLN 620/share, source: https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/CREEPYJAR/wiadomosci. We could not confirm a single current, complete shareholder table from an official company filing in this search; percentages above are dated and should be cross-checked against the company's latest annual report or ESPI notifications.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources regarding governance, litigation or going-concern; founder/management (Kwiatek, Sałek, Soból) have periodically sold shares via accelerated bookbuilds (e.g. 4.42% combined stake sold in July 2020; Venture FIZ sold ~6.43% in Jan 2026), which is disclosed insider/fund selling worth monitoring but not inherently a red flag. Source: https://comparic.pl/gpw-przeglad-informacji-ze-spolek-8-lipca-2020-r/ ; https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/CREEPYJAR/wiadomosci. The business remains heavily dependent on a single legacy title (Green Hell) pending the commercial outcome of StarRupture.

thesis.business_description: Mennica Polska S.A. (Polish Mint) is a Poland-based producer of coins, numismatic/collector items and investment gold bars, and also operates city-card payment systems and property development projects (e.g., Mennica Tower/Mennica Legacy Tower in Warsaw).
thesis.competitive_position: Mennica Polska describes itself as one of the most technologically advanced mints in the world and a leading coin/numismatic producer in Poland and Europe, and is Poland's only producer of investment gold bars, giving it a regulatory/licensing moat in that niche; its diversification into Warsaw real estate development is a separate, less-moated business line. [Simply Wall St company overview](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/consumer-durables/wse-mnc/mennica-polska-shares)
thesis.main_shareholders: Zbigniew Jakubas is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 50% of shares ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/consumer-durables/wse-mnc/mennica-polska-shares/ownership)); Polish pension funds are significant institutional holders, including Generali PTE (~10.6%), Nationale-Nederlanden PTE (~7.5%) and PZU's PTE (~6.9%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/consumer-durables/wse-mnc/mennica-polska-shares/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Zbigniew Jakubas holds ~50%, and Joanna Jakubas (family member) holds approximately 5.8% separately, per aggregator data ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/consumer-durables/wse-mnc/mennica-polska-shares/ownership)); combined individual-insider ownership is estimated around 56% - a controlling family stake.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: Piquadro S.p.A. is an Italian designer and manufacturer of leather goods and travel accessories (bags, briefcases, luggage) sold under the Piquadro brand, and since 2013 also owns The Bridge leather-goods brand.
thesis.competitive_position: Piquadro is a mid-sized, founder-led Italian leather-goods maker, listed on Euronext Milan since October 2007, competing in a crowded premium accessories segment against larger luxury houses; its moat rests on brand recognition in the Italian/Asian business-travel accessories niche rather than scale. [Piquadro 2011 shareholders meeting disclosure](https://www.piquadro.com/cdn/shop/files/43CS_Piquadro_Shareholders_Meeting_July_21_2011_EN.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Piquadro Holding S.p.A., controlled by founder/Chairman-CEO Marco Palmieri, is the controlling shareholder, holding roughly 68-72% of ordinary shares in disclosures from 2011-2016 (34,153,708-34,186,208 shares, i.e. 68.37% in a 2016 filing and described as ~72% in current aggregator data) ([Piquadro 2016 filing](https://emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2022-05/20160704_18065.pdf); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/consumer-durables/fra-4lz/piquadro-shares/ownership)); Mediobanca is the largest outside institutional holder at approximately 5% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/consumer-durables/fra-4lz/piquadro-shares/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Marco Palmieri, founder, Chairman and CEO, indirectly owns the controlling stake through Piquadro Holding S.p.A., of which he personally held 93.34% of share capital as of a 2011 disclosure, with the remaining 6.66% held by fellow board member Pierpaolo Palmieri ([Piquadro 2011 AGM disclosure](https://www.piquadro.com/cdn/shop/files/43CS_Piquadro_Shareholders_Meeting_July_21_2011_EN.pdf)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: K. Kythreotis Holdings Public Limited is a Cyprus-based building-materials and construction-services group producing aggregates (crushed rock, sand, road base), ready-mix concrete, floor screed and mortars, and asphalt, plus road construction, land development/plot division and sports-surface (football turf, tennis/basketball courts) services, through subsidiaries K. Kythreotis - Skirodema Ltd and Kythromak (Asphalting) Ltd.
thesis.competitive_position: Kythreotis is a long-established (founded 1943) vertically integrated building-materials producer in Limassol/Nicosia, Cyprus, with four ready-mix concrete production units and dedicated asphalt/road-construction operations, giving it a strong regional niche serving both government-funded infrastructure projects and private construction clients on the island; its moat is primarily local scale, quarry/aggregate resource access and decades of incumbency rather than global reach. [Cyprus Mail - Kythreotis revenue and profit update, Sept 2026](https://cyprus-mail.com/2026/09/25/land-development-lifts-kythreotis-revenue-as-profits-weaken); [K. Kythreotis Holdings - official site](https://www.kythreotis.com.cy/).
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder-chairman Petros Kythreotis holds approximately 53.63% of the company, making the Kythreotis family the controlling shareholder. [MarketScreener - K. Kythreotis Holdings shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/K-KYTHREOTIS-HOLDINGS-PUB-64305659/).
thesis.insider_ownership: The company is tightly family-controlled: Petros Kythreotis serves as both Chairman and CEO (a role he has held since 1970) while holding ~53.63% of shares; other family members also hold operational/board roles, including Christiana Kythreoti as Director of Finance/CFO and Board Member, and Kostas Kythreotis in a corporate officer role. [MarketScreener - K. Kythreotis Holdings shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/K-KYTHREOTIS-HOLDINGS-PUB-64305659/).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. No litigation, auditor dispute, or related-party controversy was found in available search results; the combination of majority family ownership and the Chairman also serving as CEO is a standard governance concentration point worth monitoring but is not itself evidence of wrongdoing. [Cyprus Mail - Kythreotis H1 2025 results](https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/09/26/kythreotis-reports-higher-first-half-profit-declares-dividend).

thesis.business_description: Fope S.p.A. is an Italian fine-jewellery manufacturer, founded in 1929 in Vicenza, that designs and produces 18-carat gold jewelry (bracelets, necklaces, rings, earrings) in-house, best known for its patented "Flex'it" flexible-mesh gold chain technology.
thesis.competitive_position: Fope occupies a differentiated "accessible luxury"/fine-jewellery niche built around proprietary Flex'it flexible-gold technology and fully in-house design-to-manufacture production in Vicenza (including custom-built machinery/robots for its signature mesh chains), which differentiates it from both mass-market jewelry brands and larger luxury conglomerates; it has been listed on Euronext Growth Milan since 2016, reflecting its status as a small-cap specialist rather than a scale leader. [FOPE Group - official](https://fopegroup.com/en/); [FOPE - IPO showcase, Euronext](https://live.euronext.com/en/ipo-showcase/fope).
thesis.main_shareholders: The founding Cazzola family controls the large majority of the company: Ines Cazzola holds approximately 34.23%, Umberto Cazzola approximately 22.53%, and the heirs of Giulia Cazzola approximately 11.70% (combined family ownership of roughly 70%); P4P International S.p.A. holds approximately 12.34%. [FOPE - Info for shareholders (official)](https://fopegroup.com/en/investor/info-per-gli-azionisti/); [Borsa Italiana - FOPE company profile](https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/azioni/profilo-societa-dettaglio.html?isin=IT0005203424&lang=en).
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider/founder-family ownership is very high: the Cazzola family (descendants of founder Umberto Cazzola, who opened the original goldsmith workshop in 1929) collectively holds approximately 70% of share capital across Ines Cazzola, Umberto Cazzola and Giulia Cazzola's heirs, consistent with three generations of continued family stewardship of the business. [FOPE Group - Brand/history (official)](https://fopegroup.com/en/storia/fope-s-p-a-si-quota-in-borsa/).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. No litigation, auditor dispute, or related-party controversy was found in available search results; note P4P International S.p.A.'s ~12.34% stake and periodic "substantial shareholder change" disclosures under Euronext Growth Milan Issuer Regulation Art. 17 are routine regulatory filings rather than indications of a dispute. [FOPE - Significant shareholder change disclosure (official PDF)](https://fopegroup.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2026-06-12-FOPE-CS-Variazione-P4P.pdf).

thesis.business_description: Pekabex S.A. is an international construction company specializing in prefabricated structures, serving as a leading manufacturer of reinforced concrete prefabricates, general contractor, and developer. It offers design, production, assembly, and comprehensive construction services, with proprietary systems for halls, residential buildings, and parking structures, operating factories in Poland and Germany.Pekabex homepage
thesis.competitive_position: Largest producer of heavy concrete prefabricates in Poland (18.3% market share), with vertical integration, 6 factories, proprietary patented systems, automation (Europe's most modern plant), export to Germany/Scandinavia (26% revenues), and strong order backlog.Pekabex site; [2022 Report](https://pekabex.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Sprawozdanie-z-dzialalnosci-raport-
thesis.main_shareholders: STE sp. z o.o. (39.91%), Cantorelle Limited (11.92%), Fernik Holdings Limited (7.86-8.17%), Nationale-Nederlanden (6.89%).Shareholder page; [2022 Report](https://pekabex.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Sprawozdanie-z-dzialalnosci-r
thesis.red_flags: Moderate customer concentration (top client CTP Group 12.5% of 2022 revenues); cyclical construction market exposure; healthy debt (net debt/EBITDA 0.69x); minor governance exceptions (no diversity policy, e-voting).[2022 Integrated Report](https://pekabex.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Sprawozdanie

name: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Sniezka SA

thesis.business_description: Fabryka Farb i Lakierów Śnieżka SA is a Polish paint and coatings manufacturer, producing decorative and industrial paints/varnishes and operating a multi-brand group across Poland and Central/Eastern Europe (including Hungarian subsidiary Poli-Farbe and Radomska Fabryka Farb i Lakierów/Rafil), listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2003.
thesis.competitive_position: Śnieżka describes itself as the only paint manufacturer listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange and the only one controlled by Polish capital, and has grown via regional acquisitions (Rafil, Hungary's Poli-Farbe at an 80% stake); it has paid dividends every year since its 2003 listing, reflecting a strong regional market position and cash generation. [European Coatings - Śnieżka powder coatings divestment](https://european-coatings.com/?p=25743)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per a December 2025 brokerage report (BDM), major shareholders are Stanisław Cymbor (~20.1%), Jerzy Pater (~20.1%), OFE Allianz (~14.4%), Rafał Mikrut (~10.1%), Piotr Mikrut (~10.1%, also CEO) and OFE Nationale-Nederlanden (~9.4%), with others holding the remaining ~15.8% ([BDM brokerage report via Strefa Inwestorów](https://strefainwestorow.pl/sites/default/files/attachments/53074429_13672243_53074429_20251203_BDM_SKA_PL_RA.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: The Mikrut family (brothers Piotr Mikrut, CEO, and Rafał Mikrut) together hold approximately 20.2% (10.1% each); founders/long-term holders Stanisław Cymbor and Jerzy Pater each separately hold ~20.1% and both sit on the supervisory board (Cymbor as chairman, Pater as vice-chairman as of the 2026 AGM) ([BDM brokerage report](https://strefainwestorow.pl/sites/default/files/attachments/53074429_13672243_53074429_20251203_BDM_SKA_PL_RA.pdf); [Parkiet - supervisory board nominations](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44428891-fabryka-farb-i-lakierow-sniezka-sa-powolanie-czlonkow-rady-nadzorczej-i-komitetu-audytu)).
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Berentzen-Gruppe Aktiengesellschaft is a German beverage producer headquartered in Haselünne, operating a Spirits segment (brands including Berentzen, Puschkin, Strothmann, Doornkaat, and Bommerlunder) as well as non-alcoholic beverages and fresh juice systems. [Berentzen Group history](https://www.berentzen-gruppe.de/en/berentzen-group/history)
thesis.competitive_position: Berentzen is an established, multi-brand German spirits producer; its strategic attractiveness is underscored by a September 2026 business combination agreement in which US drinks group Sazerac agreed to acquire it to build 'a leading spirits platform in Europe,' at a roughly 68% premium to its prior three-month average share price. [Sazerac/Berentzen business combination announcement](https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/berentzen-group-and-sazerac-to-create-a-leading-spirits-platform-in-europe-takeover-offer-for-berentzen-gruppe-aktiengesellschaft-announced/8a280588-d0f5-4f32-bb19-8a46ebbcaa26_en)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is now widely held following the 2016 exit of prior private-equity owner Aurelius: reported holders include Marchmain Invest NV (~5.63%), Lazard Frères Gestion SAS (~5.18%), and Aevum Fondation de Prévoyance (~5.12%, though Aevum's stake was separately described as closer to 10% in 2026 takeover coverage); ownership breakdown is roughly private companies 10.7%, institutions 11.2%, general public 78%. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/food-beverage-tobacco/etr-bez/berentzen-gruppe-shares/ownership), [Bloomberg: Major Berentzen Shareholder Says Sazerac Bid Too Low](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-01/major-berentzen-shareholder-says-sazerac-takeover-bid-too-low)
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding owner families (Berentzen, Pabst, Richarz, and Wolff) sold the large majority of their stake to private equity firm Aurelius back in 2008 and are no longer significant holders; current ownership is institutional/public rather than founder-insider. [Berentzen-Gruppe MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BERENTZEN-GRUPPE-AG-24156987/company/)
thesis.red_flags: Berentzen is currently the subject of a Sazerac takeover bid (EUR 5.55/share) that Swiss pension fund Aevum (reportedly the third-largest shareholder, ~10%) has publicly rejected as too low, with Aevum considering increasing its stake to block the deal; Sazerac intends to delist the company from Frankfurt if the deal completes. This is an active, disputed M&A situation investors should be aware of before building a new thesis around the current share price. [Bloomberg: Major Berentzen Shareholder Says Sazerac Bid Too Low](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-01/major-berentzen-shareholder-says-sazerac-takeover-bid-too-low)

thesis.business_description: Agram banka d.d. is a Zagreb-based Croatian commercial bank (formerly Kreditna banka Zagreb, renamed Agram banka in January 2019), providing retail and corporate banking services and closely affiliated with the Agram Group of insurance and leasing companies.
thesis.competitive_position: Agram banka is a small Croatian bank tightly integrated into the Agram Group ecosystem (insurance, leasing, automotive), acquired from the Agrokor Group in 2005; its competitive position rests on serving the group's affiliated businesses and customers rather than broad independent market scale. [SeeNews - Agram banka dividend coverage](https://www.seenews.com/news/croatias-agram-banka-proposes-2-euroshare-dividend-857092)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is concentrated among Agram Group-affiliated entities: per 2025 aggregator data, Adriatic osiguranje's asset-management arm holds ~20%, Euroherc osiguranje ~18.8%, and Agram Life osiguranje's asset-management arm ~18.6%, with further Agram-affiliated holders including Agram leasing (~8.86%), Agram TIS (~7.67%) and Intermod (~7.61%); the top 10 shareholders hold ~89.74% of the company ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/hr/banks/zgse-kbz/agram-banka-dd-shares/ownership)). A separate Croatian database (Fininfo) gives different percentages for some of the same entities, so figures should be cross-checked against the Zagreb Stock Exchange register.
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed/found as distinct from the Agram Group corporate holding structure; no individual founder/management stake was identified separately from the group's affiliated-company shareholdings. Not disclosed in public filings found.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; the concentrated ownership by multiple related Agram Group entities (insurance, leasing, trading companies) is a related-party structure worth noting, though no specific governance controversy was found.

thesis.business_description: QleanAir AB is a Swedish provider of clean-indoor-air solutions, offering modular air purification/filtration equipment on a full-service lease-contract basis to industrial and commercial customers. [QleanAir investor site](https://qleanair.com/investors/)
thesis.competitive_position: QleanAir operates a service-based, lease/subscription model for mobile air purification units rather than selling equipment outright, which the company positions as a differentiator versus pure equipment sellers; however, no independent third-party market-share data was found confirming the size of its competitive moat. [QleanAir 2024 Annual Report](https://qleanair.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/QleanAir_Annual_Report_2024.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Reported shareholders include Avanza Fonder AB (~9.2%), Calandrella Limited (~6.6%), and Livförsäkringsbolaget Skandia (~4.6%); a 2023 announcement also named Swedia Capital as the largest shareholder at approximately 26.5%. Historically (at the 2019 IPO) the controlling holder was Priveq Investment Fund IV via Qevirp 41 Limited. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/QLEANAIR-AB-85625533/company/), [QleanAir EGM notice 2023](https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b2ff8408b510c80468a53504fb68365f5&lang=en)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in detail in the sources found; no specific management/board personal ownership percentage was identified distinct from Swedia Capital's institutional stake. Could not verify further.
thesis.red_flags: No specific lawsuit, governance scandal, or delisting issue was found in the sources searched; note the company has had significant shareholder/ownership changes (large PE-linked holder Swedia Capital) which investors may wish to track but nothing concerning was identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: SThree plc is a UK-based global specialist talent/staffing partner focused on Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) roles, operating brands including Progressive Recruitment, Computer Futures, Real Staffing and Huxley, providing both permanent placement and flexible contract staffing.
thesis.competitive_position: A STEM-focused specialist recruiter (founded 1986) that has shown resilience versus more generalist staffing peers in the FTSE 100/250, underpinned by a mix of mission-critical contractor placements and complementary permanent recruitment services across DACH, Rest of Europe, Netherlands/Spain, US and Middle East/Asia segments. [SThree Annual Report 2024](https://www.sthree.com/annual-report-2024/documents/SThree_AR24_Strategic_Report.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Van Lanschot Kempen Investment Management holds approximately 10.39%, J.O. Hambro Capital Management approximately 9.86%, and FIL Investment Advisors (Fidelity) approximately 9.74%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/STHREE-PLC-4005631/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed as a significant founder/management stake in sources reviewed; the register is dominated by institutional asset managers rather than insiders.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Roularta Media Group NV is a Belgian multimedia group publishing magazines and newspapers (including stakes in French titles via its former Roularta-L'Express print partnership) and operating television/digital media, headquartered in Roeselare, Belgium.
thesis.competitive_position: Roularta is a leading Belgian/Flemish print and multimedia publisher, long family-controlled, which has been consolidating its share structure and is now pursuing a full take-private/delisting after 27 years on the Brussels exchange - a sign the controlling family sees more value outside public markets than the market is currently according it. [Belga News Agency - Roularta delisting bid](https://www.belganewsagency.eu/media-group-roularta-to-delist-as-brussels-stock-exchange-struggles-to-attract-new-listings)
thesis.main_shareholders: The De Nolf family controls Roularta via Koinon NV, holding approximately 72.3% of shares at the time of a going-private tender offer (€15.50/share, a ~24.5% premium) ([Belga News Agency](https://www.belganewsagency.eu/media-group-roularta-to-delist-as-brussels-stock-exchange-struggles-to-attract-new-listings)); a May 2025 Belgian FSMA transparency-register overview shows Hendrik (Rik) De Nolf's combined stake (via STAK Cerveteri/Koinon NV plus Roularta's own treasury-share holding) at approximately 86.98% of voting rights ([FSMA transparency register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0434278896_nl.pdf)). The Claeys family holds a smaller allied stake via West Investment Holding (~3.75-4.47% depending on source/date) ([FSMA register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0434278896_nl.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: The De Nolf family (founders Willy and Marie-Therese De Nolf's descendants, led by Rik/Hendrik De Nolf) is the controlling insider group at ~72-87% depending on measure and date; the allied Claeys family (Leo Claeys, brother-in-law of Rik De Nolf, having sold down his direct stake to De Nolf over time) holds a smaller allied minority stake. [Made-in.be - Leo Claeys share sale](https://www.made-in.be/west-vlaanderen/leo-claeys-verkoopt-aandelen-roularta-aan-rik-de-nolf/)
thesis.red_flags: Active take-private/delisting bid in progress: the controlling De Nolf family (via Koinon NV), backed by the Claeys family's West Investment Holding, has launched a €215m tender offer at €15.50/share to delist Roularta from Euronext Brussels, which minority shareholders may view as advantaging the controlling family at the expense of outside holders; precise float/treasury percentages are inconsistent across sources and should be checked against the live offer document. [Belga News Agency](https://www.belganewsagency.eu/media-group-roularta-to-delist-as-brussels-stock-exchange-struggles-to-attract-new-listings)

thesis.business_description: AB INVL Baltic Farmland is a Lithuanian real-estate company that owns and manages agricultural (farm)land, holding 100% stakes in roughly 18 subsidiary companies that collectively own about 3,000 hectares of farmland in Lithuania, leased out to Lithuanian farmers and agricultural companies.
thesis.competitive_position: INVL Baltic Farmland is a small, specialized farmland-holding vehicle (market cap ~EUR 20.5m as of September 2024) spun off in 2014 from Baltic asset manager Invalda INVL; its land management is outsourced to INVL Farmland Management under a property administration agreement, making it essentially a passive landlord rather than an active farming operator. [INVL Baltic Farmland Q3 2024 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/inl/2024_q3_en_eur_00.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per aggregator data (undated), the largest holders are LJB Investments UAB (~30.3%), Irena Mišeikienė (~28.9%), Lucrum Investicija UAB (~12.9%), Alvydas Banys (~7.8%, also board chairman) and Ilona Šulnienė (~7.4%), with the top 7 shareholders holding ~91.29% of the company ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/lt/real-estate-management-and-development/nsel-inl1l/ab-invl-baltic-farmland-shares/ownership)). This should be cross-checked against the company's own >5% shareholder disclosure as of 30 September 2024 ([INVL Baltic Farmland Q3 2024 report](https://nasdaqbaltic.com/market/upload/reports/inl/2024_q3_en_eur_00.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Board chairman Alvydas Banys holds a direct stake of approximately 7.8% per aggregator data, and is linked to the Invalda INVL group that spun the company off; combined individual-insider ownership is estimated around 48.1% per the same source, indicating a closely-held structure. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/lt/real-estate-management-and-development/nsel-inl1l/ab-invl-baltic-farmland-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Plastiques du Val de Loire (Groupe Plastivaloire) is a France-based manufacturer of complex injection-molded plastic parts for automotive (roughly 80% of revenue), telecommunications, electrical, construction, and gardening sectors, operating more than 30 sites internationally. [Plastivaloire group history](https://groupe-plastivaloire.com/en/history/)
thesis.competitive_position: Plastivaloire is a long-established, family-founded (1963, by Charles Findeling) automotive plastics supplier with international manufacturing scale (30+ sites), though it has faced balance-sheet strain typical of auto-parts suppliers; it recently returned to positive net profit and improved EBITDA margin (~9.0%) with an 8-month increase in order intake. [Half-year results 2025-2026 press release](https://www.actusnews.com/en/groupe-plastivaloire/pr/2026/07/15/half-year-results-for-2025-2026-ebitda-margin-up-to-9_0-per-cent-return-to-a-positive-net-profit-eight-month-order-intake)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Findeling family owns approximately 57% of capital and controls over 72% of voting rights (via double voting rights), as of early 2025; free float is roughly 40%. [Half-year results press release](https://www.actusnews.com/en/groupe-plastivaloire/pr/2026/07/15/half-year-results-for-2025-2026-ebitda-margin-up-to-9_0-per-cent-return-to-a-positive-net-profit-eight-month-order-intake)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is very high and founder-family controlled: the Findeling family (Patrick Findeling is Chairman of the Board, with CEO Antoine Doutriaux appointed in 2022) holds roughly 57% of capital / over 72% of votes. [Bloomberg profile: Patrick Findeling](https://www.bloomberg.com/profile/person/1396127)
thesis.red_flags: Plastivaloire has had elevated financial leverage: net debt stood at approximately €163.4 million (including €15.6 million lease liabilities) against shareholders' equity of €179.1 million as of March 31, 2026, and the company recently had to negotiate an agreement with financial partners to extend the maturity profile of its debt (with a modest 25bps rate increase on syndicated/bilateral loans). This reflects real balance-sheet/refinancing risk, though the company frames it as a successful recovery and extension, not a default. [Half-year results and debt agreement press release](https://www.actusnews.com/en/groupe-plastivaloire/pr/2026/07/15/half-year-results-for-2025-2026-ebitda-margin-up-to-9_0-per-cent-return-to-a-positive-net-profit-eight-month-order-intake)

thesis.business_description: Campine NV is a Belgian (Beerse-based) metals recycling and specialty chemicals company, primarily recycling lead from scrap (notably used car batteries) into refined lead metal, and also producing antimony and other specialty chemical products; it has recently expanded into French lead-battery recycling.
thesis.competitive_position: Campine is an established European lead-recycling specialist (approx. 60,000 tonnes of refined lead from scrap as of 2022) that has grown via distressed-asset acquisitions, buying French lead battery recycling plants out of the Recylex insolvency in 2022 and completing the purchase of Ecobat's French lead operations in October 2025 (adding ~70,000 tonnes/year of capacity), consolidating its position in European battery recycling. [Ecobat - sale of French lead operations to Campine](https://ecobat.com/2025/10/ecobat-completes-sale-of-french-lead-operations-to-campine/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Hempel family (Friedrich-Wilhelm Hempel and linked entities, including the F.-W. Hempel Familienstiftung and F.W. Hempel Metallurgical GmbH) controls Campine with approximately 71.86% of voting rights (1,077,900 of 1,500,000 shares) per a Belgian FSMA transparency-register overview dated 16 May 2025, though this rests on an underlying notification from 27 June 2019 and should be verified for currency ([FSMA transparency register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0403807337_nl.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling ownership sits with the German Hempel family (via F.W. Hempel Metallurgical GmbH and the family foundation) at ~72%, rather than with operating management; no separate management/board insider stake was identified in search results. [FSMA transparency register](https://www.fsma.be/sites/default/files/issuers/files/0403807337_nl.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the ~72% family-control figure is sourced to a 2019 notification (last update found), so confirm it has not changed via a more recent FSMA filing.

thesis.business_description: Chimimport AD is a Bulgarian holding company that acquires, restructures and manages subsidiary shareholdings and provides capital investment/financing to related enterprises, listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange-Sofia since 2007 and part of the SOFIX index.
thesis.competitive_position: A legacy privatization-era Bulgarian conglomerate (originally a 1947 state foreign-trade company, privatized via management-employee buyout in 1994) now serving as the listed holding vehicle for interests historically linked to the Varna-based TIM group, spanning banking, insurance, shipping and other sectors; competitive positioning data for the holding itself (as distinct from its operating subsidiaries) is limited in public sources. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chimimport_AD)
thesis.main_shareholders: Chimimport Invest AD holds approximately 72.22% of the company; minority holders include international institutions such as The Bank of New York Mellon, DSK Rodina Pension Funds, Eaton Vance Emerging Markets, NN Funds, UniCredit Bank and Raiffeisen Bank International. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/CHIMIMPORT-AD-9823293/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Control runs through Chimimport Invest AD (~72.22%), historically linked to the Varna-based TIM business group and its founders; specific individual insider percentages beyond the holding-company structure were not found in sources reviewed. Not fully disclosed in sources reviewed.
thesis.red_flags: The company has long-standing public association with the TIM group, a Varna-based business group that has been the subject of organized-crime investigations and media scrutiny in Bulgaria (including an investigative piece on connections to Russian elites); Bulgaria's judiciary/administration is also noted as generally weak for enforcing ownership-dispute redress, a jurisdictional governance risk. No company-specific fraud or litigation finding was confirmed. [iStories investigation](https://istories.media/en/investigations/2020/09/10/russian-elites-connections-to-bulgarias-largest-crime-group/)

thesis.business_description: PJP Makrum S.A. is a Poland-based industrial company headquartered in Bydgoszcz that manufactures industrial equipment and provides industrial construction services, organized into Docking Solutions, Steel Constructions, Industrial Construction, and other segments (including real estate leasing). [EMIS company profile - PJP Makrum](https://www.emis.com/php/company-profile/PL/PJP_Makrum_SA_en_1454806.html)
thesis.competitive_position: PJP Makrum is a long-established Polish industrial manufacturer (public since 1998) operating in niche segments like loading-dock solutions and steel construction, now controlled by diversified investment group Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE S.A., which has used PJP Makrum as a platform alongside subsidiaries like Promstahl. [Grupa Kapitałowa Immobile - PJP Makrum business areas](https://immobile.com.pl/en/obszary-dzialalnosci/pjp-makrum)
thesis.main_shareholders: Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE S.A. is the controlling shareholder, having built its stake to roughly 70.6%+ of PJP Makrum (with further tender offers, e.g., an offer for an additional 34.27% of shares at PLN 15.70/share, aiming toward 100% ownership). [Stockwatch.pl: GK Immobile tender offer for PJP Makrum](https://www.stockwatch.pl/wiadomosci/gk-immobile-ma-zamiar-oglosic-wezwanie-na-3427-proc-akcji-pjp-makrum-po-1570-zl-za-sztuke,akcje,350910)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling insider ownership runs through Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE S.A., which has progressively increased its stake toward full ownership via tender offers; no separate individual management/founder stake distinct from Immobile was identified in the sources searched. Could not verify further.
thesis.red_flags: Grupa Kapitałowa IMMOBILE's progressive tender offers aiming at 100% ownership of PJP Makrum signal a likely eventual minority squeeze-out / reduced free float, which prospective minority investors should factor in; no lawsuit or fraud allegation was identified. [Stockwatch.pl tender offer report](https://www.stockwatch.pl/wiadomosci/gk-immobile-ma-zamiar-oglosic-wezwanie-na-3427-proc-akcji-pjp-makrum-po-1570-zl-za-sztuke,akcje,350910)
