thesis.business_description: Kopparbergs Bryggeri AB is a Swedish brewery, best known for Kopparberg-brand fruit ciders, also producing beer and other beverages, headquartered at the historic Kopparberg brewery site (established 1882) in Sweden.
thesis.competitive_position: Kopparberg is a well-known international cider brand (particularly strong in the UK on-trade/off-trade cider market) built up from a derelict brewery site acquired and revived by the founding brothers in 1994; it remains tightly founder-family controlled with a dual-class share structure concentrating voting power. [Drams Scotland - visit to Kopparberg brewery](https://dramscotland.co.uk/2014/03/25/a-trip-to-the-home-of-kopparberg)
thesis.main_shareholders: P & D Bronsman AB, the family holding vehicle of founders Peter and Dan-Anders Bronsman, holds approximately 22.8% of capital but 65.3% of votes (reflecting a dual-class share structure), per aggregator data ([Inderes/Millistream data](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Kopparbergs-Bryggeri/ownership)); other large holders include 7 H Förvaltnings AB (~14.6% capital / 6.6% votes) and SEB Life International Assurance Ltd (~12.1% capital / 5.5% votes) ([Inderes](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Kopparbergs-Bryggeri/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Founders Peter Bronsman and his brother Dan-Anders Bronsman control the company through P & D Bronsman AB, giving them majority voting control (~65.3% of votes) despite a minority economic stake (~22.8% of capital) - a classic founder dual-class control structure. [Inderes ownership data](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Kopparbergs-Bryggeri/ownership); [The Grocer - Bronsman background](https://www.thegrocer.co.uk/people-news/md-davin-nugent-leaves-kopparberg-cider/373755.article)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Spire Healthcare Group plc operates a network of private hospitals and clinics across the UK, providing treatments spanning cancer care, orthopaedics, cardiac, kidney, eye, cosmetic surgery, dental and ENT procedures.
thesis.competitive_position: Spire is one of the UK's largest private hospital groups, historically majority-linked to South African hospital group Mediclinic; it was deemed attractive enough to draw a recommended take-private bid in 2026 at a 66.2% premium, indicating the market had undervalued its private-healthcare real estate and earnings relative to a private-equity buyer's view. [ProActive Investors - Spire takeover agreement](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098152/spire-healthcare-agrees-1-03-billion-takeover-as-management-reshuffles-1098152.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Mediclinic Group Limited was historically the largest shareholder at approximately 29.8% (though this figure traces to an older 2015 notification and should be verified) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/healthcare/lse-spi/spire-healthcare-group-shares/ownership)); Toscafund Asset Management holds approximately 18.1% and is also part of the consortium (alongside Three Hills and Ares Management) bidding to take Spire private via Tulip UK Bidco Limited at 250p/share (~£1.03bn total) ([ProActive Investors](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098152/spire-healthcare-agrees-1-03-billion-takeover-as-management-reshuffles-1098152.html)); Fidelity International holds approximately 10% ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/healthcare/lse-spi/spire-healthcare-group-shares/ownership)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider/management ownership is small, estimated at roughly 0.34% per TipRanks aggregator data; the company is institutionally rather than insider-controlled. [TipRanks ownership data](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/gb:spi/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: Active take-private transaction: Spire's board has recommended a cash takeover by Tulip UK Bidco Limited (backed by Toscafund, Three Hills and Ares Management) at 250p/share, with CEO Justin Ash stepping down and shareholders representing 53.4% of stock already committed to support the deal as of the most recent reporting found; this is a live, material corporate event for current/prospective shareholders to track. [ProActive Investors - Spire takeover agreement](https://www.proactiveinvestors.com/companies/news/1098152/spire-healthcare-agrees-1-03-billion-takeover-as-management-reshuffles-1098152.html)

thesis.business_description: Alumil Rom Industry S.A. is a Bucharest-based manufacturer of aluminium architectural/construction profile systems and related hardware (window and door locks, hinges, handles, glass and surface treatments), founded in 1988 and listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange since 2007.
thesis.competitive_position: The company is positioned as a leading player in the Romanian architectural aluminium systems market, operating as the local manufacturing/distribution arm of Greece's Alumil group, giving it access to group-wide product R&D and brand while serving the domestic construction and renovation market. [ZF.ro](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/bursa-alumil-rom-industry-lider-pe-piata-sistemelor-arhitecturale-de-23163153)
thesis.main_shareholders: Alumil S.A. (Alumil Aluminium Industry S.A., the Greek parent headquartered in Kilkis, Greece) holds approximately 55.9%; businessman Michail Sotiriou holds approximately 24%; the remainder (~20%) is free float dating to the 2007 IPO. [ZF.ro / BVB data](https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/bursa-alumil-rom-industry-lider-pe-piata-sistemelor-arhitecturale-de-23163153), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/materials/bvb-alu/alumil-rom-industry-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Michail Sotiriou's ~24% personal stake (separate from the Alumil corporate parent's 55.9%) is the main individually-held/insider-type position identified; General Manager is Marius Ionita, but no separate management shareholding was disclosed in the sources found. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ro/materials/bvb-alu/alumil-rom-industry-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; the company is majority-controlled by its Greek parent (standard related-party/control structure for a controlled subsidiary, but no specific dispute or dilution event was found). Recent (2026) interim results showed improving profit and declining debt. [Bursa.ro](https://www.bursa.ro/cel-mai-bun-plasament-in-perioada-30-august-6-septembrie-avans-de-5-11-procente-pentru-alumil-rom-industry-65582538)

thesis.business_description: IDI (IDI S.C.A.) is a Paris-based private equity investment company making leveraged buyout (LBO) and growth-capital investments in small and mid-cap companies, primarily in France and Europe, investing both on its own balance sheet and for third parties.
thesis.competitive_position: IDI is a listed French private-equity holding vehicle with a multi-decade LBO/growth-capital track record; its structure as a société en commandite par actions (partnership limited by shares) gives its managing general partner, Ancelle & Associés, entrenched control regardless of the free float's wishes - an important governance feature for outside investors to understand. [AlphaValue - IDI company analysis](https://corporate.alphavalue.com/Secure/Handlers/LatestHandler/74b308ae-041d-ec11-8593-00155d3d3b01/IDI_24092021.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ancelle & Associés is the controlling managing general partner (gérant-commandité); an older capital-increase report showed Ancelle/Financière Neuilly Madrid's stake moving from 78.1% to 62.2% of capital (publication context suggests ~2008) ([TradingSat](https://www.tradingsat.com/idi-FR0000051393/actualites/idi-leve-578-millions-d-euros-par-augmentation-de-capital-387876.html)); a more recent indicative breakdown (as of 1 June 2026, approximate/not fully reconciled with threshold-crossing filings) shows insiders/related entities at roughly 70.2% and institutional investors at roughly 5.6% ([aggregator data cited via rendementbourse.com](https://rendementbourse.com/idip-idi/assemblee-generale)). FFP (the Peugeot family's holding company) was reported as the second-largest shareholder at 10.1% of capital as of January 2010 ([AMF filing, Jan 2010](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/CNS/2010/01/FCCNS024782_20100119.pdf)), and Allianz SE has also been named as a minority shareholder in an undated directory source - this should be verified against current AMF filings.
thesis.insider_ownership: IDI's management describes the company as controlled and majority-owned by its own teams via Ancelle & Associés; combined insider/related-party ownership is estimated around 70% per the most recent (approximate) breakdown found, making this an insider/management-controlled investment vehicle rather than a widely-held one. Figures should be cross-checked against IDI's annual report and AMF franchissements de seuils filings for precision.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the partnership (SCA) legal structure entrenches the managing general partner's control irrespective of free-float shareholder votes, which is a structural governance consideration (not a scandal) for minority investors.

thesis.business_description: INGRA d.d. is a Croatian construction and civil-engineering group, originally founded in 1955 as an export association for Yugoslav industrial manufacturers, that builds civil infrastructure and buildings including hydroelectric/thermoelectric plants, electricity distribution networks, factories, highways, bridges, tunnels, residential buildings, stadiums and hospitals; it has also begun developing hydrogen/renewable-energy projects with the University of Zagreb.
thesis.competitive_position: INGRA is a long-established Croatian infrastructure and civil-engineering contractor with a legacy international project portfolio from the former Yugoslavia; it is now fully privatized with a majority of small shareholders and is diversifying into renewable/hydrogen energy projects ([Ingra](https://ingra.hr/en/about-us/)).
thesis.main_shareholders: President of the Management Board Danko Deban (6.9%), Management Board member Dinko Pejković (6.7%), former Supervisory Board member Franjo Herceg (4.9%) ([Bloomberg Adria](https://hr.bloombergadria.com/trzista/burze/109268/ingra-kupila-cak-26-posto-vlastitih-dionica/news))
thesis.insider_ownership: Management insiders Danko Deban (6.9%) and Dinko Pejković (6.7%) together hold roughly 13.6% of shares, alongside former board member Franjo Herceg (4.9%); the remainder is broadly held by small shareholders ([Bloomberg Adria](https://hr.bloombergadria.com/trzista/burze/109268/ingra-kupila-cak-26-posto-vlastitih-dionica/news))
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; ownership is fragmented among small shareholders with no single controlling block, which can also mean limited strategic oversight.

thesis.business_description: Fynske Bank A/S is a Danish regional bank headquartered on the island of Funen, serving retail customers and small/medium-sized businesses through a local branch network plus online and mobile banking (deposits, loans, guarantees, securities trading, currency, and advice on financing, pensions and home purchases). Source: https://www.home.saxo/en-ch/markets/stocks/fynbk-xcse ; https://borsdata.se/en/fynske-bank/analysis
thesis.competitive_position: Small regional savings-bank-type lender concentrated on Funen and East Jutland, formed through consolidation of predecessor banks (including Vestfyns Bank and Svendborg Sparekasse); credit exposure is concentrated in local households, SMEs, real estate and agriculture typical of the region, giving it a defensible local-relationship niche but limited geographic diversification. Source: https://pickthebank.eu/banks/denmark/fynske-bank-as-vesbdk22/ ; https://www.home.saxo/en-sg/markets/stocks/fynbk-xcse
thesis.main_shareholders: We were unable to locate a current, named major-shareholder list from the bank's own announcements or annual report within this search; Danish-listed companies must publish 'storaktionærmeddelelse' flagging notices for holders crossing 5%, but we did not find a specific recent one for Fynske Bank in this round. An aggregator (Inderes/borsdata-linked figures) cites free float of roughly 1.9m of 7.6m shares outstanding, implying a majority is held by larger/insider holders, but names and percentages are not disclosed in the sources found. Not confirmed from an official filing — recommend checking the company's investor relations 'storaktionærer' page or Nasdaq Copenhagen company announcements directly.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; no governance, litigation or going-concern issues surfaced. Note: data availability on major shareholders was limited in public aggregators, which is itself a research gap rather than a confirmed red flag.

thesis.business_description: Guillemot Corporation S.A. is a French company designing and distributing computer hardware and gaming peripherals/accessories, including brands such as Thrustmaster and Hercules. [Guillemot Corporation - Encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/books/politics-and-business-magazines/guillemot-corporation)
thesis.competitive_position: Guillemot is a long-established, founder-family-run gaming hardware/peripherals maker; the Guillemot brothers also co-founded Ubisoft, giving the family deep roots in the video-game industry, though Guillemot Corporation itself is a smaller niche peripherals player relative to larger consumer electronics competitors. [Yves Guillemot - Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yves_Guillemot)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Guillemot family collectively controls a large majority of the company; individual family members' reported stakes include Michel Guillemot (~9.28%), the broader Guillemot Family entity (~8.34%), Gérard Guillemot (~7.46%), Yves Guillemot (~6.71%), the Estate of Claude Guillemot (~5.30%), Valentin Guillemot (~2.58%) and Christian Guillemot (~2.24%); more recent disclosures describe the family controlling around 72% of capital and 83% of voting rights. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GUILLEMOT-CORPORATION-5164/company-shareholders/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Insider ownership is very high and concentrated in the founding Guillemot family (five brothers: Claude, Michel, Gérard, Christian, Yves), who together control roughly 72% of capital / 83% of votes per recent disclosures. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/GUILLEMOT-CORPORATION-5164/company-shareholders/)
thesis.red_flags: No specific lawsuit or related-party-transaction controversy was identified in the sources searched; the company's heavy insider/family control (extending to Ubisoft overlap given the Guillemot brothers' dual roles) is worth monitoring for related-party dynamics but no documented dispute was found. [Guillemot Corporation half-year report 2022](https://www.guillemot.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/2022-HALF-YEAR-REPORT-30-06-2022-FINAL-1.pdf)

thesis.business_description: AEP Plantations Plc (formerly Anglo-Eastern Plantations Plc, renamed November 2025) is a UK-listed, FTSE 250-constituent plantation company that owns, operates and develops oil palm plantations in Indonesia and Malaysia, also producing rubber slabs and biogas; it recently completed the acquisition of PT AEP Pinago Plantations, adding 14,300 hectares and bringing total planted area to 87,392 hectares.
thesis.competitive_position: AEP is a long-established (founded 1985), sizeable palm-oil plantation operator with a growing planted area (87,392 hectares after its latest acquisition) across Indonesia and Malaysia, generating significant free cash flow that it has returned to shareholders via $25.9m in dividends and buybacks in its latest interim period; it is not a forestry/teak business as sometimes assumed, but a palm oil and rubber producer. [AEP Interim Report 30 June 2026](https://www.directorstalkinterviews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Interim-Report-30-June-2026_Final.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Genton International Limited is described as a significant/parent-level shareholder (per a 2022 chairman's statement and a company profile listing it as parent). Other large institutional holders per a Fidelity factsheet include Value Square NV, Dimensional Fund Advisors LP, and Sorbus Partners LLP (exact percentages and date not confirmed). Total issued ordinary shares stood at 399,762,720 as of a July 2026 buyback notice, including 16,862,208 shares held in treasury. [Fidelity factsheet](https://www.fidelity.co.uk/factsheet-data/factsheet/GB0000365774-aep-plantations-plc/profile), [AEP buyback notice](https://kalkinemedia.com/uk/news/announcements/aep-plantations-executes-buyback-of-56179-shares-at-17584-pence-average-price-on-24-july-2026)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed with specific individual percentages in sources found; Genton International Limited's relationship to company insiders/founders was not clarified in available sources. Could not verify.
thesis.red_flags: At the 2024 AGM, a notable number of shareholders opposed a resolution granting directors the power to allot equity without pre-emption rights; the company subsequently said it would consult shareholders on a case-by-case basis for specific transactions. This is a disclosed governance friction point worth monitoring, though not evidence of actual dilution having occurred. [TipRanks - AEP responds to shareholder concerns](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/aep-responds-to-shareholder-concerns-over-equity-allotment-resolution)

thesis.business_description: We.Connect SA is a French distributor that designs, manufactures and distributes computer, peripheral and electronic equipment to professional customers, including computers, monitors, multimedia products, storage products and accessories; formed in 2015 from the merger of Techniline and Groupe Unika.
thesis.competitive_position: A French B2B IT hardware distributor with approximately EUR 265 million in revenue and approximately EUR 12 million EBITDA (2023), operating in the low-margin, competitive IT distribution sector. [Alluvial Capital](https://alluvialcapital.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/ACM-We.Connect-Deck.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Gorsd brothers together hold over 80% of the company: Moshey Gorsd (CEO) holds approximately 53.2% and Yossef Gorsd (board member) holds approximately 23.6%. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/WE-CONNECT-162442/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Very high founder/insider ownership: CEO Moshey Gorsd and board member Yossef Gorsd together control over 80% of the company, making it effectively a founder-controlled business despite its public listing. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/WE-CONNECT-162442/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Mangata Holding S.A. is a Polish industrial holding company operating in three main segments: automotive-component forgings and machined parts (for automotive, agricultural and hydraulic industries), industrial valves and castings, and fasteners, exporting to roughly 70-75 countries.
thesis.competitive_position: Mangata is a diversified industrial-components manufacturer with automotive/machinery components generating roughly 58% of group revenue per investor commentary, giving it a broad international customer base across multiple end-markets (automotive, agriculture, hydraulics, valves, fasteners) that reduces single-sector dependency, though specific competitive/market-share positioning was not found. [Investor commentary cited in search](https://www.parkiet.com/spolka/Mangata_Holding)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is concentrated but sources disagree on specifics: Bankier's shareholder page reports two large shareholders together hold 70.73% of shares/votes (names not specified in the excerpt found); a separate Simply Wall St article reports Avallon Sp. z o.o. holding 63% with institutions holding 23%; other aggregators describe the parent as 'Capital MBO' (spelled variously as a limited company or limited partnership in different filings). Given these inconsistencies, the exact controlling entity and percentage could not be reliably confirmed in this search and should be checked against Mangata's current WSE filings. [Bankier.pl shareholder page](https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/MANGATA/akcjonariat), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/capital-goods/wse-mgt/mangata-holding-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not clearly disclosed in sources found; the dominant ~63-70% holder is described variously as Avallon Sp. z o.o. or 'Capital MBO' entities (possibly a management-buyout vehicle given the 'MBO' naming), which may imply meaningful management/insider participation, but this could not be confirmed with a specific named individual or percentage.
thesis.red_flags: Source inconsistency itself is worth flagging for diligence: multiple financial data aggregators give materially different ownership structures and parent-entity names for Mangata's controlling shareholder, which should be resolved against the company's own current-report (raport bieżący) disclosures on the Warsaw Stock Exchange before relying on any single figure. No specific litigation, dilution or auditor red flags were identified.

thesis.business_description: Jersey Electricity plc is the vertically integrated monopoly electricity utility for the island of Jersey, importing, generating, transmitting and distributing power (around 95% imported via three undersea cables from low-carbon French sources), alongside smaller businesses in building services, retail (Powerhouse), property and utility software/consultancy.
thesis.competitive_position: As the sole licensed electricity supplier to Jersey, JEL holds a regulated natural monopoly in its core market, generating over 80% of group revenue and operating profit from electricity; its diversified smaller units (retail, property, building services) provide modest additional earnings but the investment case is dominated by the regulated utility's stable cash flows. [Edison Investment Research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/strong-cash-generation/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The States of Jersey (the island's government) is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 62% of ordinary share capital and a disproportionately larger ~82-86% of voting rights (sources vary by year: 86.4% per a 2019 Edison note, 82% per a 2016 note). The remaining ~38% of shares trades on the London Stock Exchange among roughly 300 shareholders; institutional investor Utilico Ltd previously held just over 20% of ordinary share capital (per a 2008-dated States of Jersey proposition). [Edison Investment Research](https://www.edisongroup.com/research/jersey-electricity/15875/), [States Assembly proposition P.41/2009](https://statesassembly.je/publications/propositions/2009/p-41-2009)
thesis.insider_ownership: No specific director/management shareholding percentages were found in this search; given the dominant States of Jersey stake and dual-class voting structure, free-float insider ownership is likely small, but this could not be independently confirmed.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The dual-class structure (62% of capital commanding 82-86% of votes) concentrates control with the States of Jersey, which is disclosed and long-standing rather than a new governance concern.

thesis.business_description: BioPharma Credit PLC is a UK-listed closed-ended investment trust that provides debt financing (loans and royalty-backed credit) secured against cash flows from approved, commercialized life-sciences/pharmaceutical products, aiming to generate income for shareholders.
thesis.competitive_position: BioPharma Credit occupies a specialist niche in pharma royalty/credit lending, externally managed by Pharmakon Advisors LP (led by co-founder Pedro Gonzalez de Cosio), which sources and underwrites a diversified portfolio of approved-product-backed loans designed for cash-flow stability and downside protection versus equity biotech exposure. [BioPharma Credit Investor Update](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-December-2023.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: No major shareholder register was found in this search; as a UK investment trust, its shares are widely held by retail and institutional investors via the London Stock Exchange. The shares have traded at a persistent discount to NAV (e.g., -15.42% as of December 2023), prompting buybacks. [BioPharma Credit Investor Update Feb 2024](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-February-2024.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: Directors include Pedro Gonzalez de Cosio, Martin Friedman and Pablo Legorreta (all affiliated with Pharmakon Advisors, the investment manager) with Harry Hyman as independent Chairman; specific personal shareholding percentages for these directors were not found and, as an externally-managed investment trust, meaningful 'insider' equity ownership in the traditional operating-company sense is not typically disclosed or expected. [BioPharma Credit factsheet](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-May-2023.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: Shares have traded at a material discount to NAV (around -15% in late 2023/early 2024), which the company itself noted constrains its ability to make new investments while trading below NAV - a structural/valuation concern rather than a governance one. No litigation, auditor or related-party issues were identified. [BioPharma Credit Investor Update Feb 2024](https://bpcruk.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/BioPharma-Credit-PLC-Investor-Update-February-2024.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Lime Technologies AB is a Swedish company that develops and sells SaaS-based CRM (customer relationship management) software for the Nordic and broader European market, founded in 1990.
thesis.competitive_position: Lime is a leading Nordic CRM software vendor with over 450 employees and offices across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Finland, the Netherlands and Poland, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm Mid Cap; its ownership is broadly institutional with no single controlling shareholder. [MFN - Syringa Capital Lime Technologies statement](https://mfn.se/nir/a/lime-technologies/syringa-capital-sells-holding-in-lime-technologies-still-committed-and-large-owner-c4066c4a)
thesis.main_shareholders: Largest holders per recent aggregator data include Grenspecialisten AB (~10.2%), SEB Investment Management AB (~9.25%), Cliens Kapitalförvaltning AB (~9.13%), ODIN Forvaltning AS (~8.03%) and co-founder Erik Syrén (~8.83%) ([Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-lime/lime-technologies-shares/ownership)); Syringa Capital AB (chaired by Erik Syrén) sold part of its stake in 2024 but stated it remains one of the largest shareholders ([MFN/Inderes - Syringa Capital statement](https://inderes.se/releases/syringa-capital-sells-holding-in-lime-technologies-still-committed-and-large-owner)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Co-founder and chairman-linked holder Erik Syrén holds approximately 8.83% directly, with additional exposure via Syringa Capital AB (which he chairs); aggregate individual-insider ownership is estimated around 10.5% per Simply Wall St, and recent insider transactions (Lars Stugemo, Emil Hjalmarsson, Anders Hofvander) have skewed toward net buying. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-lime/lime-technologies-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Burelle SA is a French holding company whose principal asset is a majority stake in Compagnie Plastic Omnium, a global automotive-parts manufacturer (bumpers, body panels, fuel systems, and increasingly EV/hydrogen components).
thesis.competitive_position: Burelle's value is essentially a leveraged holding-company claim on Plastic Omnium, a top-tier global automotive exteriors/modules supplier; Burelle itself has no independent operating business, so its competitive position is entirely that of its subsidiary. [Wikipedia - Burelle](https://wikipedia.com/wiki/Burelle)
thesis.main_shareholders: Burelle SA holds approximately 60% of Compagnie Plastic Omnium as of August 2022 (87,322,342 shares, following Plastic Omnium's cancellation of 1.6 million treasury shares) ([AMF filing via journalauto.com](https://journalauto.com/industrie/pourquoi-plastic-omnium-annule-t-il-09-de-son-capital/)), up from 58.78% (2019) and 56.6% (2014); this stake has risen steadily over the past decade ([AMF disclosures compiled via Businesswire/journalauto](https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ECO/2022/08/FCECO068324_20220830.pdf)).
thesis.insider_ownership: Burelle SA is majority-owned by the Burelle family (descendants of Pierre Burelle, founder of Plastic Omnium); family control of Burelle SA itself rose from 80.9% to 85.4% in 2019 after a treasury-share cancellation, exercised historically through holding vehicles Sogec 2 and Compagnie Financière de la Cascade ([Wikipedia - Burelle](https://wikipedia.com/wiki/Burelle); 2019 AMF filing). The family's underlying economic interest in Plastic Omnium itself (as opposed to in Burelle SA) was reported at 50.17% in 2019.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; high family control concentration (>80% of Burelle SA) limits minority-shareholder influence but no governance dispute was found.

thesis.business_description: Criteo S.A. is a France-founded (recently converting its domicile to Luxembourg) commerce media and advertising technology company whose platform turns shopper/ecommerce data signals into personalized advertising, historically centered on dynamic product retargeting and now spanning demand-side, supply-side and retail-media monetization tools for retailers, brands and publishers.
thesis.competitive_position: Criteo built its original scale on ad retargeting powered by AI trained on roughly $1 trillion in annual ecommerce sales data, and has been diversifying into commerce/retail media as retargeting has declined in relative importance amid privacy changes (e.g., reduced reliance on third-party cookies) and competition from Google's search/display ecosystem; the company is currently the subject of a take-private approach, reflecting perceived undervaluation relative to private-market interest.
thesis.main_shareholders: Neuberger Berman Investment Advisers LLC (~15.82%), Morgan Stanley (~9.77%), DNB Asset Management AS (~9.22%), Senvest Management, LLC (~9.15%); institutional ownership overall ~83.95% ([TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/markets/stocks/crto/ownership))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~12.61% held by insiders in aggregate, per ownership-structure data; largest individual insider holder is Till Hufnagel at ~3.74%
thesis.red_flags: Known recent corporate action: Criteo is subject to a take-private approach from Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital at a reported 50%+ premium (implying ~$3.7bn equity value, >$50/share), submitted around the time of Criteo's shareholder-approved redomiciliation from France to Luxembourg (completed vote Feb 2026); the board has not yet decided how to respond, creating deal-completion and valuation uncertainty for the thesis. ([ppc.land](https://ppc.land/vista-equity-and-quinti-capital-offer-50-premium-for-criteo-sources-say/))

thesis.business_description: FRoSTA Aktiengesellschaft is a Bremerhaven-based German frozen food producer, developing, manufacturing and marketing frozen fish, vegetables, fruits, herbs and ready meals sold under the FRoSTA brand, private label, and foodservice channels across Germany, Poland, Austria, Italy and Eastern Europe.
thesis.competitive_position: FRoSTA is a well-established branded player in the German frozen-food category, known for its 'clean label' (additive-free) positioning that it pioneered roughly two decades ago, supplying both its own brand and private-label product to major retailers such as Aldi, Lidl and Norma - a differentiated niche versus lower-cost private-label-only competitors. [Emerald Insight case study](https://emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/978-1-80455-840-920231005)
thesis.main_shareholders: Controlled by the founding Ahlers family across three generations; sources disagree on exact current split - the company's own investor page cites Felix Ahlers 25.8% and Dirk Ahlers 10.0% (free float 56.3%), while the FAQ page cites Felix Ahlers at 33.7% and Dirk Ahlers at 10%; a 2015 trade report put their combined stake at 52.9%, and an academic case study describes family ownership at 'just under 50%.' The family is reported to hold a majority (over 50%) in at least two sources. [FRoSTA investor relations](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/investor-relations/facts-and-figures/), [FRoSTA FAQ](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/service/faq/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Management and control rest with the Ahlers family: Felix Ahlers is Chairman of the Executive Board & CEO, with a disclosed stake of either ~25.8% or ~33.7% depending on source/date; his father Dirk Ahlers (former CEO) holds ~10%; Friederike Ahlers handles public relations for the family. This is a classic founder/family-controlled structure now in its third generation. [FRoSTA investor relations](https://www.frosta-ag.com/en/investor-relations/facts-and-figures/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The inconsistency in publicly stated family ownership percentages across the company's own IR page, FAQ, and media reports (ranging ~26% to ~53%+) is a data-quality/disclosure-clarity note worth flagging for diligence, though not evidence of wrongdoing.

thesis.business_description: James Latham plc, whose trading subsidiary is Lathams Ltd, is a trade-only importer and distributor of timber, panels and decorative surfaces (hardwoods, softwoods, plywood, MDF, OSB, decking, cladding, laminates, veneers) to contractors, merchants, joiners and designers across the UK and Ireland from a network of around 12 depots; the business traces its roots to 1757 in Liverpool. In the year to 31 March 2026 revenue rose 7.2% to GBP 393.0m and pre-tax profit to GBP 25.1m. Sources: https://lathamtimber.co.uk/about-us/what-we-do ; https://lathamtimber.co.uk/about-us/our-history ; https://www.rttnews.com/3664241/james-latham-fy26-profit-rises-lifts-dividend-sees-improved-margin-in-fy27-stock-up.aspx
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as one of the UK's and Ireland's largest independent trade distributors of timber and panel products, with a long-standing family-run culture and a broad stocked range. FY26 growth was volume-led (like-for-like volumes +7.7%) while gross margin eased to 16.5% from 16.8% on competitive pressure and mix; it is building a new National Distribution Centre (completion expected end-2026, full operation by end-2027). Balance sheet is strong with GBP 51.2m cash, and revenue for April-July 2026 was up 9.8% to GBP 146m, partly helped by supplier price increases. Sources: https://www.lathamtimber.co.uk/ ; https://www.hl.co.uk/shares/stock-market-news/aim-and-small-cap-news/aim-bulletin/archive/james-latham-posts-higher-annual-profit-on-improved-revenue,-volumes ; https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/agm-statement-g97x43fmwnkzrhk.html
thesis.main_shareholders: Family-influenced register, but no single controlling holder found. Regulatory notices: Peter Latham held 1,016,289 shares (5.04%) after transferring 200,000 shares to family members (September 2025); Close Asset Management held 1,295,147 shares (6.42%) per a July 2024 notification. CONFLICT: Simply Wall St (aggregator, undated) lists Peter Douglas Latham at about 12.7% (3,523,949 shares) and Latham family members Piers 3.65%, Robert 2.46% and Nicholas 2.35%, which do not reconcile with the RNS figures - possibly due to aggregating family/trust holdings. Could not locate the company's own current substantial-shareholder table in this search; treat as a research gap. Sources: https://sharesmagazine.co.uk/news/market/LSE20250905143259_5810171/holdings-in-company ; https://sharesmagazine.co.uk/news/market/LSE20240725141811_5281795/holdings-in-company ; https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/capital-goods/aim-lthm/james-latham-shares/ownership
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. Standard caveats: cyclical exposure to UK construction and RMI demand, which management described as 'patchy'; gross margin pressure from competition; the chair flagged supply-chain and price effects from the Middle East conflict that started in February 2026 for FY27; capex on the new National Distribution Centre carries execution risk; family influence on the board. Sources: https://www.ajbell.co.uk/news/articles/earnings-and-trading-james-latham-says-customer-demand-quite-patchy ; https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/agm-statement-g97x43fmwnkzrhk.html
thesis.insider_ownership: Latham family directors hold meaningful stakes: Chairman Nick Latham 653,794 shares (3.24%) and Executive Director Piers Latham 650,115 shares (3.22%) per PDMR notices (September 2025 / January 2026, including Share Incentive Plan allocations). Former director Peter Latham held 5.04% (September 2025 notice). Combined wider family ownership is likely higher but could not be verified from an official consolidated figure. Sources: https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/LTHM/pdmr-dealings-f0sajkkw811s7e6.html ; https://www.ticker.app/lse/LTHM/rns/2025-09-04/PDMR-Dealings/0331Y ; https://sharesmagazine.co.uk/news/market/LSE20250905143259_5810171/holdings-in-company

thesis.business_description: Talenom Oyj is a Finnish accounting and financial administration services company for small and medium-sized enterprises, founded in 1972 by Paavo and Anneli Tahkola, headquartered in Oulu, and operating in Finland, Sweden, Spain and Italy; it listed on Nasdaq Helsinki in June 2015.
thesis.competitive_position: Talenom is a technology-driven, scaled accounting-services provider for SMEs that has expanded internationally (Sweden, Spain, Italy) beyond its Finnish base, differentiating itself from smaller traditional accounting firms through digital/automated bookkeeping tools; specific market-share data was not found in this search.
thesis.main_shareholders: The founding Tahkola family remains the largest shareholder group: Harri Tahkola holds approximately 17.2% and Markus Tahkola holds approximately 10.6% per Simply Wall St snapshots (dated 2024-2025). Institutional holders include Danske Capital Denmark (~7.56%), Sp-Rahastoyhtiö Oy (~5.22%), with SEB Investment Management and Allianz each in the 3-5% range. Top 25 shareholders control approximately 78.95% of the company. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/commercial-services/bats-chixe-tnomh/talenom-oyj-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder-family members Harri Tahkola (~17.2%) and Markus Tahkola (~10.6%) together hold a substantial combined stake (~27.8%), reflecting continued strong founder-family influence since Paavo and Anneli Tahkola founded the company in 1972; note that different source pages show inconsistent 'individual insiders' aggregate figures (1.46% vs 18.7%), which cannot be reconciled with the named Tahkola stakes and should be treated with caution. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/commercial-services/bats-chixe-tnomh/talenom-oyj-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note the internal inconsistency across Simply Wall St's own listing pages regarding aggregate insider ownership percentages, a data-quality caveat rather than a company-specific governance issue.

thesis.business_description: Sjóvá-Almennar tryggingar hf. is one of Iceland's leading insurance companies, offering property/casualty, motor, marine and other general insurance products to retail and commercial customers, listed on Nasdaq Iceland.
thesis.competitive_position: Sjóvá is one of a small number of established insurers in Iceland's concentrated domestic insurance market, giving it meaningful domestic market share; specific market-share figures were not found in this search. [Snowball Analytics](https://snowball-analytics.com/public/asset/SJOVA.IC.ISK)
thesis.main_shareholders: Historical ownership: in 2011, the Central Bank of Iceland's asset-management arm ESÍ sold 52.4% of outstanding shares (834,481,001 shares) to SF1 slhf., a limited partnership managed by Stefnir hf., retaining a 20.6% stake itself at the time. This is a 2011 snapshot and current ownership could not be confirmed from available sources. [Central Bank of Iceland](https://cb.is/publications/news/news/2011/07/28/ESÍ-sells-stake-in-Sjóvá-Almennar-tryggingar)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in sources found; no current management/board shareholding data was located. Could not verify.
thesis.red_flags: Could not verify current state; no specific current governance concerns were found, but the 2011 sale followed Sjóvá's 2009-2010 financial difficulties and government-backed recapitalization during Iceland's post-financial-crisis banking restructuring, a historical event worth noting for context though not a current-state red flag. [Central Bank of Iceland](https://cb.is/publications/news/news/2011/07/28/ESÍ-sells-stake-in-Sjóvá-Almennar-tryggingar)

thesis.business_description: Sunex S.A. is a Racibórz, Poland-based manufacturer of renewable-heating equipment, including heat pumps, solar thermal collectors, thermosiphons, storage tanks, pump groups and related mounting systems; founded in 2002.
thesis.competitive_position: Sunex operates in the European heat pump/renewable heating equipment market, which an October 2024 IPOPEMA research note described as facing 'extremely difficult' market conditions, suggesting the company is a smaller regional manufacturer navigating a cyclical downturn in European heat-pump demand rather than holding a clearly dominant competitive position. [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per an October 2024 IPOPEMA research note: Polska Ekologia Sp. z o.o. holds approximately 43.84%, CEO Romuald Kałyciok holds approximately 24.68% individually, and other holders collectively hold approximately 31.48%. Some aggregators describe Sunex as a subsidiary of Polska Ekologia, though Polska Ekologia's ~44% stake alone is not a formal majority. [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO and President of the Management Board Romuald Kałyciok personally holds approximately 24.68% of shares, a substantial founder/management-level stake, in addition to his control influence over Polska Ekologia (the largest corporate shareholder at ~43.84%). [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: The European heat pump market was described as facing 'extremely difficult' conditions as of October 2024, a sector-wide demand headwind rather than a company-specific governance issue; no litigation, dilution or auditor concerns were identified. [IPOPEMA research note](https://biznes.pap.pl/download/attachment/49778186/DOC.20241010.49778186.20241010_0811_SNX_EN_RA.pdf)

thesis.business_description: FBD Holdings plc is an Irish general insurer, founded in the 1960s by and for farmers, now providing motor, home, farm and business insurance to farmers, businesses and retail customers across Ireland; it is the only major general insurer incorporated and based in Ireland.
thesis.competitive_position: FBD holds a dominant position in the Irish farm insurance niche - commanding over 70% (per a 2024 Cantor Fitzgerald note) to as much as 80% (per older reporting) market share of the farm segment - reflecting deep historical roots and a farmer-ownership heritage that differentiates it from internationally-owned competitors in the broader Irish general insurance market. [Cantor Fitzgerald analyst note](https://cantorfitzgerald.ie/analyst-conviction-list-fbd-insurance), [Farmers Journal](https://www.farmersjournal.ie/dempsey-at-large-the-co-op-share-dilemma-872880)
thesis.main_shareholders: A farmer-owned holding entity retains what has been described as a blocking stake of around 24.6-25% in FBD Holdings, with transfer of these shares tightly restricted similar to a cooperative structure, intended to preserve farmer influence over the insurer; some farmer-shareholders have periodically pushed to sell this stake (estimated proceeds of ~€140m in one account) and distribute proceeds. These figures are from Irish Farmers Journal reporting dated 2014 and later commentary, and may not reflect the current precise percentage. [Farmers Journal - the co-op share dilemma](https://www.farmersjournal.ie/dempsey-at-large-the-co-op-share-dilemma-872880)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed with specific current board/management percentages in sources found beyond the farmer-holding-entity structure described above; could not verify individual director stakes.
thesis.red_flags: Storm Éowyn (January 2025) was described by FBD itself as the largest weather event in the company's history, driving ~9,000 claims and a net cost (after reinsurance) of approximately €30.8m for full-year 2025, contributing to a pretax profit decline to €54.1m (from €77.0m) and a combined ratio rising to 90.8% (from 84.9%); this is a disclosed catastrophe-claims event rather than a governance red flag, but is material to near-term earnings volatility. There is also an ongoing, publicly aired internal debate among farmer-shareholders about whether to sell the ~25% farmer-held blocking stake, a governance/strategic tension worth monitoring. [FBD 2025 Full Year Results Statement](https://www.fbdgroup.com/media/fbdgroup/files/2025_Full_Year_Results_Statement.pdf), [Farmers Journal](https://www.farmersjournal.ie/dempsey-at-large-the-co-op-share-dilemma-872880)

thesis.business_description: Netcall plc is a UK software company providing cloud-based customer engagement and process automation software, principally its Liberty platform (omnichannel contact centre, workforce optimisation) and MATS low-code application platform, sold to healthcare (including NHS trusts), telecoms, financial services and local government customers.
thesis.competitive_position: Netcall is a mid-sized, profitable AIM-listed software vendor with deep penetration into the UK public sector and NHS (serving roughly two-thirds of NHS Acute Health Trusts) and blue-chip accounts such as BT, Lloyds Banking Group, ITV and Nationwide, giving it a defensible niche in regulated/public-sector contact-centre and low-code workflow software rather than scale versus global CCaaS players. [Netcall company profile / investegate](https://investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/netcall--net/director-pdmr-shareholding/1910727)
thesis.main_shareholders: Institutional/VC holders dominate the register: Gresham House Asset Management (WS Gresham House UK Micro Cap Fund) around 24%, Rathbones/Investec Wealth & Investment collectively near the 10% notifiable threshold, Octopus Investments around 7-14% (sources vary by date), Liontrust around 6%, and Business Growth Fund (BGF) around 4-6%; Artemis Investment Management notified at 3.27%. Figures come from different dated snapshots and should be checked against the latest RNS holdings notices. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-net/netcall-shares/ownership), [Investegate holdings RNS](https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/netcall--net/holding-s-in-company/1609392)
thesis.insider_ownership: Henrik Bang, long-serving CEO (joined 2004) and now Non-Executive Chairman (since Jan 2024), holds roughly 2.6% (~4.46m shares), though he sold ~1.7m shares in January 2025. Chairman predecessor Michael Jackson held about 0.84% (1.2m shares) as of a December 2018 disclosure. No named founder's stake was identified (company incorporated 1984 as Ackrill Carr plc). Aggregate individual-insider ownership is estimated at roughly 5% of the register by Simply Wall St. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/software/aim-net/netcall-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. Recent RNS disclosures describe routine board succession (new CFO and NED appointed, 2023) and standard governance-strengthening statements; no litigation, dilution, or auditor concerns surfaced in search. [LSE RNS - Result of AGM](https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/result-of-agm-d8u3bkb15kb7845.html)

thesis.business_description: SLOMAN NEPTUN Schiffahrts-Aktiengesellschaft is a Bremen-based German shipping company (founded 1873) that owns and operates a fleet of gas tankers, oil/chemical tankers and dry cargo vessels worldwide, and also offers liner and port agency services.
thesis.competitive_position: SLOMAN NEPTUN is a long-established (152-year-old) niche shipowner/operator specializing in gas and chemical/product tankers (capacities up to 35,000 DWT) and a founding member of the UNIGAS Consortium (since 1969) for gas shipping cooperation, giving it an established position in specialized tanker segments rather than bulk/container shipping scale. [SLOMAN NEPTUN - About Us](https://sloman-neptun.com/about-us)
thesis.main_shareholders: The company is a subsidiary of Rob. M. Sloman & Co., per third-party aggregator data; it is a thinly-traded Hamburg-exchange-listed stock (2.00m shares outstanding) and the company's own site states that shareholder information is published only in German, limiting English-language verification of the full register. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/transportation/hmse-nep/sloman-neptun-schiffahrts-aktiengesellschaft-shares/information)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not disclosed in sources found in English; given the Rob. M. Sloman & Co. parent/controlling relationship, insider and family (Sloman family legacy name) control appears likely but could not be independently quantified from available English-language sources. Could not verify specific percentages.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources, though the limited English-language disclosure (shareholder information published only in German) and thin free float/trading on the smaller Hamburg exchange reduce transparency for non-German-speaking investors - a diligence consideration rather than a confirmed governance issue.

thesis.business_description: Merkur PrivatBank KGaA is a Munich-based, owner-managed German private bank with a dual-pillar model: wealth management for private individuals, families and foundations, and specialized financing for medium-sized enterprises, property developers, real estate investors and leasing companies.
thesis.competitive_position: A small, niche private bank rather than a scale player; it competes on owner-managed continuity and specialist mid-market/real-estate financing rather than breadth, and has been listed since 1999. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MERKUR-PRIVATBANK-KGAA-436821/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Operates as a KGaA (partnership limited by shares) with the Lingel family as personally liable partners holding significant control; Marcus Lingel is reported to hold around 25% of shares. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MERKUR-PRIVATBANK-KGAA-436821/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: The Lingel family maintains control as personally liable general partners of the KGaA structure, with Marcus Lingel holding approximately 25% of shares; remainder held across roughly 40 owners including free float. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MERKUR-PRIVATBANK-KGAA-436821/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; no specific litigation, governance disputes or auditor concerns surfaced in available search results.

name: ECO Animal Health Group plc
gmSourceUrl: [ECO Animal Health Group plc Annual Report 2024](https://ecoanimalhealth.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/ECO-Animal-Health_Group-plc_Annual_Report_2024_FINAL.pdf)

thesis.business_description: ECO Animal Health Group plc is a UK-based international animal health company that develops, manufactures and markets medicines for livestock and companion animals, with a focus on anti-infectives (e.g., its tylvalosin/Aivlosin product line).
thesis.competitive_position: ECO Animal Health is a specialist, mid-sized player in the global animal-health pharmaceuticals market with an established anti-infective franchise, competing against larger diversified animal-health companies; its recent expansion of product range (2024) suggests ongoing efforts to broaden its niche. [Morningstar UK news](https://morningstar.co.uk/uk/news/AN_1721044186703528500/eco-animal-targets-sustained-growth-with-expanded-product-range.aspx)
thesis.main_shareholders: Schroder Investment Management Limited holds approximately 17.4%; Soros Fund Management LLC holds approximately 11.2%; founder Peter Lawrence holds approximately 9.59%; Fidelity International Ltd holds approximately 6.91%; Killik & Co LLP has been notified as crossing 3.0138% of total voting rights. Figures are from a Simply Wall St (S&P Global-sourced) snapshot that may not reflect the most current register. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/pharmaceuticals-biotech/aim-eah/eco-animal-health-group-shares/ownership), [TipRanks - Killik threshold notice](https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/eco-animal-health-group-sees-shift-in-major-shareholdings)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Peter Anthony Lawrence (director of predecessor ECO Animal Health Ltd. from 1991-2019, and Non-Executive Chairman of the group 2018-2019) holds approximately 9.59% - a meaningful founder stake. CEO David Hallas (appointed April 2022) has made insider purchases, including a ~£20,000 buy on 25 April 2025. Aggregate individual-insider ownership is reported at roughly 10.1% of the register. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/gb/pharmaceuticals-biotech/aim-eah/eco-animal-health-group-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search.

thesis.business_description: ANY Biztonsági Nyomda Nyrt. (formerly Állami Nyomda Nyrt., 'State Printing House') is a Hungarian security printing company producing banknote-grade secure documents, identity/travel documents, meal vouchers and related security printing products, listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: ANY holds an entrenched position in Hungarian security/government printing given its state-printing-house legacy, and has diversified into commercial products such as meal vouchers; specific market-share data was not found, but its historical role as the former state printer suggests incumbency advantages in government security-document contracts. [Privatbankar.hu](https://privatbankar.hu/cikkek/kkv/830-millioert-nyomjak-az-etkezesi-utalvanyokat-261607.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Dr. Ákos Erdős, board chairman, held a combined stake (via EG Capital LLC and Fortunarum Kft.) of approximately 2.3 million shares as of a July 2023 disclosure (up from ~2.2 million shares in a November 2016 disclosure); against a rough market-cap-derived share count estimate (~14 million shares, not independently confirmed), this would imply roughly 16%, but this percentage is an approximation and not a confirmed, sourced figure. Gábor Zsámboki (CEO) held approximately 143,900 shares and György Gyergyák held 200,000 shares per the 2016 disclosure. [Company 2023 disclosure via BET](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/128925477/ANY230718ER01H.pdf), [Company 2016 disclosure via BET](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/122864167/ANY161121ER01H.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: Chairman Dr. Ákos Erdős is the most significant disclosed insider holder, with his EG Capital/Fortunarum combined stake described above; CEO Gábor Zsámboki's holding (~143,900 shares as of 2016) is comparatively small. Current, up-to-date percentages could not be confirmed. [BET company disclosures](https://bet.hu/newkibdata/128925477/ANY230718ER01H.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; however, shareholder data found is dated (2016 and 2023 snapshots) and a current register should be checked directly.

thesis.business_description: Micro Systemation AB (MSAB) is a Swedish software company providing digital forensics and mobile device data-extraction technology (e.g., XRY) used by law enforcement, government and corporate investigators worldwide.
thesis.competitive_position: MSAB is a recognized specialist/niche leader in mobile forensics software for law enforcement and intelligence customers globally, a position built over many years, though it faces competition from other digital-forensics vendors (e.g., Cellebrite) and sources did not quantify relative market share. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/software/sto-msab-b/micro-systemation-shares/ownership)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is concentrated among a handful of funds/family vehicles following a 2021 share sale: AB Grenspecialisten, Edastra AB/Ltd and Cervantes Capital AB jointly acquired founder Henrik Tjernberg's A-shares in April 2021. Per Inderes (Millistream): Alcur Select ~18.4% of capital/12.5% of votes, Nordnet Pensionsförsäkring ~10.2%/6.9%, AB Grenspecialisten ~9.9% capital/23.5% votes (reflecting A-share voting power), Edastra Ltd ~6.5%/15.5%. [Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Micro-Systemation/ownership), [MSAB press release - 2021 ownership change](https://investors.msab.com/investors/newsroom/press-releases/2021/change-of-ownership-in-micro-systemation-ab/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Henrik Tjernberg sold his entire A-share (high-vote) stake in April 2021 to AB Grenspecialisten, Edastra and Cervantes Capital, meaning founder ownership has effectively ended; individual-insider ownership in Simply Wall St's category breakdown is roughly 1% of the register, with the register now dominated by funds and family investment vehicles (Grenspecialisten and Edastra hold outsized voting power via A-shares). [MSAB press release](https://investors.msab.com/investors/newsroom/press-releases/2021/change-of-ownership-in-micro-systemation-ab/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The 2021 sale of the founder's entire voting stake to a small group of holders concentrated A-share voting control (e.g., Grenspecialisten ~23.5% of votes vs ~9.9% of capital) - a dual-class control-concentration structure worth noting for governance diligence, though disclosed and not itself a violation. [MSAB press release](https://investors.msab.com/investors/newsroom/press-releases/2021/change-of-ownership-in-micro-systemation-ab/)

thesis.business_description: Björn Borg AB is a Swedish sports and fashion brand company that owns and licenses the Björn Borg trademark globally for apparel, underwear, footwear, eyewear and accessories, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2007.
thesis.competitive_position: Björn Borg AB fully owns the Björn Borg trademark (having acquired full rights from the tennis legend and the Dutch licensing entity Fabulous Licensing for 124 million kronor / ~$18 million in the mid-2000s) and operates as a brand management/licensing company in sports fashion, distinct from Björn Borg the person, who reportedly holds no equity stake in the company today. [Kullin.net](https://www.kullin.net/?p=501)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Inderes (Millistream data): Nordnet Pension ~16.1%, Martin Bjäringer ~9.9%, Mats H Nilsson ~6.5%, Thomas Eklund ~5.6%, Vilhelm Schottenius (with family) ~5.6%, Avanza Pension ~5.3%, Lazard Frères Banque ~5.2%, Fredrik Lövstedt (via company) ~3.6%. Top 25 shareholders control approximately 85.85% of the company per Simply Wall St. [Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.dk/en/companies/Bjorn-Borg/ownership), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/consumer-durables/sto-borg/bjorn-borg-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Simply Wall St categorizes 'individual insiders' at approximately 41.9% of the register, which appears to include large individual holders such as Martin Bjäringer (~9.9%), Mats H Nilsson (~6.5%) and Vilhelm Schottenius with family (~5.6%) rather than company founder Björn Borg himself, who is reported (via a secondary/lower-authority source) to hold no equity in the company - his name is used solely under license. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/consumer-durables/sto-borg/bjorn-borg-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Atlanta Poland S.A. is a Gdańsk-based company that trades, processes and retails nuts and dried fruits for the confectionery and bakery industries, and sells sweets and dried fruit products under its own Bakal and Kujawianka brands; founded in 1990.
thesis.competitive_position: Atlanta Poland is an established, long-running Polish nut/dried-fruit processor and brand owner (Bakal, Kujawianka) serving both B2B (confectionery/bakery) and retail consumer channels, giving it diversified demand but exposure to volatile global soft-commodity (nuts, dried fruit) input costs. [Yahoo Finance company profile](https://au.finance.yahoo.com/quote/ATP.WA/profile?p=ATP.WA)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder Dariusz Mazur controls the company with a dominant stake, held indirectly through Rockfield Holding AG and Rockfield Jurata Sp. z o.o.: a 2021 disclosure put this combined holding at 3,627,888 shares (59.55% of capital and votes); an August 2026 investor-site snapshot shows Mazur at 59.47%, Dariusz Orłowski at 9.99%, Generali OFE at 7.58%, and Paweł Cichosz at 6.39% (together 83.43%, free float 16.57%). [Parkiet ESPI notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26739911-atlantapl-powolanie-osob-nadzorujacych), [Strefainwestorow.pl shareholder table](https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLATLPL00018/akcjonariat)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Dariusz Mazur is both the controlling shareholder (~59-60%, held via Rockfield entities) and described in company disclosures as the company's founder and indirect main shareholder - a clear founder-controlled structure. [Parkiet ESPI notice](https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art26739911-atlantapl-powolanie-osob-nadzorujacych)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources beyond the standard concentration-of-control considerations inherent in a ~60% founder-controlled free float structure; no litigation, dilution or auditor issues were found in this search.

thesis.business_description: Kofola ČeskoSlovensko a.s. is a Czech/Slovak beverage company producing and distributing soft drinks (including its Kofola cola brand), bottled water, and, following an acquisition, beer (it bought the Czech Republic's fifth-largest brewery group), listed on the Prague Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: Kofola holds a strong, differentiated position in the Czech and Slovak beverage market through its namesake cola brand (a historic local alternative to Coca-Cola/Pepsi dating to the communist era) and has diversified into brewing via acquisition, giving it a broadened beverage portfolio across Central Europe. [Inside.Beer - brewery acquisition](https://www.inside.beer/news/detail/czech-republic-soft-drink-maker-buys-the-countries-fifth-largest-brewery-group)
thesis.main_shareholders: Jannis Samaras, executive Group CEO, controls a majority stake via AETOS together with his family, reported at 67.22% per a December 2019 investor presentation; AETOS became majority owner of the Kofola Group in 2017, acquiring a ~68% stake from the company's then-second-largest shareholder, CED Group (which held 37.3%). A more recent, undated Simply Wall St snapshot lists KSM Investment S.A. as the largest named holder at approximately 75.5% (top 4 holders together ~75.5%); whether KSM Investment is the same vehicle as, or affiliated with, Samaras/AETOS could not be confirmed in this search. [Kofola investor presentation Dec 2019](https://investor.kofola.cz/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/ir-meeting-v-ceske-sporitelne-a-s-12-12-2019-en.pdf), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/cz/food-beverage-tobacco/sep-kofol/kofola-ceskoslovensko-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: CEO Jannis Samaras is also the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 67.22% via AETOS together with his family as of the 2019 disclosure - a strong owner-operator/insider-control structure, though no source in this search explicitly described him as the company's founder. [Kofola investor presentation](https://investor.kofola.cz/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/ir-meeting-v-ceske-sporitelne-a-s-12-12-2019-en.pdf)
thesis.red_flags: A 2022 shareholder restructuring was announced (details not fully retrieved in this search - see ESM Magazine source) and a compulsory buyout of a 0.2% minority stake at 57 PLN/share was reported by a Polish financial outlet, both of which are minority-squeeze-out-type corporate actions worth reviewing directly given the concentrated ~67-75% controlling stake. [ESM Magazine - shareholder restructuring](https://www.esmmagazine.com/a-brands/kofola-ceskoslovensko-shareholders-44422), [Forsal.pl - compulsory buyout](https://forsal.pl/artykuly/906668,kofola-cs-oglosila-przymusowy-wykup-02-proc-akcji-spolki-kofola-po-57-zl-szt.html)

thesis.business_description: NSE S.A. is a French designer and manufacturer of integrated systems for the defense, aerospace, aeronautics, electronics, IT and telecommunications sectors, headquartered in Nizerolles, France (founded 1983), covering onboard wiring, cockpit electronics, flight recorders, night-vision systems, and aircraft retrofit/geolocation, plus MRO services. Source: https://marketcapof.com/fr/stocks/alnse.pa/revenue/ ; https://fr.investing.com/equities/nse-industries
thesis.competitive_position: Small-cap niche supplier to defense/aerospace OEMs and operators in France, combining systems design with MRO/retrofit services, which supports recurring revenue; FY2023 revenue reported at ~$85.1m, up from ~$70.3m in 2022, and TTM revenue to Dec 2025 of ~$128.5m, indicating strong recent growth tied to defense-sector demand. Source: https://marketcapof.com/fr/stocks/alnse.pa/revenue/
thesis.main_shareholders: Per aggregated shareholder data for Euronext Growth Paris-listed ALNSE, the holding vehicle NSE Participations holds approximately 60.0% of shares, and Crédit Mutuel Equity SCR holds approximately 20.8%; institutional investors overall hold ~80.8%, with listed companies/individuals holding ~17.8%. Source: https://fr.investing.com/equities/nse-industries (snapshot date unclear — not confirmed against an official AMF/company filing in this search; recommend checking the company's own actionnariat page or AMF TR-1 threshold-crossing notices for current figures). The company sold 120,000 treasury shares (~3.5% of capital) in May 2025 via accelerated bookbuild. Source: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/nse-annonce-le-succes-de-l-operation-de-cession-de-120-000-actions-auto-detenues_664184
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; majority control sits with the founding/holding vehicle NSE Participations plus a private-equity minority (Crédit Mutuel Equity SCR), a structure typical of French family-controlled small caps rather than a specific red flag. The May 2025 treasury-share placement diluted free float slightly but was disclosed and priced via a standard accelerated bookbuild. Source: https://www.abcbourse.com/marches/nse-annonce-le-succes-de-l-operation-de-cession-de-120-000-actions-auto-detenues_664184

thesis.business_description: eQ Oyj is a Helsinki-based Finnish investment group operating through three segments: Asset Management (mutual, private-equity, hedge and real-estate funds plus discretionary portfolio management via eQ Asset Management and eQ Fund Management), Corporate Finance (M&A, real-estate transaction and equity capital markets advisory), and Investments (private-equity fund commitments from its own balance sheet). Source: https://tracenable.com/company/eq/group-entities ; https://dividend.watch/screener/financial-services/asset-management/eqv1v-he
thesis.competitive_position: Independent, non-bank-owned Finnish asset manager and fund-of-funds investor with a multi-decade private-equity fund-investing track record across Northern Europe and North America (typically funds sized €50-500m), differentiating it from Nordic bank-owned asset managers; the group was formerly named Amanda Capital Oyj. Source: https://tracenable.com/company/eq/group-entities
thesis.main_shareholders: eQ's own July 2025 stock-exchange release on its Shareholders' Nomination Committee names its four largest shareholders as Fennogens Investments S.A., Rettig Group Oy Ab, Chilla Capital S.A. and Teamet Oy, each entitled to appoint one committee member. Source: https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/eq-plc-managers-transactions-fennogens-investments-sa-1. Third-party aggregators give approximate stakes: Inderes/Millistream cites Fennogens Investments S.A. at ~18.7% and Rettig Group Oy Ab at ~14.6%; Simply Wall St cites slightly higher figures (~19.5% and ~15.3% respectively) and states the top 25 shareholders hold ~83% of the company. Source: https://www.inderes.fi/en/companies/eQ/ownership ; https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/diversified-financials/hel-eqv1v/eq-oyj-shares/ownership. eQ's 2026 board nomination materials disclose that board member Georg Ehrnrooth is 'not independent of the company's significant shareholder Fennogens Investments S.A.', where he is a major owner — tying the Ehrnrooth family to the Fennogens stake. Source: https://www.eq.fi/~/media/files/konserni/yhtiok/2026/eq-oyj_ehdotettu-hallituskokoonpano-2026.pdf. We did not find an exact, dated percentage for Fennogens/Rettig directly from a company flagging notice in this search; aggregator figures should be treated as approximate.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; ownership is dispersed among several family/investment-company holders (Fennogens/Ehrnrooth family, Rettig family, Chilla Capital, Teamet) rather than a single controlling shareholder, which is a governance positive rather than a flag. Source: https://www.inderes.fi/en/releases/eq-plc-managers-transactions-fennogens-investments-sa-1

thesis.business_description: ATM Grupa S.A. is Poland's largest independent television and film production company, producing series, entertainment programs, films and game shows for major Polish broadcasters (Polsat, TVP, TV4) and international partners, and also operates studio/post-production facilities (ATM Studio, ATM FX), real-estate development, and a stake in mobile-games producer BoomBit. Source: https://Www.wikipedia.org/wiki/ATM_Grupa ; https://www.money.pl/gielda/spolki-gpw/PLATM0000021,o_firmie.html
thesis.competitive_position: Largest independent TV/film producer in Poland and the only listed company in the Polish audiovisual sector, with an estimated ~14% share of a market worth roughly PLN 750m (dated figure); vertically integrated with its own studios, OB vans and post-production/VFX capability, which differentiates it from smaller independent producers, but the core production business is a small-headcount operation (18-33 employees per different aggregator snapshots). Source: https://Www.wikipedia.org/wiki/ATM_Grupa
thesis.main_shareholders: Per ATM Grupa's own current report on the shareholder list from its Annual General Meeting held 26 May 2026 (reported via Parkiet/ESPI), Kurzewski Investment S.à r.l. held 56,730,000 votes = 74.21% of votes present at that AGM and 52.87% of total voting rights; Nationale-Nederlanden OFE held 7.60% of total votes; PKO TFI funds held a combined 5.91%; Generali OFE held 4.87%. Source: https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44457881-atm-grupa-s-a-lista-akcjonariuszy-na-zwza-odbytym-w-dniu-26-maja-2026-r-z-liczba-glosow-powyzej-5 . Separately, Biznesradar reports a Cyprus-based investment vehicle linked to Zygmunt Solorz holding ~17.4% of shares, a figure that does not appear on the AGM list (possibly reflecting capital vs. votes-present differences) — source: https://www.biznesradar.pl/wiadomosci/ATM-GRUPA (not independently confirmed against an official filing in this search).
thesis.red_flags: Concentrated control by the Kurzewski family/Kurzewski Investment (>50% of total voting rights) creates minority-shareholder dependence on the controlling family's decisions; the unreconciled discrepancy between the AGM-disclosed shareholder list and third-party reports of a separate ~17.4% Solorz-linked stake warrants independent verification via GPW ESPI filings. Source: https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44457881-atm-grupa-s-a-lista-akcjonariuszy-na-zwza-odbytym-w-dniu-26-maja-2026-r-z-liczba-glosow-powyzej-5

thesis.business_description: EnviTec Biogas AG, headquartered in Lohne, Germany and founded in 2002, covers the full biogas value chain: plant construction, service/biological support, and operation of its own biogas and biomethane plants (including bio-LNG). In FY2025 consolidated revenue fell 7.4% to EUR 312.6m (total output EUR 376.4m), with Own Plant Operation the dominant segment (revenue EUR 221.2m, EBT EUR 41.7m) while Service and Plant Construction were loss-making. H1 2026 revenue was EUR 169.2m and the company is shifting its own plants from electricity to biomethane. Sources: https://www.boerse-stuttgart.de/en/products/equities/stuttgart/a0mvls-envitec-biogas/ ; https://live.deutsche-boerse.com/news/EQS-News-EnviTec-Biogas-reports-solid-performance-in-fiscal-year-2025--short-term-burdens-dampen-outlook-for-2026-growth-prospects-from-2027-onwards-201b8f61-c8cd-4b0a-bdea-b556fe03857f ; https://chemxplore.com/news/envitec-biogas-biomethane-transition
thesis.competitive_position: An established integrated biogas player whose earnings now depend mainly on its own plant fleet and biomethane/bio-LNG sales rather than third-party plant construction, which has been weak (FY2025 Plant Construction revenue EUR 45.5m vs EUR 95.6m, EBT -EUR 11.5m). Its economics are highly sensitive to regulation such as German GHG-quota rules: the abolition of double counting of GHG quotas hit bio-LNG contract profitability. Plant Construction order backlog was EUR 143.1m at 30 June 2026; 2026 guidance is output/revenue EUR 330-370m and EBT EUR 5-15m, with growth expected from 2027. Sources: https://chemxplore.com/news/envitec-biogas-fy2025-solid-performance ; https://chemxplore.com/news/envitec-biogas-biomethane-transition
thesis.main_shareholders: Company fact sheet (dated July 2026, 15,000,000 shares): TS Holding GmbH 25.9%, 2. vLB GmbH & Co. KG 22.6%, OvL Verwaltungs GmbH 15.0%, treasury shares 1.0%, free float 35.5%. The fact sheet does not state who controls these holding vehicles. Simply Wall St (aggregator) shows about 99.8% 'general public', which conflicts with the company data and should be disregarded. Sources: https://www.envitec-biogas.de/fileadmin/ns_theme_envitec/company/20260704_Unternehmenskurzportrait_ETG_web_fin.pdf ; https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/energy/etr-etg/envitec-biogas-shares/ownership
thesis.red_flags: Earnings fell sharply: FY2025 EBT EUR 26.0m (vs EUR 44.0m), including an approx. EUR 8m non-cash provision for onerous bio-LNG contracts after the end of GHG-quota double counting, and H1 2026 EBT was only EUR 4.4m; the FY2025 dividend was suspended. There is heavy regulatory/policy dependence, and Plant Construction and Service are loss-making. Concentrated insider/holding-company control (~63.5%) and a free float of about 35.5% limit minority influence and liquidity. Sources: https://live.deutsche-boerse.com/news/EQS-News-EnviTec-Biogas-reports-solid-performance-in-fiscal-year-2025--short-term-burdens-dampen-outlook-for-2026-growth-prospects-from-2027-onwards-201b8f61-c8cd-4b0a-bdea-b556fe03857f ; https://chemxplore.com/news/envitec-biogas-biomethane-production-transition ; https://www.envitec-biogas.de/fileadmin/ns_theme_envitec/company/20260704_Unternehmenskurzportrait_ETG_web_fin.pdf
thesis.insider_ownership: The company is founder-led: co-founder Olaf von Lehmden is CEO and Joerg Fischer is CFO. About 63.5% is held by three holding companies (TS Holding, 2. vLB, OvL Verwaltungs), which are understood to be founder/management vehicles - the name 'OvL' suggests Olaf von Lehmden - but this search did not find a voting-rights notification that attributes each vehicle to a named individual, so attribution is unverified (research gap). Sources: https://www.envitec-biogas.de/fileadmin/ns_theme_envitec/company/20260704_Unternehmenskurzportrait_ETG_web_fin.pdf ; https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/quote/ETG.F/profile

thesis.business_description: Practic S.A. is a Bucharest-based commercial real estate company, one of the largest owners of commercial space in the city (approximately 50,000 square meters, mainly in the Drumul Taberei, Crângași and Militari districts), which it rents and sublets, including to food and non-food stores, bank branches, pharmacies and restaurants; this has been its main activity since 2002.
thesis.competitive_position: Practic is a concentrated, founder/family-controlled Bucharest commercial-property landlord rather than a diversified or publicly liquid real estate company; its shares trade on the Bucharest Stock Exchange's lower-liquidity AeRO market, and the company is reportedly in the process of delisting to become a closed joint-stock company, reducing its relevance as a liquid public equity. [Forbes Romania](https://www.forbes.ro/?p=55383)
thesis.main_shareholders: Businessman Radu Dimofte holds approximately 48.47% directly; Wellkept Group (which Dimofte indirectly controls) holds approximately 12.03%, giving him effective control of roughly 60%; IBTCYRO Holding Ltd of Cyprus previously held approximately 32.15% but transferred this entire stake (190,976 shares, 32.153% of capital) to Wellkept Properties Limited, registered by the central depository on 7 July 2026. Top 3 shareholders together hold approximately 92.66% of the company. [BVB current report - shareholder change](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRBU/PRBU_20260708150828_Current-Report-July-08-2026-shareholder-change.pdf), [Targetare.ro company profile](https://targetare.ro/2774512/practic-sa)
thesis.insider_ownership: Radu Dimofte is the controlling individual/insider, holding approximately 48.47% directly plus indirect control of Wellkept Group's ~12.03% stake (and now, following the July 2026 transfer, apparently also effective influence over the former IBTCYRO 32.15% stake via the Wellkept-affiliated acquirer) - representing a dominant founder/owner-operator control structure. [BVB current report](https://bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRBU/PRBU_20260708150828_Current-Report-July-08-2026-shareholder-change.pdf)
