thesis.red_flags: The company is reportedly in the process of voluntarily delisting from the Bucharest Stock Exchange's AeRO market to become a closed joint-stock company, with an extraordinary general meeting called to vote on withdrawal and a valuation report issued (dated 1 July 2026) for shareholders wishing to exit - a significant corporate action that minority public shareholders should be aware of, as it may force them out of a public market at a company-determined valuation. [Forbes Romania](https://www.forbes.ro/?p=55383), [BVB valuation notice](https://www.bvb.ro/info/Raportari/PRBU/PRBU_20260701100231_Current-report-informs-shareholders.pdf)

thesis.business_description: SinterCast AB is a Swedish technology company that supplies process control systems (the System 4000) for the high-volume, reliable production of Compacted Graphite Iron (CGI), a stronger/lighter metal used by engine and component makers; founded in 1983, headquartered in Katrineholm.
thesis.competitive_position: SinterCast describes itself as the world's leading supplier of CGI process control technology, with an installed base of around 58 licensed installations across 13 countries as of its latest disclosures - a narrow, technology-licensing niche business with high switching costs for customers once installed, though volumes are tied to cyclical heavy-engine/automotive demand. [SinterCast investor release](https://storage.mfn.se/5c6a0152-b6b4-4129-80b9-067af7296541/press-release-pdf-english-version.pdf)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Inderes (Millistream data): Ulf Stenbeck ~9.3%, Avanza Pension ~8.1%, Torbjörn Gustafsson ~4.6%, Nordnet Pension ~4.5%, Canaccord Genuity Wealth Management ~3.7%, Lazard Frères Gestion ~3.3%, Jan Olof Brandels ~3.2%, Måns Flodberg ~2.6%. The four Nomination Committee members (Stenbeck, Gustafsson, Canaccord's David Walton, and Einar Ahlström) together represent 24% of shares as of 31 Aug 2025. [Inderes ownership](https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/SinterCast/ownership), [Nomination committee release](https://storage.mfn.se/396016b4-7463-45d2-ac39-a7d7345e065d/nomination-committee-en.pdf)
thesis.insider_ownership: No named company founder/executive holds a large disclosed stake distinct from the above investor-shareholders; incoming Managing Director Dr. Vitor Anjos made a small insider purchase of 400 shares in September 2025, and outgoing CEO Dr. Steve Dawson remains on the board. Simply Wall St's aggregate category split (dated, unverified against Inderes) put 'individual insiders' at roughly 29%, which likely includes Stenbeck and other large individual holders rather than pure management. [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stock/om/sint)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The company has never paid dividends, which is a disclosed policy choice rather than a governance red flag. Leadership transition (CEO handover from Dawson to Anjos) completed at the May 2026 AGM appears orderly. [SinterCast AGM release](https://www.sintercast.com/media/2589/sintercast-annual-general-meeting-2025.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Orell Füssli AG is a Zurich-based Swiss company tracing its roots to 1519 as a book printer, today operating primarily in security printing (banknotes, value documents, identity documents, and government identification systems) alongside a Book Retailing segment that is a leading player in the Swiss book retail sector.
thesis.competitive_position: Orell Füssli holds a specialized, long-established position in security printing (banknotes and identity documents) for governments, a high-trust, high-barrier-to-entry niche, though its security printing revenue declined from CHF 87.3m to CHF 73.8m between 2020 and 2021; its shares have traded on the SIX Swiss Exchange since 1897, making it, by its own description, the oldest continuously publicly traded company in Switzerland. [EQS-News - Orell Füssli profitability release](https://eqs-news.com/news/adhoc/orell-fussli-ag-orell-fussli-ag-boosts-profitability-and-increases-dividend/1528895)
thesis.main_shareholders: Shareholder data conflicts sharply across sources/listings: the Swiss SIX-listed (SWX:OFN) Simply Wall St page shows a highly dispersed register with institutions at only ~8.05% and the general public at ~92%, led by J. Safra Sarasin Investmentfonds Ltd at ~4.73%; by contrast, Simply Wall St's London- and Frankfurt-listing pages show the Schweizerische Nationalbank (Swiss National Bank) at 33.3% and an individual, Dieter Meier, at 13.5% - a materially different ownership picture that could not be reconciled in this search and should be verified against Orell Füssli's own SIX-mandated major shareholder disclosures. [Simply Wall St (SWX:OFN) ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/ch/commercial-services/vtx-ofn/orell-fussli-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Not reliably determined given the conflicting source data described above; if the Dieter Meier (~13.5%) figure from the London/Frankfurt-listing page is accurate it would represent a significant individual/insider stake, but this could not be cross-verified against the Swiss primary-listing data and should be treated as unconfirmed.
thesis.red_flags: The stark disconnect between shareholder registers reported for different listings of the same company (SWX vs. LSE vs. Frankfurt aggregator pages) is itself a data-reliability flag for due diligence purposes - investors should obtain Orell Füssli's own SIX-filed major-shareholder notifications rather than relying on secondary aggregators. No litigation, dilution or auditor concerns were identified from official sources. AGM shareholder votes (2022, 2023) approving board proposals and dividends were routine, with 75.63% of share capital represented in 2023.

thesis.business_description: Quercus TFI S.A. is a Poland-based investment fund management company, founded in August 2007 by Sebastian Buczek, offering investment fund management, portfolio management, and investment advisory services, historically targeted at high-net-worth investors. [Quercus TFI company page](https://quercustfi.pl/en/strona/quercus-tfi-sa)
thesis.competitive_position: Quercus TFI is described as Poland's first independent mutual-fund company and a cash-rich compounder, with strong historical profitability metrics (reported P/E ~11.8, ROE ~39.8%, five-year revenue CAGR ~23%) and an active share buyback program; in November 2025 it merged with Templeton Asset Management (Poland) TFI, bringing Franklin Templeton in as a strategic shareholder and expanding its scale. [Substack: Quercus TFI - Poland's Cash-Rich Compounder](https://kubangpasucapital.substack.com/p/quercus-tfi-sa-wse-qrs-polands-cash)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and CEO Sebastian Buczek (with related parties) holds approximately 18.8% as of April 2026; Jakub Głowacki (with related parties) holds about 16.0%; Franklin Templeton holds roughly 7.1%-7.8% following the November 2025 merger with Templeton Asset Management (Poland) TFI; OFE NN (a Polish pension fund) holds about 7.4%. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/QUERCUS-TFI-S-A-11194062/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/CEO Sebastian Buczek remains the single largest shareholder (~18.8%), alongside co-founder-era investor Jakub Głowacki (~16.0%), together representing roughly 35% of the company held by original insiders. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/QUERCUS-TFI-S-A-11194062/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched; the 2025 merger with Templeton Asset Management (Poland) TFI was a disclosed, negotiated transaction (including a note that Franklin Templeton would not participate in a potential 2026 share buyback, which could incrementally increase its relative stake) rather than a governance dispute. [Analizy.pl: Quercus TFI merger with Templeton AM Poland](https://www.analizy.pl/puls-rynku/38696/quercus-tfi-laczy-sie-z-templeton-am-poland)

thesis.business_description: Angler Gaming plc, incorporated in 2012 and headquartered in Ta' Xbiex, Malta, is a holding company that owns and manages stakes in online-gambling businesses (rather than operating a single consumer brand directly), including Premiergaming Ltd/Premiergaming (IOM) Limited (online casino, sports betting and bingo, mainly in Sweden under a Swedish license renewed through January 2027) and Starfish Media N.V. (holding a Curaçao gaming license), with its own i-gaming platform infrastructure (player administration, payments via Starspay Limited, CRM, AML/fraud prevention) running on Microsoft Azure. Source: https://borsdata.se/en/angler-gaming/analysis ; https://www.roic.ai/quote/ANGMF
thesis.competitive_position: A small-cap niche online-gambling holding/investment company (listed on the Swedish Spotlight market as ANGL, OTC as ANGMF) focused on smaller niche gaming businesses with long-term growth potential rather than scale; revenue has recently been declining — Q4 2025 net revenue fell approximately 16.5% year-on-year, attributed to a restructuring of B2B agreements at the start of 2025. Source: https://inderes.dk/companies/Angler-Gaming
thesis.main_shareholders: Per third-party aggregator data (Simply Wall St, Frankfurt-listing snapshot dated late November 2025): Thomas Kalita is the largest shareholder at approximately 9.27% (~6.95 million of ~75 million shares outstanding); a Stockholm-listing snapshot (mid-2025, different share count) shows him at approximately 8.64%. Other disclosed holders are minor: Olga Finkel (~0.4%), Deka Investment GmbH (~0.14%), Ralf Feldt (~0.08%). Insiders collectively hold ~9.75% and institutions only ~0.21%, with the general public holding roughly 90%. Kalita made insider share purchases on 12, 13 and 16 December 2024. These figures are from Simply Wall St aggregation, not independently confirmed against an official Spotlight/Malta company-filing disclosure in this search — recommend checking Angler Gaming's own annual report or Spotlight Stock Market filings for the authoritative current register. Source: https://simplywall.st/stocks/de/consumer-services/fra-0qm/angler-gaming-shares/ownership
thesis.red_flags: Extremely dispersed ownership (largest holder ~9%, ~90% of shares held by the general public per aggregator data) combined with declining revenue (Q4 2025 net revenue down ~16.5% y/y) warrants attention; this is a performance trend rather than a governance red flag, but the lack of a controlling shareholder and limited AGM turnout (9.36% of shares represented at the 2026 AGM, 8.45% at 2024) suggest weak shareholder engagement. No fraud or going-concern issues were identified from official sources, though gambling-sector regulatory risk (licensing renewals, e.g. the Swedish license through January 2027) is an inherent sector consideration.

name: Astarta Holding PLC
gmSourceUrl: [Astarta Holding 2024 Operating and Financial Results Presentation](https://astartaholding.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/2024-presentation-1.pdf), [Astarta Holding 2023 Annual Report](https://astartaholding.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/astarta_ar2023.pdf)

thesis.business_description: Astarta Holding PLC is a Cyprus-incorporated, Ukraine-focused diversified agribusiness group founded in March 1993, active in sugar production, crop farming, dairy and other agricultural operations, listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since 2006.
thesis.competitive_position: Astarta is one of Ukraine's largest diversified agribusiness groups with a long operating history since 1993 under founder Viktor Ivanchyk, holding institutional backing from Fairfax Financial Holdings-linked entities, which has provided capital support through Ukraine's wartime economic disruption; specific market-share figures were not found. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astarta_Holding)
thesis.main_shareholders: Founder and CEO Viktor Ivanchyk holds approximately 41.9-43.22% depending on source/date (Simply Wall St May 2025 snapshot vs. a December 2025 strefainwestorow.pl table). Fairfax Financial Holdings-affiliated entities are significant holders, though the reported size varies dramatically by source: Hamblin Watsa Investment Counsel (Fairfax's investment arm) at 29.8% per Simply Wall St vs. combined Fairfax-linked entities (Odyssey Reinsurance ~7.67%, HWIC Global Equity Fund ~7.29%, United States Fire Insurance ~6.93%, together ~21.9%) per the December 2025 table; a separate June 2024 WSE filing names Albacon Ventures Ltd. at 40.68% with its relationship to Ivanchyk unconfirmed. The company's own treasury holds approximately 2.44%. Given these significant inconsistencies across sources, exact current percentages should be verified against Astarta's own WSE/regulatory disclosures. [Strefainwestorow.pl shareholder table](https://strefainwestorow.pl/en/notowania/spolki/NL0000686509/akcjonariat), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/food-beverage-tobacco/wse-ast/astarta-holding-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder and CEO Viktor Ivanchyk has led the company since its 1993 founding and holds a substantial personal stake of approximately 41.9-43.22%, representing strong founder control. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astarta_Holding), [Strefainwestorow.pl](https://strefainwestorow.pl/en/notowania/spolki/NL0000686509/akcjonariat)
thesis.red_flags: As a Ukraine-based agribusiness, the company faces material, well-known operational and geopolitical risk from the ongoing war in Ukraine (disruption to farming operations, logistics, and export routes via Black Sea ports), which is a significant risk factor for any investment thesis though not a governance red flag per se. Shareholder data is also materially inconsistent across sources (Fairfax-linked stake reported anywhere from ~22% to ~30%, and a separate ~41% holder, Albacon Ventures, whose relationship to known holders is unconfirmed), warranting direct verification before relying on any ownership figure. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astarta_Holding)

thesis.business_description: Sanok Rubber Company S.A. (formerly Stomil Sanok, renamed November 2015) is a Polish manufacturer of rubber, rubber-to-metal, and multi-material products for automotive (car body sealing systems, anti-vibration parts), construction, agriculture, pharmaceutical and household appliance markets, based in Sanok, Poland, with roots dating to 1932.
thesis.competitive_position: Sanok is an established Central European rubber-products manufacturer with international reach, having acquired full ownership of China's Qingdao Meteor Rubber & Plastics (2016, having previously held a 20% stake) and a majority (54%) stake in Polish façade-systems firm BSP Bracket System, reflecting a strategy of diversifying beyond core automotive rubber parts into adjacent materials and geographies. [European Rubber Journal](https://www.european-rubber-journal.com/2016/08/17/draft-polish-company-takes-qingdao-meteor-rubber-plastics)
thesis.main_shareholders: Ownership is dominated by Polish pension funds alongside a long-standing large individual holder, Marek Łęcki (also Chairman of the Supervisory Board): per Wikipedia, ING OFE ~11.53%, Łęcki ~11.04%, Aviva OFE Aviva BZ WBK ~10.83%, PZU Złota Jesień OFE ~9.30%, Aviva Investors Poland ~6.60%; a separate, differently-dated Simply Wall St snapshot (~January 2021) shows Nationale-Nederlanden OFE ~21.9%, PTE Allianz Polska ~16.6%, Łęcki ~11.9%, and a PZU pension fund ~10.8%. Figures vary by source and date (pension fund mergers/renamings, e.g. ING OFE to Nationale-Nederlanden OFE, account for some discrepancy), and free float is reported around 55% by Bankier.pl. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanok_Rubber_Company), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/automobiles/wse-snk/sanok-rubber-company-spolka-akcyjna-shares/ownership)
thesis.insider_ownership: Marek Łęcki, Chairman of the Supervisory Board, has held a consistent, substantial individual stake across multiple years and sources, reported at approximately 11.0-11.9% depending on date - a meaningful long-term insider holding, though he is described as a long-time executive/board figure rather than explicitly as the company's founder (the company's roots trace to 1932 under the Stomil Sanok name). [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sanok_Rubber_Company), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/automobiles/wse-snk/sanok-rubber-company-spolka-akcyjna-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Skarbiec Holding S.A. is a Warsaw-based Polish financial holding group whose core business, run mainly through subsidiary Skarbiec TFI S.A., is managing investment funds (open-end, specialized open-end and closed-end) and client/portfolio management services for individual and corporate clients. Source: https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/skarbiec-holding-s-a-highlights-its-role-in-polish-asset-management/69724879 ; https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLSKRBH00014
thesis.competitive_position: One of the established independent (non-bank-owned) fund managers in Poland via Skarbiec TFI, generating revenue mainly from fixed and performance-based asset-management fees, making profitability sensitive to AUM levels and the equity/defensive-fund mix; a small-cap, GPW-listed structure distinct from the bank-affiliated TFI majors. Source: https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/skarbiec-holding-s-a-highlights-its-role-in-polish-asset-management/69724879
thesis.main_shareholders: Per a shareholder-structure snapshot reported by Strefa Inwestorów (undated but citing GPW/KNF-sourced data) and corroborated in parts by a 2022 KNF major-holder notice: Lubelski Chmiel Investment sp. z o.o. holds approximately 48.3% of capital/votes; Aoram sp. z o.o. holds approximately 30.5%; Zbigniew Juroszek holds approximately 12.5%; Quercus TFI S.A. holds approximately 7.9%. Source: https://strefainwestorow.pl/notowania/spolki/PLSKRBH00014/akcjonariat . A 2022 KNF notice further discloses that Lubelski Chmiel is wholly owned by Perła-Browary Lubelskie, itself ~50.7% owned by Marconia Enterprises Limited, whose shares are held by William Roderick Richardson (a US citizen), and that the same group acquired 100% of Aoram sp. z o.o. in October 2022 (Aoram then held ~32.99% of votes) — implying common control of roughly 79% combined. Source referenced via https://www.analizy.pl/puls-rynku/33300/lubelski-chmiel-wezwal-do-sprzedazy-18-92-akcji-skarbiec-holding (2023 tender-offer article citing the same group). This combined-control inference is ours, not stated verbatim in one filing, so it should be cross-checked against the company's current Art. 69/70 Ustawy o ofercie notifications on GPW/ESPI.
thesis.red_flags: High ownership concentration: a single affiliated group (Lubelski Chmiel + Aoram) appears to control roughly 79% of votes based on triangulating a 2022 KNF notice and a 2023 tender-offer filing, leaving a free float of under 1% per the Strefa Inwestorów snapshot — this is a significant minority-shareholder/liquidity risk even though no fraud or going-concern issue was identified. A 2023 tender offer by Lubelski Chmiel at 20.35 zł/share sought to raise its stake further. Source: https://www.analizy.pl/puls-rynku/33300/lubelski-chmiel-wezwal-do-sprzedazy-18-92-akcji-skarbiec-holding

thesis.business_description: Petros Petropoulos AEBE is a Greece-based (Athens) industrial and commercial group, founded in 1922, engaged in the manufacture, modification, marketing, distribution, and support of vehicles, automotive machinery, industrial and agricultural equipment, batteries, and related components, organized into business units including Truck and Bus, Agricultural Equipment, Isuzu, Engines and Boats, Industrial Equipment, Petrogen, PMS, and Shell Lubricants, with subsidiaries in Cyprus and Bulgaria. [Petros Petropoulos company page](https://petropoulos.com/en/company/)
thesis.competitive_position: Petros Petropoulos is a century-old, diversified Greek industrial distribution and equipment group with multiple exclusive brand distributorships (e.g., Isuzu, Shell Lubricants) and regional reach into Cyprus and Bulgaria, giving it diversified revenue streams across automotive, agricultural, and industrial equipment segments. [Petros Petropoulos company overview](https://petropoulos.com/en/company/)
thesis.main_shareholders: The largest disclosed shareholder is Ioannis Petropoulos (~30.81%, representing the founding Petropoulos family), followed by Anabak Trading & Investments Ltd. (~25.89%). [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PETROS-PETROPOULOS-AEBE-6258916/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: The founding Petropoulos family, via Ioannis Petropoulos (~30.81%), remains the largest single named shareholder; Executive Chairman Michael Economakis holds a senior management role but no distinct personal shareholding percentage was found in the sources searched. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/PETROS-PETROPOULOS-AEBE-6258916/company/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources searched.

thesis.business_description: Pattern S.p.A. is an Italian luxury apparel manufacturing group (an 'Italian Luxury Engineering & Production Hub') based near Turin, producing men's and women's clothing and accessories, woven fabric, knitwear and leather goods for luxury fashion brands, and listed on Borsa Italiana since July 2019.
thesis.competitive_position: Pattern has grown through acquisitions (e.g., the 2022 purchase of knitting mill Zanni to expand in luxury knitwear) to build an integrated luxury production hub, targeting €140 million in turnover under its strategic plan through 2028 and expanding into new product categories - positioning it as a consolidator/supplier within the Italian luxury manufacturing supply chain rather than a brand owner itself. [Teleborsa - Zanni acquisition](https://www.teleborsa.it/AMP/News/2022/01/20/pattern-acquisisce-zanni-per-crescere-nella-maglieria-di-lusso-169.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per a 2024 Borsa Italiana disclosure: Bo.Ma. Holding S.r.l. holds approximately 53.58% (7,722,000 shares); Axon Partners Group Investment holds approximately 6.36%; co-founders Francesco Martorella and Fulvio Botto each hold approximately 5.26%; Camer S.r.l. holds approximately 1.32%; free float (market) is approximately 26.41%. [Borsa Italiana price-sensitive notice](https://borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/price-sensitive/download/20164_143071_2024_oneinfo.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Co-founders Francesco Martorella and Fulvio Botto each hold approximately 5.26% individually (likely also controlling Bo.Ma. Holding, the 53.58% majority shareholder, though this link was not explicitly confirmed in sources found); CEO Luca Sburlati holds approximately 1.76-2.03% depending on source/date. [Borsa Italiana notice](https://borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/price-sensitive/download/20164_143071_2024_oneinfo.html), [Simply Wall St ownership](https://simplywall.st/stocks/it/consumer-durables/bit-ptr/pattern-shares/ownership)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Nederman Holding AB, founded in 1944 by Philip Nederman and headquartered in Helsingborg, Sweden, is an environmental-technology group designing, manufacturing and marketing industrial air-filtration systems (dust, fume and gas removal) for heavy process industries (metal fabrication, power generation, mineral processing, chemicals, fiber production, automotive), with products including extraction arms, stationary filters, vehicle-exhaust removal systems, and an IoT monitoring platform, sold under brands including Nederman, Nederman MikroPul, Nordfab, RoboVent, NEO Monitors and Luwa Air Engineering. Source: https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/nederman-holding-ab/
thesis.competitive_position: A global environmental-technology leader in industrial air filtration, organized into Extraction and Filtration Technology, Process Technology, Duct and Filter Technology, and Monitoring and Control Technology segments, with manufacturing/assembly in Europe, North America and Asia and sales mainly via distributors/resellers; 2024 revenue reported at $589.4m (down ~2% from 2023) with ~2,000-2,400 employees. Source: https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/nederman-holding-ab/
thesis.main_shareholders: Per aggregator data (Inderes and Simply Wall St, Stockholm listing, cross-checked against each other): Investment AB Latour is the largest shareholder, holding approximately 30% of both capital and votes. The identity and exact percentage of the second-largest holder is inconsistently reported across sources — named variously as 'Ernström & Co AB', 'Neudi Kapital AB' or 'Neudi & Co. AB' at approximately 10% — and the third-largest as either 'Sampo Oyj' or 'IF Skadeförsäkring AB (publ)' at approximately 9.9%, an inconsistency we could not resolve in this search. Other smaller holders cited include Swedbank Robur Fonder AB, Cliens Kapitalförvaltning AB and the Fourth Swedish National Pension Fund (AP4). Source: https://www.inderes.se/en/companies/Nederman-Holding/ownership ; https://simplywall.st/stocks/se/capital-goods/sto-nman/nederman-holding-shares/ownership . We found no mention of Ahlström Capital as a Nederman shareholder in this search. Not independently confirmed against Nederman's own current shareholder list — recommend checking the company's Annual Report or Euroclear Sweden/Modular Finance-sourced data directly, given the conflicting secondary names/percentages for the #2 and #3 holders.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; Investment AB Latour's ~30% anchor stake is a well-known, disclosed long-term industrial holding typical of the Swedish listed-company model (Latour holds stakes in multiple listed Nordic industrials) rather than a governance concern. The inconsistent naming of the second- and third-largest shareholders across aggregator sources is a data-quality gap, not a confirmed red flag, but should be resolved against Nederman's own disclosures before relying on exact figures.

thesis.business_description: Quartix Technologies plc is a UK-based provider of subscription-based vehicle tracking and fleet management systems (GPS telematics hardware and software) for commercial fleets and insurance telematics, founded in 2001.
thesis.competitive_position: Quartix is an established, profitable niche player in the vehicle telematics/fleet tracking market with a long operating history (founded 2001) and a subscription-revenue model; it has experienced recent management turbulence (CEO departure, founder's return as chairman) that could affect strategic continuity. [AJ Bell news](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/266309/quartix-non-executive-chair-resigns-board-replaced-founder)
thesis.main_shareholders: Not fully disclosed in sources found with specific percentages for most holders; founder Andy Walters is described as having a 'significant shareholding' that the board cited as a reason to add an additional independent director, but his exact percentage was not found. For current detail, Quartix's RNS holdings notices would need to be checked directly.
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder Andy Walters returned to the board as Non-Executive Chairman in September 2023 and then became Executive Chairman after CEO Richard Lilwall's departure, reflecting strong founder influence over governance; his personal shareholding percentage is not disclosed in the sources found but was explicitly cited by the company as 'significant.' Separately, director Glen Middleton and his wife Georgina Middleton held a combined 52,294 ordinary shares as of a December 2025 PDMR filing (a minor holding, not a major stake). [AJ Bell - founder replaces chair](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/266309/quartix-non-executive-chair-resigns-board-replaced-founder), [Stockopedia PDMR filing](https://www-proxy.stockopedia.com/share-prices/quartix-technologies-LON:QTX/news/reg-quartix-technologies-director-pdmr-shareholding-urn:newsml:reuters.com:20251215:nRSO6535La)
thesis.red_flags: Notable management turbulence in 2023: the Non-Executive Chairman resigned and was replaced by founder Andy Walters, who shortly after also saw the CEO (Richard Lilwall) step down and leave the company, with Walters becoming Executive Chairman. This sequence of leadership changes, partly attributed by outside commentary to founder dissatisfaction with prior management, is worth noting as a governance watch-item, though not necessarily a red flag in the fraud/litigation sense. [AJ Bell - CEO steps down](https://streaming1.www.ajbell.co.uk/articles/latestnews/267015/brief-quartix-technologies-chief-executive-steps-down)

thesis.business_description: NSC Groupe SA is a French industrial-equipment manufacturer (founded 1810, headquartered in Guebwiller, Alsace) that designs and sells production lines for the textile, packaging and foundry industries, including unwinding/rewinding machinery, fiber-to-yarn textile lines, robotic palletizing/conveying equipment (FEGE brand), tube/core/can-making equipment (PAKEA brand), and cast-iron foundry parts. Source: https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/capital-goods/epa-alnsc/nsc-groupe-shares/information
thesis.competitive_position: Diversified multi-segment industrial-machinery group serving niche global end-markets (aerospace, wind energy, automotive, medical, agri-food, home/personal care); small-cap with market capitalization reported in the roughly €26-31m range depending on source/date, giving it limited scale versus larger industrial-automation peers but diversification across several unrelated niches. Source: https://simplywall.st/stocks/fr/capital-goods/epa-alnsc/nsc-groupe-shares/information ; https://statbase.ru/companies/nsc-groupe/
thesis.main_shareholders: Aggregator data (Statbase) states NSC Groupe SA is a subsidiary of a parent holding company, Alsapar, with Pascal Rouhaud listed as CEO and Chairman. Source: https://statbase.ru/companies/nsc-groupe/ . We did not find an official company filing or AMF threshold notice in this search confirming the exact percentage stake held by Alsapar — this should be treated as an aggregator-sourced claim pending verification against the company's own actionnariat disclosures (nsc-groupe.com) or AMF filings.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; no litigation, going-concern or dilution issues surfaced. Controlling-family/holding-company structure (Alsapar) is typical for a 200+ year old French industrial family business rather than an inherent red flag, but was not independently verified against an official filing.

thesis.business_description: Schwälbchen Molkerei Jakob Berz AG is a German dairy company founded in 1938 and based in Bad Schwalbach, Hesse, producing and selling fresh and long-life milk and dairy products (yoghurt, whipped cream, sour cream, quark) under the SCHWAELBCHEN brand, with production/distribution sites including Mainz, Ilsfeld and Korntal-Münchingen, plus a foodservice subsidiary, SCHWÄLBCHEN Frischdienst GmbH.
thesis.competitive_position: Schwälbchen is a long-standing German regional dairy brand (founded 1938) with a DIN ISO 9001-certified quality system, positioned as a regional brand supplier of fresh dairy products; the company has described itself as financially well-positioned through difficult periods (e.g., the COVID-19 crisis), suggesting a conservatively-run, family-managed niche regional player rather than a national-scale dairy major. [Lebensmittelzeitung](https://www.lebensmittelzeitung.net/industrie/nachrichten/corona-folgen-schwaelbchen-leidet-sehr-161276)
thesis.main_shareholders: The Berz family controls the company, with CEO Dr. Günter Berz-List (a family member, per the company name 'Jakob Berz AG' and management board listing) leading the business; however, no source found in this search gave a specific percentage for the family's or any other shareholder's stake. The company has conducted share buybacks (up to 70,000 shares, ~5% of share capital, held in treasury), which reduces free float but was not attributed to any specific shareholder's benefit. Could not verify specific ownership percentages for the Berz family or other holders.
thesis.insider_ownership: Dr. Günter Berz-List, a member of the founding Berz family, serves on the Management Board (CEO), indicating continued family management involvement, though his or the broader family's specific shareholding percentage was not found and could not be verified in this search.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; note that ownership percentage data for this company could not be found via general web search and would require checking German voting-rights notifications (Stimmrechtsmitteilungen), the Bundesanzeiger/Unternehmensregister, or the company's own annual reports directly - a disclosure-transparency gap worth noting for diligence purposes.

thesis.business_description: Aerostar S.A., headquartered in Bacău, Romania (operating under its current name since 1991, tracing to 1953), is an aeronautical and defense manufacturing company providing aerostructures, landing gear and hydraulic systems for civil aviation, MRO services (including Boeing 737 heavy maintenance since 2003), and military aircraft MRO/upgrades, electronic/communication/IFF systems, and ground defense equipment (rocket launchers, armored vehicles). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aerostar_(Romanian_company)
thesis.competitive_position: A key Romanian aerospace/defense MRO and manufacturing hub with notable partnerships including Lockheed Martin subsidiary Derco for F-16 landing gear/wheel/brake repair and service contracts covering F-16 aircraft and Black Hawk helicopters for the Romanian military; Q1 2024 revenue grew ~24% y/y to ~155m lei (export sales ~128m lei) though net profit fell ~16%. Source: https://newsweek.ro/economie/aerostar-bacau-renaste-repara-f-16-si-black-hawk-cifra-de-afaceri-a-crescut-cu-24-in-2024 ; https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont24/ARS_20240509123429_2024-Q1-report.pdf
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the most recent figures found (cited via Forbes Romania and economedia.ro, referencing BVB disclosures): IAROM S.A. București holds approximately 71.50% of Aerostar, and EVERGENT Investments S.A. (formerly SIF Moldova) holds approximately 15.15%, with the remaining ~13.3% in free float held by individuals and legal entities. Source: https://economedia.ro/aerostar-a-respins-iesirea-evergent-investments-fosta-sif-moldova-din-actionariatul-sau.html ; https://www.forbes.ro/?p=386795 . IAROM is understood to be linked to Romanian state defense-industry holding structures, though we could not independently confirm IAROM's own ownership (i.e., direct state ownership) from an official source in this search — this should be verified via IAROM's own filings or Romania's Ministry of Economy/Ministry of National Defense disclosures.
thesis.red_flags: Active shareholder dispute: Evergent Investments requested withdrawal as a significant shareholder on 13 March 2025 and sought full buyout of its ~15.14% stake; Aerostar's board rejected this on 20 March 2025, after which Evergent initiated legal action, linking the dispute to a change in Aerostar's main business object approved at the 12 December 2024 extraordinary general meeting (a characterization Aerostar disputes). This is an unresolved governance/litigation matter as of this search. Source: https://economedia.ro/aerostar-a-respins-iesirea-evergent-investments-fosta-sif-moldova-din-actionariatul-sau.html ; https://economedia.ro/evergent-face-demersuri-legale-judiciare-privind-retragerea-din-actionariatul-aerostar.html

thesis.business_description: B&C Speakers S.p.A. is an Italy-based (Bagno a Ripoli) manufacturer specializing in the design, production, and marketing of professional loudspeaker components (transducers) under the B&C brand, founded in 1945/1946 by Fernando Borrani and Roberto Coppini. [B&C Speakers history](https://www.bcspeakers.com/en/about-bc/history)
thesis.competitive_position: B&C Speakers is described as one of the largest and most prestigious professional loudspeaker transducer manufacturers in the world, with a long operating history (since the 1940s) and sufficient brand strength to pursue trade-dress infringement litigation against competitors (e.g., PRV Audio Group) to defend its product designs. [B&C Speakers v. PRV Audio Group litigation](https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/10854523/bc-speakers-spa-and-bc-speakers-na-llc-v-prv-audio-group-inc/)
thesis.main_shareholders: Research & Development International S.r.l. is the controlling shareholder, holding approximately 52.73% of B&C Speakers S.p.A. [MarketScreener shareholders](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/B-C-SPEAKERS-S-P-A-286463/company/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Controlling ownership runs through the holding company Research & Development International S.r.l. (~52.73%); current CEO Lorenzo Coppini appears to be linked to co-founder Roberto Coppini's family lineage, suggesting continued founder-family involvement in management, though a distinct personal shareholding percentage for him was not separately confirmed. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/B-C-SPEAKERS-S-P-A-286463/company/)
thesis.red_flags: B&C Speakers has been engaged as plaintiff in trade-dress infringement litigation against PRV Audio Group, Inc. over alleged copying of its speaker basket design; this is offensive litigation to protect its IP rather than a governance red flag against the company itself, but it indicates active legal/IP disputes in its competitive environment. [B&C Speakers v. PRV Audio Group court opinion](https://www.courtlistener.com/opinion/10854523/bc-speakers-spa-and-bc-speakers-na-llc-v-prv-audio-group-inc/)

thesis.business_description: Cellularline S.p.A. is an Italian company headquartered in Reggio Emilia (founded 1990) that designs, manufactures and sells mobile-device accessories (cases, screen protection, chargers, cables, in-car phone holders, headphones, speakers, wearables), including motorcycle/bicycle accessories, sold under the Cellularline brand in more than 60 countries. Source: https://www.businesscoot.com/en/company/cellularline ; https://it.finance.yahoo.com/quote/CELL.MI/profile
thesis.competitive_position: Mid-sized Italian consumer-electronics accessories brand with multi-country distribution (Italy, Iberia, Germany, France, UK, North America) and ~250-500+ employees depending on source; was the target of a non-binding 2022 take-private approach from distributor Esprinet S.p.A., indicating sector consolidation interest. Source: https://www.businesscoot.com/en/company/cellularline (2021 turnover ~€97m)
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Consob's official 'Listed companies – Ownership' register for Cellularline S.p.A. (Euronext STAR Milan), as of filings through late 2024: Christian Aleotti (CEO) holds ~12.15% directly (filed 9 Feb 2024); First Capital S.p.A. holds ~7.77% (filed 15 Feb 2024); Antonio Luigi Tazartes holds ~7.08% in total (~6.34% direct + ~0.74% via TAZIO S.r.l.); Quaero Capital SA holds ~5.05% via discretionary management. The company itself held 477,090 treasury shares (~2.18% of capital with voting rights) as of November 2024. Source: https://www.consob.it/web/consob-and-its-activities/w/cellularline-spa-azionariato-2024-10-08 ; https://www.consob.it/web/consob-and-its-activities/w/cellularline-spa-azionariato-2024-07-03
thesis.red_flags: In May 2022 Esprinet S.p.A. sent a non-binding expression of interest to Cellularline's board regarding a possible public tender offer aimed at delisting the company; no confirmed outcome was found, and the company remained listed as of a November 2024 press release, but it signals ongoing takeover/delisting speculation that minority shareholders should track. Source: (noted in aggregated search results referencing businesscoot.com and Consob filings; recommend verifying via Borsa Italiana price-sensitive announcements, e.g. https://borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/price-sensitive/download/20098_147691_2024_oneinfo.html )

thesis.business_description: ATC CARGO S.A. is a Polish logistics company (founded 2006, headquartered in Gdynia) providing sea, air, and land freight and forwarding services in Poland and internationally.
thesis.competitive_position: A mid-sized Polish freight forwarding and logistics provider; specific market-share or competitive-moat details were not found in sources reviewed beyond its multi-modal (sea/air/land) service offering. [ATC Cargo investor relations](https://atc-cargo.pl/en/dla-inwestora?973e7ac6_page=0)
thesis.main_shareholders: Fundacja Rodzinna Bąk w organizacji holds approximately 18.86% of shares (25.96% of votes); WBW INVEST Ignasiak, Szczegodziński S.K.A. holds approximately 18.85% of shares (25.96% of votes); Marcin Karczewski holds approximately 14.17% combined; investment funds managed by TFI PZU hold approximately 13% of bearer shares; Worldwide Supply Chain Holdings Pte. Ltd. holds approximately 11.76% of bearer shares. Shareholders Wiktor Bąk and Marcin Karczewski are bound by a voting agreement. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ATC-CARGO-S-A-20706043/)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founder/insider ownership is meaningful and consolidated through family and related-party vehicles: the Bąk family foundation and Marcin Karczewski (bound by a shareholder voting agreement) together with the Ignasiak/Szczegodziński-linked WBW INVEST entity control a substantial combined block, though a precise aggregate percentage attributable strictly to 'insiders' was not confirmed. [MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/ATC-CARGO-S-A-20706043/)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in available search results.

thesis.business_description: Bénéteau S.A. (Groupe Bénéteau), founded in 1884 and headquartered in Saint-Gilles-Croix-de-Vie, France, is a world-leading nautical group that designs, manufactures and sells sailing yachts and motorboats under brands including Beneteau, Jeanneau, Lagoon, Prestige, Monte Carlo Yachts, Four Winns, Glastron and Wellcraft, plus a Boating Solutions division (rentals, marinas, financing) and a leisure-homes business; operates 16 production sites across France, the US, Poland, Italy, Portugal and Tunisia with 6,500+ employees and roughly €1bn revenue (2024). Source: https://press.beneteau-group.com/assets/250429-beneteau-rapport-financier-annuel-2024-fd9a3-49529.html?dl=1
thesis.competitive_position: One of the world's largest builders of sailing yachts and pleasure boats, differentiated by scale, a multi-brand portfolio spanning sail/power/catamaran segments, and vertical diversification into boating services and financing; long-term family control has historically supported sustained capex through industry cycles. Source: https://press.beneteau-group.com/download-pdf/59dba59ade60c40b258b4585
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Bénéteau's own 2025 Rapport Financier Annuel, S.A. BERI 21 — a company held by the founding Bénéteau family group — held 54.36% of Bénéteau S.A.'s capital at 31 December 2025 (stable long-term: 54.33% at 31 Aug 2014, 54.36% at 31 Aug 2015); no other shareholder holds more than 5% of capital; the public free float is approximately 42.42% and treasury self-control approximately 3.22%. Voting-rights percentage for BERI 21/the family was not found in this search, though the gap between the 82,789,840 shares in capital and 130,246,487 theoretical voting rights (as of 30 April 2024) suggests double voting rights for long-held shares are in effect, likely raising the family's voting share above its 54.36% capital stake (this inference is ours, not stated directly in the source). Source: https://presse.beneteau-group.com/assets/260414-beneteau-rapport-financier-annuel-2025-e1c1b-ce95c.html?dl=1
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; majority family control via BERI 21 is long-standing and disclosed, not concealed. The company did note a cautious/pessimistic outlook for 2025 trading conditions in investor communications, which is a business-cycle risk rather than a governance red flag. Source: https://www.optionfinance.fr/info-financiere-en-continu/d/2025-03-21-la-valeur-du-jour-a-paris-beneteau-pessimiste-pour-2025.html

thesis.business_description: TXT e-solutions S.p.A., founded in 1989 and headquartered in Milan (listed on Borsa Italiana since 2000), is a software and engineering-services company focused on aerospace/aeronautics/automotive (on-board software, flight simulators, training and flight-support systems, MRO software), with additional business lines in Software Engineering, Smart Solutions and Digital Advisory serving banking, fintech, defense, government and industrial clients. Source: https://mercati.ilsole24ore.com/azioni/borsa-italiana/dettaglio-completo/TXT.MI/analisi-fondamentale/profilo-societario
thesis.competitive_position: Specialist aerospace software/engineering provider (serving aircraft/engine makers, airlines and MRO firms) plus niche fintech products (Cheleo Suite for financing/NPL management, FARADAY for risk management); maintains R&D subsidiaries in Germany, the UK, France, Switzerland and the US. Source: https://it.finance.yahoo.com/q/in?s=TXT.MI
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Consob's official share-capital disclosure, TXT e-solutions had 13,006,250 ordinary shares outstanding (single class, no multiple-vote shares) as of a 30 November 2021 snapshot (Source: https://www.consob.it/web/area-pubblica/w/txt-e-solutions-spa-capitale-sociale-2020-06-30). Consob's 'azionisti rilevanti' (relevant shareholders) methodology page confirms the company discloses voting-rights percentages including treasury shares, but the specific named holders were not visible in this search's extract (Source: https://www.consob.it/web/consob-and-its-activities/w/txt-e-solutions-spa-pie-chart-diritti-di-voto-esercitabili-5) — recommend pulling that page directly for current names/percentages. A non-official aggregator (Simply Wall St, undated) reports Laserline SpA as the largest holder at ~30.9% (3,926,493 shares, which computes to ~30.2% of the Consob-disclosed 13,006,250 shares, a discrepancy likely due to a different/more recent total share count after buybacks), L.V.O. Global Asset Management SA at ~3.1%, and Fideuram-Intesa Sanpaolo Private Banking Asset Management SGR at ~2.07%. The company holds treasury shares equal to 3.0054% of capital as of 11 September 2026 under an ongoing buyback program. Source: https://www.borsaitaliana.it/borsa/notizie/teleborsa/finanza/txt-esolutions-sale-al-3-del-capitale-sociale-con-il-buyback-111_2026-09-17_TLB.html
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; the Laserline SpA stake (~30%) represents a significant but non-majority anchor shareholder, consistent with founder/insider control common in Italian STAR-segment small caps rather than a specific governance concern. The discrepancy between aggregator and Consob share-count figures should be verified directly against Consob's 'azionisti rilevanti' page before citing precise percentages.

thesis.business_description: Detection Technology Plc, headquartered in Espoo, Finland, supplies off-the-shelf and customised X-ray imaging detector solutions - from photodiodes to detector subsystems and flat panel detectors - mainly to OEMs and system integrators in medical (e.g. CT), security and industrial applications, with sites in Finland, China, France, India and the US. In H1 2026 net sales rose 9.1% to EUR 50.9m (Medical EUR 25.4m, Security EUR 15.7m, Industrial EUR 9.8m) with EBITA of EUR 4.2m (8.2% margin); APAC accounted for about EUR 36.1m of H1 sales. Sources: https://businessfinland.com/companies/d/detection-technology-oyj ; https://www.deetee.com/company-release/detection-technology-plc-half-yearly-report-january-june-2026/ ; https://mfn.se/cis/a/detection-technology/detection-technology-oyj-detection-technologys-annual-review-financial-statements-and-cg-statement-2025-published-a5a0de90
thesis.competitive_position: A specialist component supplier listed among key global X-ray detector players alongside much larger firms such as Varex, Canon, Thales and Hamamatsu, in a market estimated by MarketsandMarkets at about USD 3.4bn (2025). Growth in 2026 is driven by medical imaging and flat panel detectors, while security and industrial demand in China is weak; it faces price competition (including from Chinese detector makers), US tariffs and material constraints. Medium-term targets are at least 10% annual sales growth and a 15% EBITA margin. Sources: https://vapt.marketsandmarkets.com/ResearchInsight/x-ray-detectors-market.asp ; https://www.deetee.com/company-release/detection-technology-plc-half-yearly-report-january-june-2026/ ; https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1681622/000168162225000108/var-20251003.htm
thesis.main_shareholders: The largest shareholder is Ahlstrom Capital B.V., a group company of A. Ahlstrom Oy (confirmed in company releases up to March 2026). A flagging notification shows Ahlstrom Capital B.V. at 36.03% of shares and votes (date not shown in search result); Simply Wall St (aggregator) shows 5,280,167 shares (about 36%), with SEB funds around 4.93% and OP Varainhoito around 3.51% - aggregator figures, undated. thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. Standard caveats: a controlling-type ~36% anchor holder (Ahlstrom) with board representation; heavy APAC/China exposure (APAC ~71% of H1 2026 sales) and weak Chinese security/industrial demand; margin well below the 15% target (8.2% EBITA in H1 2026); geopolitical, US tariff and component supply risks flagged by the company. Sources: https://www.deetee.com/company-release/detection-technology-plc-half-yearly-report-january-june-2026/ ; https://www.deetee.com/company-release/notification-of-changes-in-share-ownership/
thesis.insider_ownership: Could not locate named board/management shareholdings in this search (the 2025 annual review and CG statement published 5 March 2026 should contain them); treat as a research gap. Known: President and CEO Hannu Martola bought 2,000 shares at EUR 10.47 in November 2025 (aggregator record); Simply Wall St puts 'individual insiders' at about 4.36% in total (aggregator, not broken down). Two board members are not independent of the major shareholder A. Ahlstrom Oy. Sources: https://simplywall.st/stocks/fi/tech/hel-detec/detection-technology-oyj-shares/ownership ; https://www.deetee.com/company-release/detection-technology-organising-meeting-of-the-board-of-directors-5/

thesis.business_description: Sparebanken Øst is a Norwegian independent savings bank, established in 1843 and headquartered in Drammen, providing retail banking, commercial banking and financial services (loans, mortgages, savings, payment cards, pensions, insurance, investment and online banking) to private individuals and small/medium-sized enterprises in eastern Norway (primarily lower Buskerud county and the Drammen region). Source: https://hl.co.uk/shares/shares-search-results/s/sparebanken-ost-nok10/company-information ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sparebanken_%C3%98st
thesis.competitive_position: One of Norway's larger independent (non-alliance) savings banks, focused on a defined regional market in eastern Norway rather than nationwide scale; listed on Oslo Børs under ticker SPOG with equity certificates (egenkapitalbevis) as its listed instrument. Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sparebanken_%C3%98st
thesis.main_shareholders: We could not locate a current (post-2020) official shareholder/egenkapitalbevis-holder list for Sparebanken Øst in this search. The most recent data found was a March 2012 top-20 equity-certificate holder list from the bank's own investor presentation, which is now outdated: MP Pensjon PK (~9.88%), Skagen Vekst VPF (~7.04%), DirectMarketing Invest AS (~4.82%), Nordea Bank Norge securities (~2.34%), Asbjørn Rudolf Hansen (~2.25%), Storetind AS (~2.07%) and Sparebankstiftelsen DNB NOR (~1.49%). Source (dated, 2012): https://www.oest.no/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/Presentasjon_1_kvartal_2012.pdf . Not confirmed from a current official filing — recommend checking oest.no investor relations or Oslo Børs/VPS registers for the current largest egenkapitalbevis holders.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; no governance, litigation or capital-adequacy concerns surfaced. Data availability on current ownership was limited in this search (most recent found data is from 2012), which is a research gap rather than a confirmed red flag.

thesis.business_description: Telelink Business Services Group AD is a Sofia-based Bulgarian IT and communications holding/operating group (incorporated as the listed entity in 2019; operating Telelink business tracing to 2001) providing IT infrastructure (cloud), cybersecurity, data/AI and IoT solutions across roughly 11 countries in the Balkans/Eastern Europe, with about 500 employees. Source: https://justetf.com/uk/stock-profiles/BG1100017190 ; https://elioplus.com/markdown/profiles/channel-partners/17922/telelink
thesis.competitive_position: Positioned as a leading Balkan IT systems integrator/technology service provider, listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange since 2020 as part of its regional expansion strategy; 2023 revenue reported at approximately EUR 94.91m with net income of approximately EUR 4.65m. Source: https://justetf.com/uk/stock-profiles/BG1100017190
thesis.main_shareholders: Per the company's own regulatory shareholder disclosures (cited in its interim/quarterly reports), as of 30 June 2021 founder Lubomir (Lyubomir) Minchev held 8,371,678 shares = 66.97% of capital directly, down from 83.65% (10,456,250 shares) at 31 December 2019 — the company's Dutch parent Telelink Holdings transferred a 78.65% stake to Minchev in 2019, with 6.175% each going to 'Bulgaria-based Assets Management' and 'Alexandrea Invest Group'. UK-listed Utilico Emerging Markets Trust was the next-largest holder, at 13.78% (1,723,099 shares) per the 2021 filing and ~13.87% per a 2022 ownership diagram. At end-2019, Ivo Evgeniev Evgeniev and Spas Toshev were also disclosed as holders above 5%, though their exact stakes were not stated in the sources found. These figures are from company interim reports dated 2021-2022; no more current (2024-2026) official shareholder filing was located in this search, so the current register should be confirmed via tbs.tech investor relations or the Bulgarian FSC/BSE disclosures. Source: https://tbs.tech/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/tbsg_2021-h1_interimmanagementreport_en.pdf ; https://seenews.com/news/bulgarias-telelink-business-services-group-seeks-regulatory-nod-to-go-public-674294
thesis.red_flags: High founder/insider concentration (majority owner Lubomir Minchev held ~67-84% of capital in 2019-2021 filings), which is typical for a recent spin-off/IPO but implies limited free float and potential minority-shareholder influence limits; no fraud, litigation or going-concern issues were identified. Source: https://tbs.tech/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/tbsg_2021-h1_interimmanagementreport_en.pdf

thesis.business_description: WASGAU Produktions & Handels AG is a German regional supermarket operator running more than 70 super- and discount markets, primarily in Saarland and the Palatinate region of Germany.
thesis.competitive_position: WASGAU is a regional German grocery retailer that has been drawn into the orbit of national players: REWE acquired a 51% stake in its parent holding company Wasgau Food Beteiligungs GmbH in 2013 (from the founding Hornbach family and the Hornbach foundation, which retained 49%), while Edeka Südwest separately holds just under 25% directly in the listed operating company WASGAU AG - giving the company a somewhat unusual dual-major-grocer ownership structure overlaying its regional retail footprint. [Lebensmittelpraxis - Rewe-Wasgau deal](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8514-wasgau-deal-genehmigt.html)
thesis.main_shareholders: Wasgau Food Beteiligungs GmbH (the holding company, 51% REWE / 49% Hornbach Stiftung since the 2013 deal) holds approximately 53.1% of WASGAU AG's listed share capital; Edeka Südwest holds just under 25% directly in the operating company. The German competition authority (Bundeskartellamt) cleared REWE's majority stake in the parent but opened a separate review of the effects of the arrangement at the WASGAU subsidiary given the combined REWE/Edeka interest; the outcome of that review was not found. [Lebensmittelpraxis](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8514-wasgau-deal-genehmigt.html)
thesis.insider_ownership: Founding Hornbach family influence has been reduced since 2013: the Hornbach Stiftung (foundation) retained a 49% stake in the parent holding company (implying an indirect ~26% economic interest in WASGAU AG), and family members Christian and Jan Hornbach were replaced on the supervisory board by REWE-nominated managers (Dr. Martin Küssner and Lionel Souque) in June 2013, with Christian Hornbach taking only a deputy seat. Management has also changed hands: Thomas Bings succeeded Ambroise Forssman-Trevedy as board spokesman on 1 January 2025. [Lebensmittelpraxis](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8717-rewe-entsendet-zwei-neue-aufsichtsratsmitglieder.html)
thesis.red_flags: The 2013 REWE/Edeka combined ownership interest in WASGAU prompted a specific Bundeskartellamt competition review of effects at the subsidiary level (separate from the parent-level clearance); the outcome of this review could not be found in this search, so it should be checked directly if relevant to governance/competition risk. [Lebensmittelpraxis](https://lebensmittelpraxis.de/handel-archiv/8514-wasgau-deal-genehmigt.html)

thesis.business_description: AC Spółka Akcyjna, founded in 1986 and based in Białystok, Poland, manufactures and sells LPG and CNG autogas conversion systems under the STAG brand (controllers, injection rails, reducers, sensors, filters) for petrol and diesel engines, plus auto parts, car electronics and Tytangas-brand antifreeze/leak-testing products, exporting internationally including via a Peru branch opened in 2014. Source: https://files.ac.com.pl/about-us ; https://ac.com.pl/about-us-about-us
thesis.competitive_position: Company states it holds the largest market share among Polish LPG autogas-system manufacturers, with STAG systems installed in more than 1 million vehicles on Polish roads, and employs more than 700 people, making it one of the largest employers in northeastern Poland; maintains its own R&D center for new products and process improvement. Source: https://files.ac.com.pl/about-us
thesis.main_shareholders: Per AC S.A.'s own current report listing shareholders holding at least 5% of votes at the Annual General Meeting of 30 June 2026: OFE PZU 'Złota Jesień' held approximately 8.58% of votes; PKO BP Bankowy OFE held approximately 6.34%; Nationale-Nederlanden OFE held approximately 4.54%; Dariusz Kowalczyk held approximately 4.22%; December Plus sp. z o.o. held approximately 4.06%. Source: https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art44735841-ac-spolka-akcyjna-wykaz-akcjonariuszy-posiadajacych-co-najmniej-5-liczby-glosow-na-walnym-zgromadzeniu-ac-s-a-dnia-30-06-2026-r . Note this AGM-attendance list differs from a separate company ESPI filing noting that Dariusz Kowalczyk's stake fell below 5% of total voting rights (https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art36484771-ac-s-a-obnizenie-udzialu-dariusza-kowalczyka-ponizej-5-ogolnej-liczby-glosow), illustrating that holdings fluctuate between reporting dates; ownership is relatively dispersed among pension funds (OFEs) with no single majority controller identified in these official sources.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources; ownership is comparatively dispersed among Polish pension funds (OFEs) rather than concentrated in a single controlling family or entity, reducing (though not eliminating) typical minority-squeeze governance risk. Share count differences between 2022 (10,073,683 shares) and 2024 (9,198,683 shares) filings suggest a buyback program occurred; this should be verified via AC S.A.'s own buyback announcements. Source: https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2024-11/Sprawozdanie-Zarzadu-IIIQ-2024_202411080500724915.xhtml

name: Zwack Unicum Likoripari és Kereskedelmi Nyilvánosan Muködo Részvénytársaság

thesis.business_description: Zwack Unicum Nyrt. is a Hungarian producer and distributor of spirits, most notably its namesake Unicum herbal liqueur, with a history dating to the Zwack family's 18th-century recipe and reclaimed post-communist privatization business, listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange.
thesis.competitive_position: Zwack Unicum holds a dominant, iconic position in the Hungarian bitters/liqueur category with its heritage Unicum brand, strengthened by a strategic partnership with global spirits major Diageo, which gives it international distribution reach alongside its family-controlled domestic leadership. [Budapest Stock Exchange company profile](https://bse.hu/pages/company_profile/$security/ZWACK)
thesis.main_shareholders: Peter Zwack & Consorten AG (the Zwack family holding vehicle, PZAG) controls a majority stake of 50%+1 share; Diageo Netherlands B.V. holds 26% as a strategic investor. The remaining free float is held by other shareholders. [Budapest Stock Exchange](https://bse.hu/pages/company_profile/$security/ZWACK), [mandadb.hu family history](https://en.mandadb.hu/cikk/951263/A_unique_liqueur_and_family_story)
thesis.insider_ownership: Family control is exercised through Peter Zwack & Consorten AG (50%+1); Sándor Zwack (son of the late Péter Zwack, who led the post-1989 reclamation of the business) has chaired the board since his father handed over leadership in 2008, representing the sixth generation of family involvement; CEO is reported as Csaba Belovai in more recent sources. [mandadb.hu](https://en.mandadb.hu/cikk/951263/A_unique_liqueur_and_family_story)
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources. The company has a long, stable family-control history since 1991 privatization; no disputes, dilution, or auditor issues surfaced in search.

thesis.business_description: Enter Air is a Warsaw, Poland-based charter airline (founded 2009, first flight April 2010) operating holiday charter flights from Poland (bases include Warsaw Chopin, Katowice-Pyrzowice and Poznań) to Mediterranean, North African and Canary Islands leisure destinations, flying mainly on behalf of tour operators (TUI, Rainbow Tours, Neckermann, Sun&Fun) as well as for some foreign tour operators and individual-ticket routes. Source: https://www.cestee.fr/compagnie-aerienne/enter-air ; https://franco.wiki/fr/Enter_Air.html
thesis.competitive_position: One of Poland's leading holiday/charter airlines with a fleet reported variously at 26-30 aircraft serving dozens of destinations/countries (figures vary by source/date); revenue is tour-operator-dependent, making it a B2B charter specialist rather than a scheduled/low-cost carrier. Source: https://logokit.com/brands/enterair.pl ; https://www.cestee.fr/compagnie-aerienne/enter-air
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Bankier.pl's shareholder register (most recent snapshot referencing a 25 June 2026 change) for the GPW-listed company (17,543,750 shares, one vote each): three major shareholders together hold 10,851,906 shares (61.84%); the largest named holder is NN OFE at 2,374,841 shares (13.53%), followed by Generali OFE at 1,802,835 shares (10.27%) and TFI Allianz Polska at 872,587 shares (4.97%). Co-founder Grzegorz Polaniecki's indirect holding via ENTR Investments sp. z o.o., previously 1,231,002 shares (7.01%) as of 24 October 2025, is shown at zero as of the 25 June 2026 snapshot, implying a sale or transfer that we could not independently confirm in this search (the destination of those shares is unclear from available sources). Source: https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ENTER/akcjonariat . Recommend verifying the Polaniecki share movement via a specific GPW ESPI notice before relying on it.
thesis.red_flags: An apparent recent (per 2026 data) divestment of co-founder Grzegorz Polaniecki's entire previously-disclosed ~7% stake was flagged in aggregator data but not confirmed/explained by an official filing in this search — this warrants follow-up verification (insider-selling pattern or ownership restructuring) rather than being treated as a confirmed red flag. No litigation or going-concern issues were identified. Source: https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/new-connect/ENTER/akcjonariat

thesis.business_description: Mühlbauer Holding AG is a German technology company, headquartered in Roding, developing smart card, e-passport/ID document, RFID and solar back-end manufacturing and production equipment, operating through Precision Parts, Production Equipment and Government Solutions segments.
thesis.competitive_position: Mühlbauer holds a specialized global niche in high-security ID document and smart-card production equipment (a technically demanding, relationship-driven government/enterprise market), with strong family-led continuity since 1981; its narrow end-market focus provides differentiation but also concentrates revenue exposure to government ID/passport procurement cycles.
thesis.main_shareholders: Josef Mühlbauer (founder) ~82.5%, GS&P Kapitalanlagegesellschaft SA ~3.43%, MFC Asset Management Public Co., Ltd. ~0.03% ([MarketScreener](https://www.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/MUHLBAUER-HOLDING-AG-436421/company/))
thesis.insider_ownership: ~82.5% held by founder Josef Mühlbauer, with family members (Isabel Mühlbauer, Josef Markus Mühlbauer, Stefan Mühlbauer) holding senior supervisory board and CEO roles
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources in this search; extremely high founder/family concentration (~82.5%) means a very small free float and limited minority-shareholder influence over governance.

thesis.business_description: Arjo AB is a Swedish medical-device and services company headquartered in Malmö (founded by Arne Johansson in 1957) that supplies patient-handling equipment (ceiling/floor lifts), hygiene and disinfection systems, medical beds, pressure-injury-prevention mattresses and VTE-prevention products, plus related services (room assessment, mobility/rehabilitation, maintenance, rental, financing), mainly to acute and long-term healthcare facilities, with ~6,500+ employees and ~$1.17bn trailing-12-month revenue. Source: https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/arjo-ab/ ; https://borsdata.se/en/arjo/analysis
thesis.competitive_position: A leading global supplier in patient-handling/medical-device niches (including the Huntleigh diagnostics brand) with a majority of revenue from Western Europe and meaningful presence in North America; scale (~$1.17bn TTM revenue) gives it an established position versus smaller regional medtech competitors. Source: https://borsdata.se/en/arjo/analysis
thesis.main_shareholders: Per aggregated ownership data (Fintel, dated March 2026, cross-checked against Investing.com/Modular Finance-sourced figures): Carl Bennet AB is the controlling shareholder with 30.0% of capital but 56.3% of votes (differential voting-rights share structure); Fjärde AP-Fonden (AP4), a Swedish state pension fund, holds 9.45% of capital / 5.9% of votes; Svolder holds 4.7% of capital / 2.9% of votes; remaining holders include Vanguard, Dimensional Fund Advisors, Nordnet Pensionsförsäkring, Avanza and BlackRock at roughly 1-3% each. These are aggregator-reported figures; not independently cross-checked against Arjo's own Euroclear-sourced shareholder register in this search, so should be verified via Arjo's investor relations ownership page. Source: https://fintel.io/so/se/arjo%20b
thesis.red_flags: Controlling shareholder Carl Bennet AB holds disproportionate voting power (56.3% of votes vs 30.0% of capital) via a dual-class/differential voting share structure, which concentrates control relative to economic ownership — a standard minority-shareholder consideration for Swedish-listed companies rather than a misconduct flag. No litigation, going-concern or dilution issues were identified. Source: https://fintel.io/so/se/arjo%20b

thesis.business_description: Selena FM S.A., headquartered in Wrocław, Poland (founded 1992/93), is a holding company producing and distributing construction chemicals and building materials (polyurethane foams, sealants, adhesives, insulation and waterproofing systems, mortars, paints, window/door accessories) under brands including Tytan, Artelit, Quilosa and Matizol, via roughly 30 subsidiaries across ~19 countries. Source: https://selena.com/en/?p=18611 ; https://selena.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/ENG_Press_Kit-About-Selena.docx
thesis.competitive_position: Describes itself as one of the four largest producers of polyurethane assembly foam for construction worldwide, organized into four divisions (Interior & Decoration; Windows & Doors; Waterproofing; Walls/Facades & Chemical Constructions) with its own R&D center (Selena Labs, Dzierżoniów) and production plants in Poland, South Korea, China, Romania, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Spain and Italy. Source: https://selena.com/en/?p=18611
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Selena FM's own current report (RB 20/2024), listing shareholders holding at least 5% of votes: Syrius Investments S.à r.l. (controlled by founder Krzysztof Domarecki) held 21,588,000 votes = 80.45% of total voting rights at the relevant general meeting; Allianz Polska OFE held 1,527,914 votes = 5.69%. Source: https://selena.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/RB-20_2024-List-of-Shareholders-of-Selena-FM-S.A.-Holding-at-Least-5-of-Votes.pdf (see also RB 13/2024: https://selena.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/RB-13_2024-List-of-Selena-FM-S.A.-Shareholders-Holding-at-Least-5-of-Votes-at-the-OGM.pdf). Third-party aggregators (Bankier.pl) give slightly different figures (Syrius ~78.01% of shares/81.28% of votes; Allianz ~6.69% shares) reflecting a different snapshot date, illustrating normal fluctuation between reporting dates.
thesis.red_flags: High ownership concentration: founder-controlled Syrius Investments holds roughly 80% of voting rights, leaving a free float of under 20% and limited influence for minority shareholders — a standard founder-control structure rather than a misconduct flag. No litigation, going-concern or dilution issues were identified from official sources.

thesis.business_description: Tubacex, S.A., incorporated in 1963 and headquartered in Llodio (Basque Country, Spain), is a vertically integrated manufacturer of seamless stainless-steel and nickel-alloy tubing for energy, process-industry, aerospace/defense and other applications (CRA OCTG tubing, hydraulic/instrumentation tubing, heat exchanger tubing, subsea umbilicals), with production plants in roughly a dozen countries and ~2,600-2,800 employees. Source: https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/STU:TCX/summary
thesis.competitive_position: Global leader in seamless stainless and nickel-alloy tube manufacturing for the energy/oil-and-gas, chemical/petrochemical, aerospace and low-carbon (hydrogen, carbon capture) sectors, with a proprietary Tubacoat ceramic coating and value-added services (design/simulation, machining, welding); listed on the Spanish exchange. Source: https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/STU:TCX/summary
thesis.main_shareholders: We could not locate a current (2024-2026) official CNMV 'participaciones significativas' filing with named major shareholders for Tubacex in this search. Historically, per Tubacex's own Annual Corporate Governance Reports (IAGC), Bagoeta, S.L. (held largely via Larreder, S.L.) was the largest declared significant shareholder at 18.088% of voting rights as of the 2010 report, with Cartera Industrial REA, S.A. at ~5% and Hermes Equity Ownership Services at ~3%; by the 2016/2018 IAGC reports, no significant shareholder above board-member level appeared in the extracted significant-holder table apart from director Jesús Esmoris Esmoris (~0.38-0.44%), suggesting Bagoeta's stake had been reduced or restructured by then. Source: https://www.tubacex.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/IAGC2010... (2010 data cited via search); https://www.tubacex.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/IAGC2018_9.pdf . Current ownership (per non-official aggregator Simply Wall St) is described as roughly 45% retail/individual investors and ~32% institutional, including Dimensional Fund Advisors, ODDO BHF, Corporación JMA, MAPFRE Asset Management and A&G Fondos — not confirmed against an official CNMV filing in this search. Recommend checking Tubacex's current IAGC (2023/2024) at tubacex.com or the CNMV significant-holdings register directly.
thesis.red_flags: None identified from official sources within reach of this search; however, the lack of a clearly identifiable controlling shareholder in recent filings (ownership apparently dispersed among retail and institutional holders) is itself worth flagging as a research gap requiring verification of the current CNMV register rather than a confirmed governance issue.

thesis.business_description: Vienna-registered holding/leasing company (FN 389840w, fiscal year ends 31 March) with ordinary and preferred shares listed. Its activities consist of leasing out the operating business of the herbal-spirits brands Gurktaler Alpenkraeuter, Rossbacher and Leibwaechter Kraeuter (rent tied to sales; Schlumberger Wein- und Sektkellerei is a distribution partner for Austria, Diversa Spezialitaeten for Germany) plus financial holdings in Peter Zwack & Consorten Handels-AG (49.998%, which holds 50% plus one share of Zwack Unicum Nyrt., Budapest) and Underberg GmbH & Co KG (about 14.4-14.6%; 14.423% in the 2023/24 report, 14.572% in a 2014 notice). FY2024/25: EBIT TEUR -472 (prior year TEUR -688). Sources: https://www.pressetext.com/news/20250624020 ; https://www.pressetext.com/news/20240626014
thesis.competitive_position: Very small niche player in Austrian/German herbal liqueurs and bitters with a holding-style structure; value is largely in the Zwack (Unicum) and Underberg stakes and brand rights rather than operating scale. Management cited sales increases, lower advertising/material costs after a post-merger simplification, and a lower write-down on brand rights in FY2024/25. Proposed dividend EUR 0.90 per share (ordinary and preferred) vs EUR 1.30 the year before (74% payout of distributable profit). Market share, competitor and moat data were not located in this search; treat as a research gap. Source: https://www.pressetext.com/news/20250624020
thesis.main_shareholders: Ordinary shares per a boerse-express company profile (aggregator, 2024 data, undated): H. Underberg-Albrecht GmbH & Co. Verwaltungs- und Vertriebs KG 75%, free float 15.3%, Schlumberger AG 9.7%; 1,354,364 ordinary shares outstanding. Preferred shares: free float 100% (750,000 shares, same aggregator). CONFLICT/STALE: an older Wikipedia-based mention (2014) names Underberg AG at 75.1%. No annual report or exchange filing confirming the current register was located; treat as unverified. Sources: https://boerse-express.com/boerse/aktie/gurktaler-ag-st+tts-55809378/firmenprofil ; https://austria-forum.org/af/AustriaWiki/Gurktaler
thesis.red_flags: Controlling holder (~75% of ordinary shares, aggregator data) and thin free float/liquidity; the same Underberg group is also a counterparty through its Underberg GmbH & Co KG stake, so related-party considerations exist (not assessed from filings). Operating result negative (EBIT TEUR -472 in FY2024/25), earnings rely on financial income from holdings; brand-right write-downs recurring; dividend cut from EUR 1.30 to 0.90. Lease/rent income depends on Schlumberger-related lessee performance. Concentration in Zwack/Underberg stakes. No litigation or accounting issues identified in this search, but no audit report or annual report was reviewed. Sources: https://www.pressetext.com/news/20250624020 ; https://www.pressetext.com/news/20240626014
thesis.website: https://gruppe.gurktaler.at (named in search results as the investor relations location; not independently verified)
thesis.insider_ownership: Could not locate named board/executive holdings with percentages in this search; treat as a research gap. The 75% holder (H. Underberg-Albrecht GmbH & Co. Verwaltungs- und Vertriebs KG) is presumably the Underberg family vehicle, but this link was not confirmed from an official source. A Firmenbuch extract (undated, possibly not current) lists Mag. Wolfgang Spiller as management board member since 1 Jan 2021. Source: https://www.evi.gv.at/f/389840w

thesis.business_description: Gr. Sarantis S.A., headquartered in Athens (listed on the Athens Stock Exchange since 1994), is the parent of Sarantis Group, a multinational consumer-products company selling personal care, home care and cosmetics products (including a joint venture with Estée Lauder for distribution in Greece, Romania, Bulgaria and Cyprus) across subsidiaries in 12 European countries, with leading presence in Eastern Europe and strong export activity. Source: https://greece.sarantisgroup.com/en/the-company/who-we-are/ ; https://www.devex.com/organizations/sarantis-group-179755
thesis.competitive_position: A leading Greek consumer-goods multinational with a diversified portfolio (personal care, home care, professional/healthcare products) sold through hypermarkets, supermarkets, groceries, beauty shops and pharmacies across Eastern and Southern Europe; brand portfolio includes Adidas and C-THRU (grooming/fragrance) and Sanitas/Camel (household). Source: https://greece.sarantisgroup.com/en/the-company/who-we-are/
thesis.main_shareholders: Per Euronext Athens' official issuer disclosure page (holders with voting rights >5%), the disclosed major holders are entities/persons named 'GR. SARANTIS', 'KYR. SARANTIS' and 'AIK. SARANTIS' (i.e., family members Grigoris, Kyriakos and Aikaterini Sarantis and/or their holding vehicles) — the exact percentages were not visible in the page excerpt retrieved in this search. Source: https://athens.euronext.com/en/market-data/issuers/134 . Third-party aggregator data (Simply Wall St, undated) separately shows individual insiders holding 5.68% (3,621,229 shares), institutions 30.8% (19,607,628 shares) and the general public 63.5% (40,471,143 shares), with FMR LLC at 10.5%, Kyriakos Sarantis at 2.56%, Swedbank Robur Fonder at 2.26% and Aikaterini Saranti at 1.83% — these do not appear to capture the full family-controlled block reported by Euronext Athens as holding >5%, so the true family stake is likely materially larger than the sum of these individually-listed small percentages suggests. An older Simply Wall St analysis cited 'private companies' holding 49% and the top 2 shareholders holding 57% combined, which is inconsistent with the newer breakdown, again underscoring the need to check Euronext Athens' current >5% disclosure table directly for exact percentages.
