thesis.business_description: Izostal S.A. (Poland) applies anticorrosion internal and external coatings/insulation to steel pipes, mainly for gas and oil pipelines, supplemented by trading in pipes, steel products and fittings. According to the company presentation, the gas sector accounts for over 90% of sales value; the main customer is the Polish gas TSO OGP Gaz-System (sales to it were PLN 132.5m in 2024, +35%, per the 2024 management report). The group order backlog was about PLN 800m at the time of the 2024 report. Full-year 2025 revenue was not located in this search (research gap). Sources: https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/izostal,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx ; https://www.bankier.pl/static/att/emitent/2025-03/sprawozdanie-zarzadu-izostal-s-a-r2024_202503281625533282.xhtml ; https://www.sii.org.pl/static/img/004165/Prezentacja_Izostal_SA.pdf
thesis.competitive_position: A niche pipe-coating contractor tightly tied to Poland's gas-transmission build-out and to its parent Stalprofil group (joint offers with Stalprofil were selected by Gaz-System, per BiznesRadar). Market share and named competitors were not found in this search (research gap). Bankier-reported items: Q3 2025 EBITDA PLN 10.7m (+39% y/y); the company agreed a deal involving a stake in Proma sp. z o.o. (sources conflict on whether it was an acquisition or disposal of stakes; treat as unclear); a dividend of about PLN 0.11/share was recommended from 2025 profit. Sources: https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/12329,oferta-stalprofilu-i-izostalu-o-wartosci-118-88-mln-zl-wybrana-przez-gaz-system ; https://www.bankier.pl/gielda/notowania/akcje/IZOSTAL/wiadomosci ; https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art43638741-izostal-spolka-akcyjna-zbycie-przez-izostal-s-a-pakietu-udzialow-w-spolce-proma-sp-z-o-o

thesis.business_description: Byggmax Group is a Nordic low-price retailer of building materials and DIY products with more than 210 stores in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. FY2025: net sales SEK 6,133m (+2.5%), like-for-like +3.4%, EBITA SEK 361m (5.9% margin vs 3.9%), net debt excluding leases SEK 354m, proposed dividend SEK 1.65 (0.75). Q2 2026: net sales SEK 2,263m (+2.9%), EBIT SEK 267m, net debt excl. IFRS 16 SEK 186m, net debt/EBITDA 0.4x. Headquarters not confirmed in this search. thesis.business_description: Digital Network S.A. (renamed from 4fun Media in February 2022) is a Polish digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising company. Through its subsidiary Screen Network S.A. it runs what it calls Poland's largest network of LED/LCD advertising screens (about 20,000 screens in 300+ cities). From November 2025 it added classic outdoor advertising by buying 100% of Braughman Group Media Outdoor (BGMO). Revenue after 9M 2025 was PLN 56.7m (+20%), with net profit of PLN 21.9m. Q1 2026 revenue was PLN 42.9m (+179% y/y), helped by consolidating BGMO. The head-office city was not confirmed in this search. Sources: https://comparic.pl/4fun-media-zmienia-nazwe-na-digital-network/ ; https://www.sii.org.pl/18180/analizy/newsroom/relacja-z-czatu-digital-network-jestesmy-w-calej-polsce-w-ponad-300-miastach.html ; https://www.sii.org.pl/18624/analizy/analizy-i-komentarze/digital-network-wazna-akwizycja-i-wysokie-marze-wraz-z-solidna-dynamika-zysku-netto-w-3q-2025-analiza.html ; https://comparic.pl/akcje-tej-spolki-z-gpw-wracaja-do-wzrostow-ostatnio-jej-kurs-poszybowal-o-90-20-04-2026/
thesis.competitive_position: Digital Network is the scale leader in Polish DOOH screen advertising, with high margins and a policy of paying out up to 100% of standalone net profit as dividends. It bought BGMO for PLN 131.5m (plus up to PLN 10m contingent), paid in cash plus 326,939 new Series G shares, adding billboard inventory. DM BOS valued the deal at about 4.5x P/EBIT. In May 2026 DM BOS raised its target to PLN 200 but cut its rating from Buy to Hold after the share price rally; the shares rose more than 200% in 2025. No market-share figures or named competitors were found in this search. Sources: https://www.biznesradar.pl/a/140883,digital-network-przejmuje-braughman-group-media-outdoor-za-131-5-mln-zl ; https://www.parkiet.com/technologie/art43278581-digital-network-robi-duze-przejecie ; https://www.gpw.pl/pub/pwpa/20260528_dom_maklerski_banku_ochrony_środowiska_dig_pl_aw.pdf
thesis.main_shareholders: Controlling holder is Epicom Ltd (Larnaca, Cyprus). Stockwatch (aggregator) shows 2,271,808 shares, or 53.59%, at 24 Jun 2025, and October 2025 press coverage of the BGMO loan also cites 53.59% of votes. Epicom held 56.79% in Feb 2020 and 61.57% after a July 2020 purchase (company ESPI notices). Simply Wall St (aggregator, undated) instead shows Epicom at 65.3% and Franklin Resources at 3.71%; this conflicts with the figures above and looks stale. The 53.59% probably predates the issue of 326,939 Series G shares to the BGMO sellers, which would dilute it once registered. Epicom's ultimate beneficial owners were not disclosed in the sources found. Sources: https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/digitanet,akcjonariat,dane-finansowe.aspx ; https://www.parkiet.com/komunikaty-espi/art27415571-4fun-media-s-a-zawiadomienie-akcjonariusza-o-zakupie-akcji-4fun-media-s-a ; https://simplywall.st/stocks/pl/media/wse-dig/digital-network-shares/ownership
thesis.red_flags: (1) Related-party dealings with the controlling holder: in 2020 subsidiaries were sold to Epicom Ltd for over PLN 6m, and in October 2025 Epicom lent PLN 20m (WIBOR 3M + 2.3%, due 31 Jan 2026) to help fund BGMO. The company also took a bank loan of about PLN 70m, moving it from a cash-rich position to debt-funded. (2) A former BGMO shareholder (Lukasz Fabisiak) publicly alleges that seller Slawomir Pawluk took over BGMO 'for free' and has announced legal steps; the company and BGMO reject this. (3) The December 2025 dividend advance was skipped to fund the deal, and integration risk follows. (4) The controlling holder is an offshore company whose beneficial owners are undisclosed, and the free float is small. (5) Much of the investor coverage (Comparic) is promotional, and the valuation has re-rated sharply (DM BOS downgrade to Hold, May 2026). thesis.business_description: Conpet S.A. (Ploiesti, Romania) operates Romania's national system for transport of crude oil, rich gas, condensate and ethane under a concession from the National Agency for Mineral Resources (GD 793/2002): about 3,800 km of pipelines, 194 crude/condensate tanks and 17 rich-gas tanks, plus rail transport services. FY2025 per final BVB filing: turnover RON 545.54m (+2.2%), operating profit RON 53.86m (+8.8%), operating revenues RON 617.70m (the preliminary February 2026 release said RON 617.09m). Share capital 8,657,528 shares at RON 3.3 nominal. Sources: https://www.bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/COTE_20260326074708_COTE-25-03-2026---Sinteza-Raport-anual-2025-BVB-Eng.pdf ; https://www.energynomics.ro/en/companii/conpet/ ; https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/COTE_20260226170115_COTE-26-02-2026-Sinteza-raport-2025-date-preliminare-ENG.pdf
thesis.competitive_position: Concession holder for the national crude oil pipeline system, so effectively the incumbent operator of the national network; tariffs are regulated through the mineral resources agency (ANRM/NAMR), e.g. a 2019 tariff order set refinery-specific rates and a later 4% increase was reported (date not checked). A 2006 article called it the only operator of the main crude pipelines; current exclusivity was not verified. Customer concentration among Romanian refineries (e.g. Petrobrazi, Lukoil/Ploiesti, Petromidia) is plausible but current volumes and contracts were not located; treat as a research gap. Sources: https://www.energynomics.ro/en/companii/conpet/ ; https://profit.ro/povesti-cu-profit/energie/conpet-a-majorat-cu-4-tarifele-de-transport-prin-sistemul-national-de-transport-al-titeiului-gazolinei-condensatului-19216939
thesis.main_shareholders: Most recent official figure found is stale: preliminary 2022 annual report (31 Dec 2022) shows the Romanian State via the Ministry of Energy at 58.7162% and other holders 41.2838%. Fondul Proprietatea sold a 23.6% block in 2014 (retaining about 6.1% then; later status unconfirmed) and press reported KJK buying about 4.5% from it (date and current status not verified). The 2025 annual report shareholder table was not retrieved; treat current percentages as a research gap. Sources: https://bvb.ro/infocont/infocont23/COTE_20230227174906_Raport-anual-preliminar-2022-CONPET-ASF-si-BVB-ENG.pdf ; https://www.wall-street.ro/articol/Piete-de-capital/175403/fondul-proprietatea-a-scos-la-vanzare-prin-plasament-privat-un-sfert-din-conpet.html ; https://www.zf.ro/burse-fonduri-mutuale/finlandezii-de-la-kjk-au-luat-4-5-din-conpet-de-la-fondul-proprietatea-13582418

Regulated tariff and concession dependence on a mineral-resources agency; throughput depends on a few Romanian refineries and on the crude supply chain (no current customer-concentration or sanction/Ukraine-related disclosures were located). A 2023 preliminary net profit was RON 60.2m (reported); 2025 net profit of about RON 53.76m is from a registry aggregator, not verified. The shareholder data above is stale.
